mchog la rgyal mtshan phul/ /ring por mi thogs nor mang rnyed par 'gyur/ /shes rab mtha' yas mdzod ni mang ldan yang ①/ /sems chung mi 'gyur dman pa'i sems mi 'gyur/ /de ni gzhan la gnod pa'i sems mi skyed/ /sems ni rab dang rtag tu bag yod ldan/ /de la me dang dug dang mtshon mi tshugs/ /skye bo tshogs chen gyis ni blta bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten mar me gcig phul na/ /'di nas bzung ste srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni 'dzam gling gser gyis gang / /de 'dra'i dpal de zad par bya mi nus/ /bcom ldan mchod rten mar me phul byas na/ /de yi lus ni mdog ngan yong mi 'gyur—/ /gzugs mchog sra zhing lag pa gzu ba 'dra/ /snang ba thob nas 'jig rten kun du rgyu/ /gal te khrag khrig brgya stong sangs rgyas zhing / /yungs 'bru dag gis byur bur gang gyur pa/ /bgrang ba dang ni gzhal zhing brjod par nus/ /bde gshegs mar me gcig phul de lta min/ /rgyan kyis ④brgyan pa'i gzugs mdzes blta sdug pa/ /su zhig bcom ldan mchod rten 'bul byed pa/ /de 'dir lus ni mtshungs pa med 'gyur te/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i sku ni rab 'bar ba/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos spu'agyur/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzugs dang gser 'dra dang / /'dzam gling gser ltar rab mdzes blta ④na sdug /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas pas mngon du gang / /mngon par shes pa 'thob cing dbang cher grags/ /byang chub spyod mchog dam pa zhi ba spyod⑤—/ /de ni nams kyang rjolongs spyod 'grib mi 'gyur/ /lhas kyang bste stang bya zhing mchod par 'os/ /brtan pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod gzhar mi dga'//tshul khrims rnam dag rab mkhas tshangs par spyod/ /yi dam bcas nas 64—1403

nags dang nags 'dab ①song / /mngon shes 'thob cing khyad par 'thob par 'gyur—/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rnams la gdugs 'bul ba/ /ji lta bur yang byang chub sems mi 'dor/ /byams la gnas shing mi dman sems su 'gyur//de yi shes pa rnams ⑤kyang nyams pa med/ /rol mo sgra yis mi mchog mchod byas ④na—/ /mya ngan med cing dbang ldan rgyal por 'gyurabu/ /mi yi 'jig rten yid 'ong sgra ldan 'gyur/ /de sgra yan lag tshang zhing dag par ⑤'ong bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i dhisgra byas na/ /shes bzhin ldan zhing mig ni rnam dag 'gyur—/ /rna ba rnam par dag cing sems kyang dag /sna yi dbang po mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de yi lce ni rab mdzes blta na sdug /thog mar rab mnyen mdzes shing sgra yid 'ong / /dper na lha yi rin chen byi ru 'dra/ /sgra skad yan lag bye ⑦ba dpag med 'byin/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i ⑧sgra byas na/ /nams kyang sbrul du mi 'gyur lce med min/ /zhar ba sgur po ya yo can mi 'gyur/ /lus ni khyad par 'phags shing shin tu mdzes/ /bcom ldan mchod rten rol mo'i ⑨sgra byas na/ /lha 'am klu 'am mi 'am lto 'phye che/ /su yang de la ma dad skyed mi 'gyur/ /dbugs phyin thob nas 'jig rten kun du rgyu//bcom ldan mya ngan ⑩'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du/ /yan lag ma smad khyad 'phags lus thob cing mdzes la mtshan gyis go char ⑪byas par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyags/ /lha yi tsan+dan khyad 'phags rab mdzes pa'i/ /gzhal med khang mchog yid 'ong dri ldan 'thob/ /de ni de la nam yang sred mi skyed/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑫bstan pa 64byed1404

'jig 'gyur tshe/ /'dzam bu'i ①gling du skye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /de ni de tshe mtho ris bdag por 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /dri mi zhim dang mi gtsang smad pa rnams/ /rtag tu spong zhing tshul khrims phung por gnas—/ /de ni rtag tu tshangs spyod mchog 'di spyod/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /'di nas shi 'phos mtho ris lha dbang 'gyur/ /ring por mi thogs don stong rnams la rtog /lha rnams la ni rgya chen don kyang byed/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /khyad 'phags tshig ldan sgra dbyangs yid 'ong 'gyur/ /skye bo mang po'i yid 'ong dga' zhing bkur/ /de yi kha bzhin rtag tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten spos byug phul byas na/ /de ni ngan song sa rnams ma lus spong / /de bzhin gshegs dang ②nye ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /dad pa thob cing rtag tu bde ba dga'/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /de ni mi khom brgyad po kun spong zhing //de ni dal 'gyur de ni khyad par 'phags/ /de ni sangs rgyas mtshungs med mchod par zhu byed/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /bag yod blo gros brtan ④la dpa' bor 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i yon tan dag la dga' mi bskyed—/ /mi dman sems kyis mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /de ni nams kyang byang chub sems mi 'dor/ /tshul khrims skyon med shin tu bsdams par 'gyur/ /rnam dag 'dod chags bral ba'i chos kyang 'thob/ /bcom ldan mchod rten ba rgya bsal byas na/ /de ni mdog ngan dus rnams rtag tu spong / /'chal ba'i shes rab ma lus rnam par spong / /shes rab rgya chen gyur nas spyod la gnas/ /bcom ldan mchod rten 64—1405

ba rgya bsal byas na/ /kha zas gtsang ma dag kyang rnyed 'gyur zhing / /khyad 'phags kha dog ldan zhing blta sdug pa/ /reg dang ldan zhing ①rab mdzes gos ④rnams 'thob/ /dad pa'i shugs bskyed bcom ldan mchod rten la/ /me tog skam po nyal nyil phyags byas na/ /'dod pa smad pa sdug bsngal bye ba rnguspong / /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ded dpon mnyes par byed/ /mchod rten me tog rnying pa su 'phyag pa/ /de ni mdzes shing rnam dag lus su 'gyur/ /skye bo mang pos mchod 'os blta 'os 'gyur/ /de la rgyal po gnod par sems mi 'gyur/ /bcom lda na mchod rten dag la snga rabs mis/ /me tog phul ba skam po phyags byas na/ /ngan song sa yi lam ngan thams cad gcod/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims phung por gnas/ /mchod rten me tog rnying pa su 'phyag pa/ /bag yod mya ngan rnams dang skyon rnams spong / /nad rnams du ma ma lus rnam par spong / /bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su dbugs 'byin 'thob/ /mchod rten me tog rnying pa su 'phyag pa/ /sbyin gnas mtshungs med sems rgyas 'thob par 'ong / /mtshungs med thob cing lha mis mchod 'os 'gyur/ /rnam dag lus ldan rgyan gyis ④brgyan par 'gyur/ /lha yi me tog rab mdzes man+da thu ra/ /mtshungs med pa ta la yang su 'bul dang / /mchod rten me tog nyal nyil su 'phyag pa/ /de dag rnam smin 'dra ste mchog tu 'gyur/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur byar mos bskyed de/ /ston pa'i mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba/ /'jig rten dag na bla mar bkur ste kye bya/ /de ni mdzes shing blta na sdug par 'gyur—/ /de 'dir rgyal srid thob nas lha klu mi/ /lto 'phye che dang 'jig rten thams cad 'dud/ /stong gi 'jig rten khams kun rgyas par 'gyur/ /64—1406

dbang phyug nyid du dbang thob rgyal srid bsten/ /de yi yul la sems can gang gnas pa/ /de kun sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs par 'god/ /des ni ngan song sa yang rnam par spong / /de dag rnams kyis don mchog dam pa byed/ /bsod nams blo gros dran ① ldan mchod 'os 'gyur/ /dbugs khyephyin thob nas 'jig rten kun du rgyu/ /de yi g.yog 'khor yid 'ong sgra skad ldan/ /bsam pa ji bzhin de dag dga' ba bskyedaldu / /gsal snyan ngag gis ④sems can go bar byed/ /de srog dbang phyug sus kyang phan mi byed/ /skye bo tshogs chen dag gis blta 'os 'gyur/ /de yi g.yog kyang dbyangs ldan ⑤yan lag dag /sangs rgyas mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba/ /sbyin dang snyan par pyasmra dang don spyod ⑦dang / /don mthun pa dag skye bo mang la byed/ /spyos shing brgyad kyang khro ba'i dngos mi bskyed3/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba//mtho ris 'jig rten gnas shing lha dbang 'gyur/ /mir gyur na yang mi yi rgyal po 'os/ /de ni nam yang yongs su nyams mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba/ /de ni nam yang ngan song phyis mi ltung / /'jig rten 'dir de rtag tu 'dod pa spong / /nor can nang na phyug cing nor mang 'gyur—/ /yon tan ldan la tshig gcig su smra ba/ /de ni nam yang mi rigs bsngags mi spyod⑪ / /mi yi 'jig rten gnas min spyod mi 'gyur/ /de la sems can mi ngoms /tsodaga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /snying rje chen po pad ma dkar po'i mdo las kyang / kun dga' bo nga 'dug pa la mngon sum du bste stong ⑩byed pa dang bla mar byed pa nas mchod par byed pa'i bar lta zhog /gang nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam la bste stong ⑫64—1407

—byed pa lta yang zhog /nga'i phyir mchod rten byas pa la gang bsnyi stong ①byed pa lta yang zhog ste/ kun dga' bo gang dag kha cig sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i sems kyis me tog gcig nam mkha' la 'dor na/bsod nams kyi phung po de'i rnam par smin pa dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag ④thams cad kyi ④'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ tha ma mya ngan las 'das par nga smra'o—/ /kun dga' bo gang dag kha cig sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i sems kyis me tog gcig nam mkha' la 'dor na/de'i rnam par smin pa gang yin pa de ni/ kun dga' bo gal te sems can 'ga' zhig bskal pa gcig tu 'khor ba la 'di ④ji srid par kun du brgyug cing 'khor yang / 'khor ba'i sngon gyi mtha' mi shes pa bzhin du bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'du byas pa de'i mtha' de ni brgya byin nyid rnams kyis ⑤rnyed par sla ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/kun dga' bo 'di ltar sangs rgyas la phul ba'i yon tan ⑥ni 'khor ba na spyod pa'i bde ba thams cad kyi mthas gtugs ④par sla ba ma yin te/ gzhan du na dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa nyid 'bras bu ⑧yin pas tha ma mya ngan las 'da' bar nga smra'o/ /kun dga' bo gang dag kha cig mngon du bste stang byed pa lta yang zhog /gang nga'i sku gdung dang ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam la sku gdung gi mchod pa byed pa lta yang zhog /gang nga'i phyir mchod rten byas pa rnams la bste stang byed pa lta yang zhog /gang sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na me tog gcig nam mkha' la 'dor ba yang ⑫lta yang zhog ste/ kun dga' bo gal te sems can mya ngan las 'das pa'i ⑩skal ba med pa zhig gis ⑪64byed1408

sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na ①me tog gcig nam mkha' la 'dor na yang kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i ⑧'bras bu de yang mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pas klas pa ①dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthas gtugs par nga smra'o zhes gsungs so/ /klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chen po las kyang / klu'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chos brgyad dang ldan na/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sangs rgyas dang phrad pa ④'thob po /brgyad gang zhe na/ sems can sangs rgyas kyi gzugs la lta ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la rim gro byed pa dang /rgyun mi 'chad par de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byed pa dang / sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa la ⑤blta ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgra grag sdepa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der smon lam 'debs pa dang / rgyun zhum pa med pa dang / rgyun rgya chen por gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes tshol ba'o zhes gsungs so/ /bsod nams 'phel bar 'dod pa la sangs rgyas dang 'phrad pa ci dgos she na/ de'i mtha' ni thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin pas mi shes te/ 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa las ji skad bsngags pa lta bu'o/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyar yang / /sangs rgyas sgra ni rab bkod spyon/ /je tshom thams cad gcod pa'i mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /chos kun rtogs par thugs chud cing / /'jig rten gsum gyi bsod nams stegs/ /sems can thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /'jig rten sgon ma mthong ba legs/ /bsod nams che las grub pa'i zhing / /64byed1409

ye shes dkyil 'khor rab shar ba/ /'jig rten dpag med snang bar mdzad/ /bsod nams phung po rnam par 'phel/ /sdug bsngal dra ba gcod mdzad cing / /ye shes phung po sbyong ①ba yi/ /rgyal ba gang gis snemanyes byas pa/ /de dag ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med/ /rkang gnyis dam pa mthong na ni/ /sems rgya chen po skye zhu'agyur zhing / /shes rab stobs ni 'od gsal ba/ /grangs med pa yang skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las/ sems can kun gyi ④don gyi phyir/ /brtan zhing thugs rje che ldan la⑤/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang 'byung / /don kun brtson ⑥pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyar yang / /lus can dag ni thams cad kyis/ /lan du phan gdags ji ltar nus/ /ngan song gsum po mi bzad du/ /bskal pa bye bar bsreg bla 3yi/ /chags pa thams cad rnam bzlog pa/ /ston pa mi mthong de lta min/ /'jig rten ji snyed thams cad kyi⑧//ngan song 'gro ba so so der/ /shin tu yun ring gnas bla ⑨yi/ /sangs rgyas mi thos de lta min/ /ci yi phyir na ngan song du/ /yun ring gnas par 'dod ce na/ /gang phyir rgyal ba'i dbang po dag /mthong na ye shes 'phel phyir ro/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal mthong na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad 'gyur//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyod yul gyis⑫/ /ye shes la yang 'jug par 'gyur/ /mi mchog sangs rgyas mthong na ni/ /sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /gang gis byang chub thob ⑫'gyur ba'i/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'phel/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bsod nams rab tu ⑫ 'phel bar bya ba la sangs rgyas dang phrad r+shartepa ni de ltar dgos pa yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku 64—1410

gzugs tsam mthong ba yang de tsam du 'bras bu dpag tu med na/ rang gi ngo bo mthong ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis①—/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis sangs rgyas ri mor bris pa'am gzugs su byas pa mthong na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa bskyed ⑤na/ thal mo sbyar ba'am me tog gam bdug pa'am spos sam mar me 'bul ba lta ci smos te/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa ①bskyed do zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las kyang / bsod nams spel ba'i thabs ④gsungs te/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'phyag pa de smon lam rnam par dag pa mchog bzhi 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ gzugs la smon lam rnam par dag pa mchog dang / mnyam par gzhag pa brtan pa la smon lam rnam par dag pa mchog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba la smon lam rnam par dag pa mchog dang /mtshan phun sum tshogs pa la smon lam rnam par dag pa mchog ces bya ba'o/ /yang de nyid las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten rnams la me tog 'bul ba'am spos ris 'dri na ma tshang ba med pa brgyad 'thob ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/gzugs ma tshang ba med par 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa dang /g.yog 'khor ma tshang ba med pa dang / tshul khrims ma tshang ba med pa dang /64—1411

ting nge 'dzin ma tshang ba med pa dang / thos pa ma tshang ba med pa dang / shes rab ma tshang ba med pa dang / smon lam ma tshang ba med pa zhes gsungs so/ /rin po che'i phung po'i mdo las kyang / gang dag srid pa gsum du gtogs pa'i sems can de dag thams cad so so nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'phang du 'di lta ste/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab lta bu byed la de dag ①la yang so so nas gang gā'i ṭuklung gi bye ma snyed kyi ④bskal par bste stang bya ba thams cad kyis ④bste stang byed pa bas byang chub sems dpa' gang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bas me tog gcig 'dor na/ de ni bsod nams kyi phung po snga ma bas bsod nams ches mang du bskyed do zhes gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs par gyur la/thams cad 'khor los a+yosgyur ba'i rgyal srid dang ldan par gyur te/ 'khor los ⑥sgyur ba'i rgyal po re res kyang mar me'i snod rgya mtsho chen po tsam byas te/ ri rab tsam gyi mar me'i snying pos mar me bus la/ so so nas de lta bu'i mar me'i mchod pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten rnams la mchod pa bas/ byang chub sems dpa' khyem gyi gnas nas 'byung ba gang gis ⑦mar me'i snying po 'bru mar gyis bskus te de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten kyi drung du 'dzin na/ras 'bru mar gyis bskus pa'i mar me 'di la snga ma'i mar me phul ba des brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /'khor los ④sgyur ba'i rgyal po de dag gis ⑨ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i ⑩dge slong gi dge 'dun la bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis ⑪phu dud byed pa bas/ byang chub sems dpa' 64—1412

khyem gyi gnas nas mngon par byung ba gang gis bsod snyoms blangs te/ lhung bzed du chud pa de gzhan dag dang bgo bsha' byas te zan de ni de bas ches mang zhing ches rin che'o/ /gang yang rgyal po chen po de dag gis ri rab tsam gyi gos kyi phung po sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba bas/byang chub sems dpa' khyem stigyi gnas nas mngon par ④byung ba gang gis ①phyi rol du byung ste/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la chos gos gsum phul na/ dge slong gi chos gos byin pa 'dis gos sbyin ④pa snga ma de zil kyis non par 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyal po de dag re res 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad me tog gis mdzes par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phul ba bas/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim gyi gnas nas byung ba gang gis spritha na de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la me tog gcig phul na sbyin pa 'di la sbyin pa snga ma bas ⑥des brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi phod do zhes gsungs so/ /mthar kyis yang dag par 'phags pa'i ④le'u las kyang bstan te/ phan yon bzang po bzhi po 'di dag mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa la spro bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/bdag gis ⑧sbyin gnas kyi mchog la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ba dang /bdag mthong nas gzhan dag kyang de bzhin du slob par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pas byang chub kyi sems brtan par 'gyur ba dang /mngon sum du mthong bas skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs par 'gyur ba ste/ bzhi po 'di ⑨dag go zhes so/ /'di ni de bzhin 64—1413

gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro byed pa bla na med pa ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las ji skad du/ blo gros rgya mtsho gsum po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro byed pa bla na med pa'o/ /gsum gang zhe na/gang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / gang dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang / gang sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed pa'o zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o—/ /'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las kyang bstan te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bcu dang ldan na mngal gyi dri mas mi gos par skye'o/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs byed pa dang /mchod rten zhig pa 'chos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dag la spos kyi byug pa 'bul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dag la khrus kyi spos chu 'bul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dag la phyag dar dang skyang nul bya ba 'bul ba dang / pha ma la lus kyi rim gro byed pa dang /mkhan po dang slob dpon dag la lus kyi rim gro byed pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la lus kyi rim gro byed pa dang / de yang zang zing med pa'i sems kyis te zang zing dang bcas pas ma yin pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang 'di rmyeltar/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad mngal kyi dri mas ma gos par skye bar gyur cig ces yongs su bsngo zhing de yang bsam pa thag pa nas sems pa ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag go zhes bya ba'o bu/ /rjes su yi rang ba'i phan yon ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gsungs te/gang theg pa la dang po yang dag par ④zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi sems bskyed pa de la rjes su yi rang bar bgyid/ byang 64—1414

chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi sems bskyed pa de la rjes su yi rang bar bgyid/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi ①phyir mi ldog pa'i chos de ②nyid la rjes su yi rang bar babyis na/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i ①bsod nams kyi phung po ji snyed cig bskyed par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni srang tshad kyis gzhal bas tshad gzung bar nus kyi/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su yi rang ba'i mdo las skyes pa'i sems bskyed pa de dag gi bsod nams ni tshad gzung bar mi nus so/ /de skad ces bka' pa pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byen gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ④ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar la rjes su yi rang ba las skyes pa'i bsod nams 'di ltar dpag tu med do zhes bya ba mi nyan pa dang ma 'tshal ba dang rjes su yi rang bar mi bgyid pa dang mi sems pa de dag ni bdud kyis byen gyis brlabs pa lags so/ /sems can de dag ni ⑤bdud kyi phyogs su 'gyur ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'am nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag gis sems bskyed pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag gis dhimyur du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang 64—1415

dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed par 'gyur gyi mi mnyes par byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rjes su yi rang ba'i mod las skyes pa'i sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis gang dang gang du skye ba de dang der phu dud du bya bar 'gyur bla mar bya bar 'gyur ri mor bya bar 'gyur mchod par bya bar 'gyur rjed ①par 'gyur gsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni yid du mi 'ong ba'i gzugs rnams mthong bar mi 'gyur ro④/ /de dag ni yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra rnams thos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dri dang ro rnams ma yin zhing reg bya rnams reg par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni ngan song du skye bar mi 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni mtho ris su skye bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can de dag gis sems can grangs med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can de dag thams cad la bde ba skyed pa dag la rjes su yi rang ba'i phyir te/ de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can grangs med pa dpag tu med pa dag yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du byed par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'o—/ /yang de nyid las/ rab 'byor stong gsum rmi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas par gyur la/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas nas kyang bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du dmigs pa'i 'du shes kyis/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug pa bas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dang thabs mkhas pas zin pa gang gis/ 'das 64—1416

pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang rnam par grol ba dang /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang /sde rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po dang / nyan thos kyi tshul khrims dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po thams cad gcig tu bsdus te/ bzlums shing gzhal la/ ma lus pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i mchog gis burjes su yi rang ba dang / gtso bo dang dam pa dang rab dang phul dang gya nom pa dang bla ma dang bla na med pa dang bla ma'i bla ma dang mnyam pa med pa dang / mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa dang dpe zla med pas rjes su yi rang la rjes su yi rang ba'i mod las skyes pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo na/ rab 'byor rjes su yi rang ba'i mod ①las skyes pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po 'di la/ byang chub sems dpa' dmigs pa can gyi ④bsam gtan bzhi'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa snga ma des brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod bo/ zhes gsungs so/ /tshul 'di nyid ni yongs su bsngo ba la yang gsungs so/ /gsol ba gdab pa'i phan yon ni drag shul can gyis zhus pa las/ chos yongs su gzung ⑤bar bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhal du med grangs med pa rnams su tshe yongs su bsgyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /bslab pa kun las btus pa las phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i phan yon gyi le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o / /⑥bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i tshul 64—1417

gyis bsod nams 'phel bar bshad zin to // //①'di yang 'di'i rgyu gzhan yin te/ dad pa la sogs pa ④rtag tu bsgom pa gang yin pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo las ji skad gsungs pa lta bu ste/ rgyal po chen po chos bzhi po 'di dag ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams yongs su mi nyams shing khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba'o1/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ rgyal po chen po dad pa ni yongs su mi nyams shing khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba'obu/ /dad pa gang zhe na/ dad pa gang gis 'phags pa'i drung du nye bar 'gro ba dang mi bya ba mi byed pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po gus pa ni khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba ste/ gus pa gang gis 'phags pa rnams kyis legs par bshad pa rnams gus par nyan pa dang rna blags te chos nyan pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po nga rgyal med pa ni khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba ste/nga rgyal med pa gang gis ⑤'phags pa rnams la mngon par 'dud pa dang rab tu 'dud pa la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /rgyal po chen po brtson 'grus ni khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba ste/ brtson 'grus gang gis lus rjoyang ba dang sems yang ba 'thob pa dang bya ba thams cad kyang nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa ste/ rgyal po chen po chos bzhi po 'di dag ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams yongs su mi klunyams shing khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba'o ④zhes bya ba ste/dad pa la sogs pa 'di dag la rtag tu goms par bya'o/ /yang na dad pa la sogs pa gzhan dag la ste/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las ji skad du/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ⑨ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub 64—1418

sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po lnga rnams mi zad pa ste/ de la dbang po lnga gang zhe na/ gang 'di dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang /dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /de la dad pa'i dbang po gang zhe na/ dad pa gang gis ①chos bzhi la dad pa ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor ba na spyod pa'i 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la dad pa ste/ de las kyi rnam par smin pa la ston ②pa yin/ dge ba'am sdog pa'i las gang dang gang byas pa de dang de'i rnam par smin pa myong bar 'gyur ro snyam ste srog gi phyir yang sdig pa'i las mi byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la dad pa ste/ spyod pa de la zhugs nas kyang theg pa gzhan la 'dod pa mi bskyed ①pa dang / chos thams cad la don dam pa nges pa'i don zab mo/ rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba bdag med pa sems can med pa srog med pa gso ba med pa gang zag med par rnam par dpyod pa dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa'i mtshan nyid du dad pa ste/ lta bar gyur pa thams cad bag la nyal bar mi byed pa dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la dad pa ste/ dad pa'i phyir the tshom dang nom nur dang bral bas sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag yang dag par sgrub pa rjoste 'di ni dad pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /de la brtson 'grus kyi dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang la dad pa'i dbang pos ⑤dad par 'gyur ba'i rjochos de dag brtson 'grus kyi dbang pos yang dag par sgrub pa ste/ 'di ni brtson 'grus kyi dbang po zhes bya'o/ /de la dran pa'i dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang brtson 'grus kyi dbang pos yang dag par 64—1419

bsgrub pa'i chos de dag dran pa'i dbang pos chud mi gson te/ 'di ni dran pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /de la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po gang zhe na/ dran pa'i dbang pos chos gang chud mi gson pa'i chos de dag ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse gcig tu byed de/ 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po zhes bya'o/ /de la shes rab kyi dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse gcig tu byas pa'i chos de dag shes rab kyi dbang pos rab tu rtog cing shin tu rtog par byed de/ gang chos de ①dang de dag la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog ②par shes shing so sor rang gis ①shes pa 'di rjoni shes rab kyi dbang po zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na dbang po lnga po 'di dag ni lhan cig tu 'grogs shing rjes su 'byel pa ste—/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /lung bstan pa'i sar yang gzhog go zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /dad pa la sogs pa'i stobs rnams la yang rtag tu goms par bya ste/'phags pa gtsug na rin po che'i mdo las ji skad du/ rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa'i stobs kyi spyod pa yongs su dag pa gang zhe na/ gang dbang po de dag gis nye bar bstan ⑤nas bdud thams cad kyis mi brdzi pya bar 'gyur ba dang /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gnyis kyis mi 'phrogs ④par 'gyur ba dang / theg pa chen po 'di las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis mi thul bar ④'gyur ba dang / sngon gyi dam bcas pa la brtan par 'gyur ba dang / sems kyi stobs shin tu brtan par 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / dbang po rnams sbed par 'gyur ba dang /dgra rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ba dang / phyir rgol ba thams cad kyis mi 64—1420

bskyod par 'gyur ba'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar/re zhig bsod nams spel ba'i phyir/ /dad pa la sogs rtag tu bsgom①/ /gzhan yang byams dang zhes bya ba ni/ zla ba'i ②sgon ma'i mdo las ji skad du/bye ba khrag khrig dkrigs ①pa'i zhing dag na/ /mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la de yis rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems kyi grangs dang char mi phod/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas stsogs rjodran bya/ /sangs rgyas la sogs pa rjes su dran pa de yang gang zhe na/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i ⑤mdo las bsngags pa ste/ mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis /mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i dbu skra 'jam mdzes snum zhing bzang / /khyod kyi gtsug tor 'di na ri rgyal bzhin/ /gtsug tor ④mi mthong khyod dang mtshungs ma mchis/ /thub pa khyod kyi smin mtshams mdzod spus mdzes/ /kun da zla ba kha ba dung ltar dkar/ /thugs rje gang gis 'gro ba 'di gzigs pa/ /spyan mchog bzang po ut+pal sngon po 'dra/ /rgyal ba dri med spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ljags dze+eyangs srab la zangs kyi mdog 'dra ba/ /de yis rang gi zhal gyi gdong yang khebs/ /chos gsungs pas ni 'gro ba 'dul bar bkyi/ /'jam snum gsung ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshems bzangs ④ shin tu brtan pa rdo rje 'dra/ /bcu dang sum cu snyoms shing thags bzang ba/ /'dzum pa mdzad nas ⑫'gro ba 'dul bar bgyid/ /bden gtam snyan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba khyod kyi gzugs dang mtshungs ma mchis/ /'od 64—1421

kyis ①zhing brgya dag kyang snang bar bgyid/ /'jig rten na ni tshangs dbang skyong de dag /bcom ldan khyod kyi 'od kyis ①zil du brlag /e na'i ①byin pa mnyam med bcom ldan 'das/ /glang po'i rgyal po rma bya seng ge'i stabs/ /bcom ldan gnya' shing gang du gzigs shing gshegs/ /sa dang ri dang ngam pa g.yo bar mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das sku mtshan gyis dubargyan pa ste/ /khyod kyi pags pa 'jam zhing gser mdog 'dra/ /'gro ba gzugs 'di lta bas ngoms mi 'gyur/ /khyod ni mtshungs pa ma mchis gzugs dang ldan/ /khyod sngon bskal pa brgyar ni dka' thub spyad/ /khyod gtong dul dang sbyin pa kun la dgyes—/ /sems can kun la thugs rje byams thugs ldan/ /mchog tu thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni sbyin dang tshul khrims rtag tu dgyes/ /khyod ni bzod dang brtson 'grus dges rab brtan/ /khyod ni bsam gtan shes rab 'od gzigs khru mnga'/ /mtshungs med ye shes mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni smra ba ngan pa'i tshogs can 'joms/ /khyod ni seng ge lta bur 'khor du sgogs—/ /khyod ni sman pa'i rgyal po dri gsum sel/ /mchog tu dga' mdzad khyod pyal phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa sku gsung thugs ni rnam par dag /pad ma chu ltar srid pa gsum mi gos/ /khyod ni tshangs dbyangs ka la ping ka'i skad/ /srid gsum pha rol gshegs ④la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyis ⑧'gro 'di sgyu ma lta bu dang / /gar la lta dang rmi lam 'dra ba dang / bdag med sems can med cing srog 'gro med/ /chos rnams smig rgyu chu zla 'dra bar mkhyen/ /stong pa zhi ba skye ba med pa'i tshul/ /ma shes pas na 'gro ba 'khyams 'gyur te/ /thugs rje ⑨thabs tshul rig ⑩pa brgya dag gis⑪/ /de dag rnams ni 'dzud par mdzad 64—1422

pa lags/ /'dod chags la sogs nad mang brgya dag gis/ /skrag par 'gyur ba'i 'gro la rtag gzigs te/ /bde gshegs sems can brgya dag yongs 'grel dhicing / /zla med dman pa lta bu rnam par rgyu/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi dang mya ngan non/ /sdug dang bral dang smre sngags 'don pa brgyas/ /rtag tu na ba'i 'gro ba gzigs nas ni/ /thub pa thugs rjes yongs su 'grel zhing rgyu/ /dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba'i 'gro rnams su/ /'gro kun shing rta'i 'phang lo bzhin du 'khor/ /glen pa dmigs bu ma mchis mgon ma mchis/ /de la lam gyi dam pa ston mdzad pa/ /gtso bo mtshungs pa med pas gang bstan pa/ /'phags lam de nyid gang dag sngon chad kyi/ /chos kyi dbang phyug 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba de dag rnams kyis rab tu gsungs/ /'jam zhing mnyen la yid du 'ong ba'i mchog /tshangs las lhag par mchog tu dga' bgyid pa/ /dri za mi ci lha yi bu mo mchog /sgra de zil gyis ④mnan nas gsung ba mdzad①/ /bden dang drang ba mi zad thabs tshul gyis/ /yongs sbyangs duyon tan mtha' yas ldan pa'i gsung / /de thos sems/ can khrag khrig phrag brgya dag⑤ /theg pa gsum gyis zhi bar mchi bar bgyid/ /byed la mchod pas lha yi bde ba ni/ /rnam pa mang dang de bzhin mi yis du'athob/ /mi yi bdag po 'gro la phan bgyid pa—/ /phyug ⑦cing nor che 'byor pa chen por 'gyur/ /mtshungs med byed la dad pa bskyed pa ni/ /gling bzhi bdag po 'khor los ④sgyur ba mchog /'gro la dge ba bcu po kun dbyed ⑨pa/ /rin chen rab bzangs ⑩bdun ldan thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba khyod la mchod pa bgyis pas ni/ /tshangs pa brgya byin 'jig rten bdag po dang / /yongs su dga' ldan lha yi bdag po dang / /64—1423

gzhan 'phrul ba ①dang 'thab bral rab dgar 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i ④sdug bsngal rnam mang sel mdzad pa/ /mnyam med khyod la mchod dang mthong ba dang / /thos pa'ang de ltar 'bras bu mchis lags te/ /gnas mchog rga shi med pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan lam la mkhas shing lam mkhyen pa/ /'jig rten 'di ni ngan pa'i lam las zlog1 /bcom ldan 'gro ba dag ni 'phags pa'i lam—/ /bde ba zhi ba rdul dang bral la 'god/ /bsod nams gter khyod bsod nams don gnyer ba'i/ /bsod nams bgyi ba rtag tu mi bas te/ /byang chub dam pa ma thob bar du ni/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por ④bas mi 'gyur/ /gzhan 'phrul 'dra ba rtag tu dga' bkyid pa/ /yongs su dag cing mdzes pa thob par 'gyur/ /dam pa'i zhing du lus dang ngag yid kyis/ /sems can dag ni rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i mi yis 'di la sogs/ /yon tan rnam pa du ma thob par 'gyur/ /mtho ris thar pa rjomi yi bde ba dang //'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gter thob 'gyur/ /khyod kyi brjod dang grags pa rgya chen po/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi zhing mang brgyar yang mchis/ /rgyal ba khyod kyi bsngags ⑨pa'i phreng ba ni/ /bde bar gshegs rnams 'khor du rtag par sgogs—/ /rims nad bral zhing 'gro ba thar mdzad pa/ /mthong na dga' ba thugs rje mchog ldan pa/ /bcom ldan dbang po zhi ba zhi dges ⑦pa/ /mi mchog dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis ⑤rgyal ba khyod kyi gsung thos nas—/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob mkha' la gnas/ /dpa' bo bde gshegs mtshungs par bdag gyur ⑨te/ /dri med chos ni 'gro la rnam par dbye/ /lha dang mi dang klus ⑫mchod bde bar gshegs/ /yon tan kun gyi mthar phyin 64—1424

deng ①bstod pas/ /bsod nams rgya chen gang bsgrubs ④gyur pa 'dis/ /'gro ba sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /ces bya'o/ /yang na chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las gsungs pa ste/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po mnga' ba byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po'i spyod yul can/ sems can gyi phung po chen po'i skyabs su gyur pa/ mgon du gyur pa/ sman pa chen po zug ①rngu 'byin pa/sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa/ rtag tu ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul ba/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las ④'das pa las rnam par grol ba nas/sems can thams cad kyi pha ma lta bur gyur pa dgra zin la sems snyoms pa'i bar du'o—/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon rjopa/'jig rten thams cad kyi snang bar gyur pa/ rnal 'byor chen po la rnal 'byor pa—/ bsam gtan chen po'i rjospyod yul ba/ rnam par grol ba phun sum tshogs pa/ bdag nyid chen po⑦/ /skye bo chen po'i zham 'bring ba dang ldan pa/skye bo khyad par can gyi zham 'bring ba dang ldan pa/ lta ba dang nyan pa dang brten pa dang bsnyen bkur byed pa mi zlogs ldupa/ bdag bde ba la mi lta ba/gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa la dgyes pa/ chos la gzhol ba/ chos kyi nor can/ chos kyi zas ⑨can/ chos kyi sman can/ chos kyi gter chen⑩/chos kyi dbang phyug /chos kyi bdag po/ chos kyi sbyin bdag /rtag tu gtong ba la mngon par dgyes pa/ rtag tu bag yod pa/ rtag tu dbe+en pa la mngon par dgyes pa/ thams cad du stegs dang zam par gyur pa/ rgyal po'i lam chen po dang 'dra ba/ nyi ma chen po dang 'dra ba/ tshangs pa chen po 64—1425

dang 'dra ba/ ye shes chen po'i rdo rje 'chang ba/ chos chen pos dbugs 'byin pa/ gzugs lta ①bas mi ngoms pa mthong bas mi ngoms pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag de ltar rjes su dran no/ /de dag de ltar rjes su dran pas de dag gi yon tan yongs su sgrub pa'i phyir sbyor ro/ /dran pa nye bar 'jog go/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa zhes bya ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa ①dran pa nye bar gzhag pa zhes bya'o/ /'di nyid las chos rjes su dran pa gsungs pa/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ni yon tan mtha' yas mu med pa ste/ de dag ①ni chos las skyes pa/ chos kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/ chos kyis ④sprul pa/ chos ⑤ bdag por gyur pa/ chos las byung ba/ chos kyi spyod yul/ chos la brten bupa/ chos kyis ④grub pa ste/gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po de dag kyang / chos las skyes pa/ chos las rnyed pa chos kyis ⑧grub pa'o/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi po de dag kyang chos las skyes pa chos las rnyed pa chos kyis ⑨grub pa'o—/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad po de dag kyang chos las skyes pa chos las rnyed pa chos kyis ⑩grub pa'o/ /gang 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba'i yo byad de dag kyang chos las skyes pa chos las rnyed pa chos kyis ⑪grub pa'o/ /de bas na bdag ⑫sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tshol bas chos gtso bor bya'o/ /chos spyod yul ba dang /64—1426

chos la brten ①pa dang / chos la gzhol ba dang / chos snying por byed pa dang /chos ②rjes su mthun pa'i chos bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos rjes su dran pa dran pa nye bar gzhag pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ chos ni sems can thams cad la mnyam par 'jug pas chos ni tha ma dang 'bring dang rab mthong nas 'jug pa ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni phyogs su ma lhung bas chos ni ngor lta ①zhing 'jug pa ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni dus chad pa med pa/'di mthong ba la don yod pa rang gi ④rig pas chos ni dus la lta zhing 'jug pa ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni mthon rjodaman med pas chos ni rgya che ba la 'jug pa ma yin dman pa la 'jug pa ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang mthun pa'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni mchog dang tha ma dang bral bas chos ni rnam par dag pa la yang 'jug pa pya ma yin nyams pa la 'jug pa yang ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni zhing dang zhing ma yin pa'i lta ba dang bral bas chos ni 'phags pa la 'jug pa yang ma yin so so'i skye bo la 'jug pa yang ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'jug pas chos ni nyin mo 'jug pa ma yin mtshan mo 'jug pa ma yin/ mtshan mo 'jug la nyin mo mi 'jug pa ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni gang la yang nam yang sdod pa ma yin pas chos ni 'dul ba'i dus las kyang mi 'da' ste/ de 64—1427

ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni thams cad du 'dod pa med pas chos ni sdang ba rnams la zhe 'gras pa yang med dad pa rnams la rjes su chags pa yang med de/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni dz+re ba yang ma yin gang ba yang ma yin te dpag tu med grangs med pas nam mkha' ltar 'bri ba yang ma yin 'phel ba yang ma yin te/de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni sems can rnams kyis srung ①ba ma yin gyi chos kyis sems can rnams srung ba sdeste/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni skyabs yongs su tshol ba ma yin pas chos ni 'jig rten thams cad kyi skyabs yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni thogs pa med pa'i mtshan nyid pas chos ni gang la yang thogs pa med de/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni bag la nyal med pas bag la nyal mi 'jug ste/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o/ /chos ni rtag tu rnam par mi rtog pas chos ni 'khor bas 'jigs skrag pa yang ma yin mya ngan las 'das pa la rjes su chags pa yang ma yin te/ de ltar bdag gis kyang chos dang 'dra ba'i sems su bya'o snyam mo/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos ltar dran pa nye bar 'jog pas de'i phyir chos rjes su dran pa zhes bya ste/rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' chos rjes su dran pa ①dran pa nye bar gzhag pa zhes bya'o zhes so/ /yang dhide nyid las gsungs pa/ dge 'dun ni chos smra ba/ chos spyod pa/ chos sems pa/ chos kyi zhing / chos 'dzin pa/chos la ston ⑤pa/ chos la mchod pa/ chos kyi bya ba byed pa/ chos kyi buspyod 64—1428

yul ba/ chos spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ rang bzhin gyis ①drang ba/ rang bzhin kyis ②dag pa/ snying rje'i chos can/ snying rje dang ldan pa/ rtag tu dben pa'i spyod yul ba/ rtag tu chos la gzhol ba/ rtag tu dkar po spyod pa'o snyam mo zhes bya ba 3la sogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rjes su dran pa ni 'di lta bu yin te/dge 'dun gyi yon tan yang dag pa gang yin pa de dag bdag gis④/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la bsgrub ⑤par bya'o snyam pa ste/ 'phags pa dri ma med par grags pas bstan bupa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan ji skad du 'byung ba de lta bur dge 'dun rjes su dran pa bsgom par bya'o/ /sems can kun gyi gzugs dang ni/ /skad dang dbyangs su gang brjod pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyis/ /skad cig gcig la ston par byed/ /sgyu ma'i chos kyis ⑦rnam rtsen pa/ /de dag sems can smin bya'i phyir/ /rga ba dang ni na bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid shi bar rab tu ston/ /sa rnams kun du getshig par ni/ /bskal pas bsreg par kun ston te/ /sems can rtag par 'du shes pa/ /mi rtag par ni rab bstan to/ /sems can bye ba stong rnams kyang / /yul gcig tu ni mgron du gnyer/ /thams cad khyem du zan byin te/ /thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /sngags dang rig stipa ci yod dang / /bzo ⑫gnas rnam pa mang po dag /thams cad kyi yang pha rol phyin/ /sems can thams cad bde thob byed/ /'jig rten ya mtshan ji snyed pa/ /de dag kun du rab byung nas/ /lta ba tha dad gyur pa yi/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su 'grol⑪—/ /zla ba'am nyi mar de gyur te⑫/ /brgya byen tshangs pa skye dgu'i 64—1429

bdag① /chu dang me yang rab 'gyur te/ /sa dang rlung du'ang de bzhin no/ /nad kyi bskal pa bar ma la/ /de ni rtsi mchog dam par 'gyur/ /des ni sems can rnam grol zhing / /nad rnams med cing bde bar 'gyur/ /mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma la/ /zas dang skom du bsgyur nas su/ /bkres shing skom pa med byas te/ /srog chags rnams la chos ston to/ /mtshon gyi bskal pa bar ma la/ /de dag byams pa bsgom 'gyur ④te/ /sems can bye ba brgya mang po/ /gnod sems med la 'dzud par byed/ /g.yul chen 'dres pa'i nang du ni/ /de dag phyogs la ④mnyam par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' stobs chen rnams—/ /'dum zhing 'du bar dga' bar byed/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ji snyed pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dmyal bar yang / /sems can rnams la phan bya'i phyir/ /bsams rjobazhin du ni der 'gro'o/ /ji snyed dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi/ /'gro ba'i bar du rjobastan pa ni/ /thams cad du yang chos ston te//de'i pya phyir rnam par 'dren ces bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams kyang ston/ /bsam gtan pa la bsam gtan ston/ /bdud rnams rab tu 'joms byed cing //de dag glags su 'gyur mi byed/ /me dbus na ni pad ma ltar/ /byung ma stsong ba de ston te/ /de bzhin 'dod dang bsam gtan yang / /byung ma stsong ba de ston to/ /bsams bzhin smad 'tshong rnams su sgyur/ /skyes pa rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /'dod chags lcags kyus drongs ⑦nas su/ /de dag sangs rgyas ye shes 'god/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /grong mi dang ni ded dpon dang / /mdun na 'don dang blon po dang / /blon po chen por rtag tu 'gyur—/ /sems can dbul po rnams la ni/ /zad mi shes pa'i gter du 64—1430

gyur—/ /gang la sbyin pa byin pa yang / /de dag byang chub sems bskyed btsudag/nga rgyal khengs pa'i sems can la/ /de dag tshan ②chen mchog gyur te/ /nga rgyal kun kyang bcom nas su/ /bla med byang chub tshol du btsud/ /'jigs skrag sems can rnams la ni/ /rtag tu de yi mdun na 'dug /de dag mi 'jigs byin nas kyang / /byang chub tu ni smin par byed/ /de dag lnga mngon ①shes pa yi/ /drang srong tshangs par spyod gyur te/ /bzod dang nges dang tshul khrims dang / /sdom pa la ni sems can 'god/ /rim gro lhur byed sems can rnams/ /'jigs rjopa med pas 'dir mthong nas/ /bran dang g.yog tu shin tu 'gyur/ /slob mar yang ni nye bar 'gro/ /yan lag gang dang ④gang rnams kyis/ /sems can chos la dgar gyur pa/ /thabs chen shin tu bslabs pa dag /bya ba dag ni thams cad ston/ /de dag slob ma bumatha' yas shing / /spyod yul rnams kyang mtha' yas te/ /ye shes mtha' yas rdzogs pas na/ /srog chags mtha' yas grol bar byed/ /⑦bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyar ni/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / /de yi yon tan mtha' brjod dka'—/ /zhes bya ba'o④// //bam po bcu bzhi pa ste tha ma⑨/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rnams ni—/ dkon mchog ta la tu)la'i gzungs las ji skad gsungs pa de ltar 4mebasgom par bya ste⑫/ me tog phal cher me tog bla re dang / /me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /me tog sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /bdug pa phal cher bdug pa'i bla re dang / /bdug pa bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /bdug pa sna tshogs 64—1431

kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /phal cher spos dang spos kyi bla re dang / /spos kyi bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /sna tshogs spos rnams kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /phreng ba phal cher phreng ba'i bla re dang / /phreng ba bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /phreng ba sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /phye ma phal cher phye ma'i bla re dang / /phye ma bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /phye ma sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /na bza' phal cher na bza'i bla re dang / /na bza' bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /na bza' sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /phal cher gdugs dang gdugs kyi bla re dang / /gdugs kyi bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /sna tshogs gdugs rnams kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /rin chen phal cher rin chen bla re dang / /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /rin chen sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /pad ma phal cher pad+ma'i bla re dang / /pad ma bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /pad ma sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /rgyan phreng phal cher rgyan phreng bla re dang / /rgyan phreng bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /rgyan phreng sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /rgyal mtshan mchog bkod 'od zer rab bkye zhing / /de dag rgyal mtshan dkar dmar ser po dang / /sngo dang rgyal mtshan bkod pa sna 64—1432

tshogs pa/ /du mas rgyal ba'i zhing rnams brgyan ①par byed/ /nor bu'i dra ba sna tshogs bkod pa'i gdugs/ /dar gyi lda ldi ba dan rab dpyangs ④shing / /dril g.yer dra ba rgyal ba'i gsung sgogs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi dbu la de dag 'dzin/ /lag pa'i mthil nas mchod pa bsam byas blu rnams/ /rgyal ba gcig la mchod pa byed pa ltar/ /rgyal ba ma lus kun la'ang de bzhin te/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag 'gro ba sdud pa'i ye shes kyis—/ /rnam par 'phrul dang ting 'dzin mchog bsgrubs shing / /bya ba dag dang bsnyen bkur kun gyi sgo④/ /thabs stong dag gis sems can 'dul bar byed—/ /kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa mchod sgo dang / /sbyin pa bsam kyis mi khyab gtong sgo dang / /sbyangs pa'i yon tan tshul khrims srung ⑤sgo dang / /bzod pa mi zad mi 'khrugs 0sgo dag dang / /kha cig brtul zhugs dka' thub brtson sgo dang / /bsam gtan rab tu zhi bar gzhan sgo dang / /don la rnam nges shes rab sgo rnams dang / /spyod pa kun ldan thabs kyi sgo dag dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas pa dag dang mngon shes sgo/ /bsdu ba'i dngos pos phan par 'dod sgo dang / /bsod nams bsags dang ye shes sgo dag dang / /bden dang rten dang rnam thar sgo dag dang / /kha cig stobs dang dbang po lam sgo dang / /nyan thos theg pas rnam par grol sgo dang / /rkyen gyi theg pas rnam par dag sgo dang / /theg pa mchog gi rnam par 'phrul sgo dang / /kha cig mi rtag nyid dang sdug bsngal sgo/ /kha cig bdag med srog med sgo dag dang / /mi sdug 'du shes 'dod chags bral sgo dang / /zhi 'gog ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo yis 'dul/ /'gro ba spyod pa'i sgo rnams ji snyed pa/ /de snyed chos kyi sgo la 64—1433

rab zhugs te/ /de dag kun du rnam thar sgo dag nas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul/ /gang dag kun du rnam thar sgo dag nas/ /bsams ⑫bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul byed pa/ /de dag sus kyang mtshan mar gzung mi nus/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa de 'dra'o/ /de dag dga' ba bkod pa ④ting 'dzin mchog /'gro ba thams cad yongs smin ①mthun byed pa/ /dga' bde spro ba rab dga' kun ldan rnams/ /bsams shing bstan zhing dhisems can 'dul bar byed/ /gang du lo nyes 'jig rten yo byad gang / /bde byed thams cad rab tu dkon gyur pa/ /der ni kun gyi bsams spubazhin bya ba yis/ /sbyin pa sbyin zhing 'gro ba'i don rnams byed/ /de dag zas skom mchog dang ro mchog dang / /gos dang bgo ba rin chen sna tshogs dang / /rgyal srid nor dang bdag phangs yongs gtong bas/ /sbyin la mos pa'i 'gro ba 'dul bar byed/ /brten ⑥pa de dag mtshan mchog ⑦lus spras shing / /gos dang rgyan mchog bgos shing brgyan byas te/ /phreng bas brgyan cing spos kyis skebasgus pa yis⑨/ /gzugs rnams bstan pas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /mthong na dga' tshim rab tu dga' rnams la/ /blo mchog de dag mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /gzugs kyi dam pa yongs su ston byed cing / /gzugs la mos pa'i sems can 'dul bar byed/ /de dag ka la ping ka'i sgra snyan dang / /khu byug kun la ngang pa'i sgra skad dang / /rnga dang tshangs dang mi 'am ci yi sgras/ /mos pa kun la de bzhin chos kyang ston/ /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gang yin pas/ /rgyal ba gang dag 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi bye brag sgo mo de dag gis/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig 64—1434

rten sems can 'dul/ /de dag bde dang sdug bsngal grogs kyang byed/ /don dang gnod pa'i grogs kyang de bzhin byed/ /bya ba kun la grogs su 'gyur byas shing / /grogs kyi sgo nas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /sdug bsngal gnod pa 'dus byas skyon rnams la/ /grogs kyi don du de dag bzod byed cing / /'gro ba kun la phan don bde don du/ /de dag grogs don gnod pa dang du len/ /gang na sngon byung med cing chos med de/ /dgon par 'gro dang thar pa mi dmigs pa/ /der ni rgyal srid 'byor pa rab spangs te/ /zhi ba'i yid kyis gnas med mngon par 'byung / /de dag khyem dang 'ching dang bsreg ①pa'i gnas/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su dgrol ba'i rgyur/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba kun la mi gnas par/ /mngon par byung zhing thar pa rab tu brjod—/ /de dag spyod pa bcu rnams rjod byed cing / /skyes chen rnams kyi chos spyod gang yin dang / /drang srong rnams kyi spyod yul bu ma lus par/ /yongs su brjod cing 'gro ba'i don rnams byed/ /gang na sems can dpag med tshe ldan zhing / /bde dang ldan la nyon mongs chud yod pa/ /der ni rga bas nyen cing nad bu can/ /bdag la dbang med 'chi ba'i dbang gyur ston//'dod chags 'bar zhing zhe sdang rab 'bar la/ /'jig rten gti mug me chen rab 'bar zhing / /rga dang na dang 'chi ba rab 'bar ba'i/ /'jig rten bstan gnas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /de dag sangs rgyas stobs bcu brtson bzhi dang / /chos kyi khyad par bco brgyad rnams kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas che ba'i bdag nyid rjod byed cing / /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams kyis 'gro don byed/ /de dag kun brjod rdzu 'phrul rjes bstan pas/ /gzugs kyi byin 64—1435

rlabs nyustobs kyis thams cad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston byed cing / /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pas sems can 'dul/ /de dag thabs tshul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'jig rten rgyu zhing 'gro ba'i don rnams byed/ /'jig rten mi chags chu la pad ma bzhin/ /dga' zhing dad par byed la rnam par rgyu/ /de dag snyan dngags mkhan rgyal snyan dngags sbyor/ /gar mkhan rnga mkhan gyad dang rol mo mkhan/ /bzhugs mdzes rgyan phreng thogs shing gar byed dang / /sgyu ma mkhan po gzugs mang kun du ston/ /grong pa grong dpon kha lo sgyur 3bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin ded dpon tshong dpon khyim bdag 'gyur/ /rgyal po blon po mdun 'don pho nya dang / /sman pa 'jigs med bstan bcos cho ga mkhan/ /de dag dgon par ljon shing chen por 'gyur/ /sman dang rin chen mi zad gter rnams dang / /yid bzhin nor bu 'dod sbyin sdong po dang / /lam gol dong ba rnams la lam ston 'gyur/ /'jig rten byung nas mi ring shes gyur cig /sems can lam gyi getshul rnams mi shes pa/ /de dag kun la rmongs chos tshong thabs dang / /sna tshogs bzo rnams 'jig rten rjod par byed/ /'tshe med gnod sems bh+yamed pa'i sbyor ba gang / /sems can bde byed mkhas pas rab bsngags pa/ /rig stobs sman dang bstan bcos sna tshogs kun/ /drang srong de dag rnams kyis rab tu brjod/ /gang la lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs phya'agyur ba/ /drang srong spyod mchog dam pa gang yin dang / /brtul zhugs dka' spyad dka' thub spyod kun kyang / /mkhas pas de dag rnams kyis rab tu brjod/ /de dag spyod can kun rgyu mu stegs can/ /gdung ba go ④ta ma dang mi smrar spyod/ /gcer bu gos med lhur len dge sbyong la/ /mu stegs 64—1436

can gye slob dpon mkhas par ston/ /de dag kun du 'tsho ba'i chos 'dzin dang //bla na yod dang bla na med rnams dang / /ral pa ring dang gzhon nu'i brtul zhugs can/ /de dag tu yang slob dpon 'gyur ba yin/ /nyi ma'i rjes lta dka' thub lnga ldan dang / /khyi dang ba lang brtul zhugs ri dwags spyod/ /gle'u can dang mu stegs sum cu pa/ /de dag tu yang de dag slob dpon 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i shes la 'jug par khyedaga' rnams dang / /mu stegs nye reg yul du rgyu rnams su/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu chu spyod ②gyur nas kyang / /bsam yas chos la de dag dam pa mchog /tsog pur 'dug dang gcig pur rgyu ba dang / /tsher ma rtswa dang thal bar nyal ba dang / /gang dag gtun shing mal can gnas pa dang //de dag tu yang de dag slob dpon 'gyur/ /phyi rol mu stegs can rnams ji snyed pa—/ /de dag bsam pa mos pa rtogs byas shing / /bsnyen dka' mi bzad drag shul dka' thub kyis/ /mu stegs can gyi sdug bsngal spang bar 'dul/ /'jig rten lta bas 'khrug bhupa shes byas nas/ /lta ba ngan la gnas pa'i mu stegs can/ /kun la phra ba'i gzhi dang thabs tshul gyis④/ /de dag rnams la bden pa ston par byed/ /la lar 'gro lding ba yi sngags kyi gzhi/ /shin tu gsang ba'i gzhi yis bden pa ston/ /la la dag la gsal zhing drang tshig gis//la la dag la lha yi gsang tshig (snyegis/ /la la dag la yi ge dbye tshig dang / /don la rnam nges rdo rje'i tshig ⑥rnams dang / /rgol ba 'dul bar shes pa'i tshig rnams dang / /bstan bcos thub med thar pa'i tshig ⑦rnams kyis/ /la la dag la mi skad tshig rnams dang / /kun la 'jug pa nges spritshig rnams kyis su ⑨//la la dag la lha yi ⑫nges tshig dang / /klu yi nges tshig gnod sbyin nges tshig gis//64—1437

la lar srin po 'byung po sha za dang / /dri za grul bum lto 'phye che ①tshig dang / /mi ci lha min mkha' lding tshig rnams kyis/ /bden pa bstan cing thar par 'dren par byed/ /de dag bden dang nges tshig tshul shes te/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /chos nyid bsam byas tshig lam shes par ston/ /de dag ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ /de dag 'gro bde mchog gi ting nge 'dzin—/ /'gro ba kun la mngon par sgrub byed cing / /'od zer bsam kyis mi khyab rab bkye ④ste/ /'od zer bkye nas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /mthong na legs pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer de shes pa/ /de dag mthong legs don med ma yin te/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes mchog gi rgyu/ /mi rnams kun la sangs rgyas yongs bstan dang 1 / /chos kyang yongs su bstan de lam bstan cing / /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs mchod rten bstan byas pas/ /des na mthong legs 'od zer grub par 'gyur/ /lha yi 'od zer zil gyis gnon pa yi④ / /'od zer 'od byed ces bya rab gtong zhing //rdul dang mun pa thams cad bsal byas te/ /'jig rten phan pa'i 'od de rab tu snang / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /de dag rgyal ba mchod phyir sgon ma 'dzin/ /de dag rgyal ba mchod phyir sgron bzung khrubs/ /'jig rten sgon ma mdzad pa'i rgyal bar gyura'u/ /'bru mar mar me mar gyi mar me dang / /rtswa shing 'dam bu 'od ma'i sgon ma dang / /spos dang bcud len rin chen sgon ma dgakhye /rgyal ba rnams la phul nas 'od byed thob/ /sgol zhes bya ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas la/ /de dag sred spangs sred pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can sgol ba'i 64byed1438

don du go cha gyon/ /gang dag sred spangs sred pa'i rgya mtsho las sems can sgol ba'i don du go gyon pa/ /de dag chu bo bzhi las rab tu sgol/ /mya ngan med pa'i bde ba'i grong khyer ston/ /stegs dang zam pa du ma byas pa dang //chu klung lam la sgol ba'i gru byin te/ /'dus byas sun phyung zhi ba bsngags byas pas—/ /des na sgol ba'i 'od zer grub par 'gyur①/ /skom pa sel ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan skom pa rab spangs shing / /chos la mos pa'i ro ni don du gnyer—/ /'dod pa'i yon tan skom pa rab spangs te/ /chos mos ro la don du gnyer gyur pas/ /bdud rtsi ①char pa 'be+ebs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'jig rten skom pa'i sred pa rnam par sel④/ /rdzing dang khron pa chu klung chu rdo dang / /mtsho rnams byang chub don du byed btsud de/ /'dod pa smad cing bsam gtan bsngags byas pas/ /des na skom pa sel ba grub par 'gyur/ /dga' bar byed pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /dga' bas rgyas shing byang chub mchog don du/ /rab 'byung 'gyur bar bya zhes sems bskyed do/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i sku gzugs mtshan brgyan pa/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa rnams byas shing / /rtag tu sangs rgyas yon tan rnams brjod pa/ /des na dga' byed 'od zer grub par 'gyur—/ /mgu bar byed pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od ④des bskul byas pa/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas la ni dga' mgu zhing / /chos la dga' mgu dge 'dun dga' mgu'o/ /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas dga' mgu zhing / /chos la dga' mgu dge 'dun dga' mgu nas/ /sangs 64—1439

rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /rtag tu 'grogs thob bzod pa bla med 'thob/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /sems can mang po bskul zhing dran byas te/ /byang chub sems kyi yon tan rab brjod pas—/ /des na mgu byed 'od zer grub par 'gyur/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa//bla na med pa'i byang chub don gnyer zhing / /sbyin pa sna tshogs du ma sbyin par byed—/ /gtan pa med pa'i mchod pa hu de byed tshe/ /slong ba rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs byed de/ /bsam pa thams cad sbyin pa byin byas pas/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i 'od zer grub par gyur/ /ye shes ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /chos gcig sgo mo nas ni du ma yi/ /chos kyi sgo rnams yud kyis ④khong du chud/ /chos kyi dbye ba sems can 'dzin btsud de/ /don la nges pa'i ye shes rnams ①phye zhing / /chos kyi tshig don brjod pa byas pas rgyan/ /des na ye shes ldan pa'i 'od zer 'grub / /shes rab sgron ma'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /stong pa bdag med ma skyes ma byung zhing / /rang bzhin med pa'i chos la rab tu 'jug /bdag po med chos stong pa byed med pa/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla mtshungs 'dra zhing / /rmi lam mtshungs la gzugs brnyan 'dra ba dag /ston shepas shes rab sgon ma de grub po/ /chos kyi rnam 'phrul 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /mi zad mdzod kyi phyogazungs ni thob gyur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mdzod kyang 'dzin/ /chos 'dzin rnams la yongs su phan 64byed1440

btags te/ /drang srong rnams la chos kyis bsrung byas shing / /'gro ba chos kyi rjes su gzung byas pas/ /chos kyi rnam 'phrul 'od zer grub par 'gyur ①/ /gtong dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can 'jungs pa gang dag des bskul bakhya/ /longs spyod mi rtag ①mi brtan shes gyur nas/ /de dag rtag tu gtong la dga' mos 'gyur/ /ma dul gdul dka'i sems can ser sna can/ /nor rnams rmi lam sprin dang 'drar ④shes nas/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis sbyin pa spel byas pas/ /des na gtong dang ldan pa'i 'od grub po/ /yongs su gdung med 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /khrims 'chal sems can gang dag des bskul ba/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag la gnas gyur nas/ /rang 'byung du'agyur bar bya zhes sems bskyed do/ /dge ba'i las lam yongs su dag pa dang / /tshul khrims la yang sems can mang 'dzud cing / /byang chub sems kyang yang dag 'dzin bcug pas/ /yongs gdung med pa'i 'od zer de grub po/ /bzod pa bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /mi bzod sems can gang dag des bskul ba/ /khro dang tha ba nga rgyal yongs spongs shing / /de ni rtag tu bzod mos dga' bar 'gyur/ /sdig ldan rnams kyis nyes byas bzod byas te/ /byang chub don du 'khrug pa ma byas shing / /bzod pa'i yon tan rtag tu bsngags brjod pas/ /des na bzod pa bkod pa de khyegrub po/ /brtun dang ④ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /le lo'i sems can gang dag des bskul ba/ /rigs par brtson pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la/ /sbyor ba skyo ④med mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /rigs par brtson pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la/ /sbyor ba skyo ba med pas mchod byas nas/ /de dag 64—1441

bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das te/ /byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur—/ /sems can mang po brtson 'grus 'dzin bcug ste/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa rab byas nas/ /zad pa'i dus na dam chos yongs bzung bas—/ /des na brtun par ldan pa'i 'od thob ①bo/ /zhi bar byed pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /rnam 'khrug ⑨sems can ji snyed des bskul ba/ /de dag chags dang sdang dang 1rmongs med cing / /rtogs par gyur nas mnyam gzhag sems su 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i grogs po skyon ldan spyod ducan dang / /'dre ba yongs su rnam par spangs byas te/ /dgon par rab zhi bsam gtan rab brjod pas/ /des na zhi bar byed pa'i 'od grub po/ /shes rab bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /shes 'chal sems can ji snyed des bskul ba//bden dang rten dang rnam thar tshul rnams dang / /dbang po shes pa rtogs par khong chud cing dze+e/ /nyi ma'i sgon ⑥ma'i ting 'dzin thob gyur nas/ /shes rab snang bar mdzad pa'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rgyal srid nor dang bdag phangs yongs btang ste/ /byang chub don du chos gang btsal byas pa/ /chos de gus par byas nas rab bshad pas/ /shes rab bkod pa'i 'od zer de grub po/ /sangs rgyas ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag du ma bsam yas rnams/ /pad+ma dam pa rnams la bzhugs par mthong / /sangs rgyas che dang sangs rgyas rnam thar dang / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul mtha' yas brjod byas shing / /sangs rgyas stobs dang rdzu 'phrul rab brjod pas/ /des na sangs rgyas ldan pa'i 'od grub po / /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jigs nyen ⑦64—1442

sems can gang la des reg pa/ /'byung po gza' dhidang gsad brdeg bcing ba dang / /nad 'go 'jigs pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pas sems can bskyab pa ⑤dang / /srog chags gsod las bzlog par byas pa dang / /'jigs pa skyabs tshol rnams la skyabs byas pas/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i 'od zer de grub po/ /bde ba kun byed 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /nad pa na ba gang dag des reg pa/ /rnam pa kun du nad kyi sdug bsngal thar/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde ba rnams kyang 'thob/ /nad gsos 'bras bu sman dang rtsa ba dang / /rin chen bcud len spos dang byug pa dang / /bu ram sbrang rtsi 'o ma mar dag dang / /'bru mar zas skom byin pas ④de thob po/ /sangs rgyas ston pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /tshe zad tha mar gang dag des bskul ba—/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /de dag shi 'phos sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'gro/ /'chi ba'i dus su sangs rgyas dran byas te//dga' byed rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bstan byas shing / /'chi kar sangs rgyas skyabs su gtang ④brjod pas/ /sangs rgyas ston pa'i 'od zer de thob po/ /chos rab brjod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /chos nyan klog cing yi ger 'dri bar byed/ /de dag rtag tu chos la dga' mos 'gyur/ /chos kyi mu ge byung tshe chos brjod de/ /chos tshol rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs byas shing / /'dun pa bskyed de chos la brtson gyis zhes/ /brjod pas chos rab brjod pa de thob po/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams yongs su bskul ba'i phyir/ /dbyangs dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jig rten gsum na sgra rgyun ji snyed pa/ /kun kyang de bzhin 64byed1443

gshegs pa'i gsung du thos/ /gsang bstod sgra yis ①drang srong che bstod de/ /rgyal ba'i gsung sgra don du sel snyan dang / /sgra chen dril bu sbyin rnams 'gro kun la/ /rab tu bsngags pas dbyangs ldan 'od grub po/ /'chi med sbyin pa'i 'od zer rab gtong ⑤zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa—/ /bag med spyod pa thams cad rab spangs te/ /yon tan kun la brtson pa nyams su len/ /'dus byas rtag tu bde ba med pa ste/ /sdug bsngal 'tshe ba du mas yongs su gang / /'gog pa rtag tu bde zhing zhi spyod ces/ /brjod pas 'chi med sbyin pa de thob po/ /khyad par ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing //sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi tshul khrims khyad par dang / /ting 'dzin khyad par shes rab khyad par thob/ /thub chen rgyal po khrims kyi 1mchog gyur cing / /ting 'dzin mchog dang shes rab mchog gyur ces/ /byang chub don du bstod cing bsngags brjod pas/ /des na khyad par ldan pa'i 'od grub po/ /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /rin chen mi zad gter rnams thob gyur nas/ /drang srong che la rin chen dam pas mchod/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten rin chen phul/ /skye bo nyon mongs rin chen rnams kyis bsdus//rgyal ba rnams la rin chen rab phul bas/ /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer grub par gyurabya/ /spos rab snang ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pas/ /mi la med spos yid 'ong tshor gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams la nges par 'gyur/ /mi dang lha yi spos dang byug pa yis—/ /mi yi gtso la mchod pa rab byas te/ /spos las rgyal ba'i gzugs 64—1444

dang mchod rten dag /byas pas spos rab snang ba de grub po/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs mchog sna tshogs dang / /sel snyan bsgrags shing spos kyi bdug pa yis/ /pho brang dam pa mdzes byas me tog bkram/ /sel snyan ngag gis rgyal ba rnams bsu zhing / /me tog bdug pa bdug spos phye ma dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs mchog rnams kyis mchod/ /des na sna tshogs bkod pa grub par gyur/ /shin tu dang byed 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sa rnams lag mthil bzhin du gnas par byed—/ /mchod rten drang srong gnas rnams sbyang byas pas/ /des na shin tu dang byed 'od grub po/ /sprin dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /spos kyi char 'be+ebs sprin rnams kun du gnas/ /mchod rten 'khor sar spos kyi ①chus btab pas/ /sprin dang ldan pa'i 'od de rab tu 'thob/ /lhab lhub bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /gcer bu gos gyon rgyan dang ldan par 'gyur—/ /gos dang bgo ba rgyan phreng sna tshogs dag /sbyin pa byas pas lhab lhub bkod pa grub/ /ro mchog ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /bkres pa kha zas ro mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zas dang skom dang ro mchog sna tshogs rnams—/ /byin pas ro mchog ldan pa'i 'od grub po/ /nor rnams ston pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dbul po dag gis rin chen gter rnams 'thob /dkon mchog gsum la gter gzhi mi zad pa/ /dbul ba byas pas nor ston 'od thob po/ /mig rnams ①sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /de tshe long bas sna tshogs gzugs rnams mthong / /rgyal ba dag dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la—/ /mar me phul bas mig sbyong 'od zer grub/ /rna ba rnam sbyong 'od zer 64byed1445

rab gtong zhing / /rna ba nyams pas sgra mang thos par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /sel snyan phul bas rna ①sbyong 'od grub po//sna rnams ②sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sngon chad ma tshor dri zhim tshor bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /spos rab phul bas sna sbyong 'od zer grub/ /lce rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sgra snyan yid 'ong rnams kyis ④sangs rgyas bstod/ /mi snyan bslang ④bar smra ba rnams chaspongs te/ /'jam par smras pas ṭulce spyong 'od zer grub/ /lus rnams ④sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dbang po nyams pa dbang po ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /lus btud sgebyas pas lus rnams ḍū/ sbyong ba thob/ /sems rnams ⑩sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /smyos ⑪pa thams cad sems dang ldan par 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin dbang rjes sems 'gro byas pas na/ /sems rnams sbyong ba'i ⑫'od zer de grub po/ /gzugs rnams ⑫sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /mi dbang rnams kyi bsam yas sgu mthong ste/ /sku gzugs ri mo sna tshogs mang po dang / /mchod rten brgyan byas ⑪ gzugs spyong 'od grub po/ /sgra rnams sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sgra ni sgra min stong par rab tu shes/ /rkyen las ⑩byung bas brag ca 'dra'o zhes/ /sgra rnams bstan pas 'od zer de grub po//dri rnams ⑩sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dri nga thams cad dri zhim mchog tu 'gyur/ /spos rab mchog chus rgyal ba'i mchod rten dag /khrus byas byang chub zhing gi 'od de yin/ /ro bro sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing //dug can dug med ro'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyan thos bcas dang pha 64byed1446

ma la/ /ro mchog thams cad phul ba'i 'od de yin/ /reg rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /reg na rtsub pa 'jam zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /mdung thung rtse gsum ral gri mda' chen char/ /phreng ba 'jam pa pad+ma gcal 'gyur—/ /bcos bu'i ras mang 'jam zhing reg bde rnams/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gshegs shul bting bkram ste/ /me tog byug pa na bza' 'jam rnams dang //phreng ba bla re phul ba'i 'od de yis/ /chos rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jig rten phan mdzad rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /spu rnams kun nas chos rnams bsam mi khyab/ /byung ba thos nas mos pa thams cad tshim/ /rkyen las byung bas ma skyes ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku ni chos sku ste/ /chos nyid nam ①mkha' bzhin du ②gnas so zhes/ /brjod pas chos rnam 1sbyong ba thob par 'gyur/ /'od zer sgo mo de dag la sogs pa/ /drang srong rnams kyi spu yi sgo gcig nas/ /'od zer gang gā'i ④ bye ma snyed 'byung ste/ /kun la sbyor ba ⑤tha dad tshul can no/ /ji ltar sku yi spu yi sgo gcig nas/ /'od zer gang gā'i bye ma snyed 'byung ba/ /ma lus spu rnams kun nas de bzhin te/ /drang srong nying 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o/ /yon tan gang gis gye'od zer gang 'grub pa'i/ /yon tan de grogs sngon chad gang gyur pa/ /de dag nyid las 'od zer rab 'byung ste/ /drang srong ye shes rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag bsod nams sngon grogs gang yin la/ /rjes su yi rang gsol ba sus btab dang / /gang gis mthong ste dge ba bsags gyur pa/ /de dag kun gyis khru'od zer de dag shes/ /gang dag bsod nams byas shing dge bsags dang / /gang dag yang yang sangs rgyas rnams mchod cing / /sangs rgyas yon 64—1447

tan 'dun te don gnyer ba/ /de dag kun la 'od zer de dag bskul/ /dper na dmus long nyi ma mi mthong yang / /de med ma yin 'jig rten kun du 'char—/ /mig dang ldan pas shar bar shes gyur nas/ /kun kyang rang rang so so'i las la 'jug /de bzhin skyes ① chen 'od zer de dag kun/ /rab tu byung yang log pas nyen gyur cing / /mos nyams phal pa rnams kyis mi mthong ste//blo gros yangs pa rnams la de dag moda.e/ /dper rgyan nor bu bzhon dupa gzhal med khang / /bcud kyis len dang rin chen byug pa spos/ /de dag skye bo che la yod mod kyi/ /phongs par gyur pa rnams la de dag med/ /de bzhin skyes chen 'od zer de dag kun/ /de dag yod kyang lo7/ pas nyen gyur cing / /mos pa nyams pa rnams kyis mi mthong ste/ /blo gros yangs pa rnams la de dag mod—/ /gang dag 'od zer dbye ba 'di thos nas/ /dad cing mos la dang ba skyes gyur nas/ /bdag ni yon tan che ④rgyur mi 'gyur zhes/ /de dag dogs a+yo dang som nyi mi bskyed do/ /de dag g.yog 'khor bkod pa rnam 'phrul pa/ /ting 'dzin dam pa mngon par grub byed cing / /phyogs bcu kun du do zla med rnams kyi/ /zham ring sangs rgyas sras rnams ston par byed/ /'od bkod de dag pad+ma sna tshogs pa/ /stong gsum tshad tsam byin gyis brlab pya byas nas/ /skyil krung bcas pa'i lus kyis kun khyab ste/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag zhing bcu'i rdul snyed pad+ma gzhan/ /'khor dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab ④ byas shing / /sangs rgyas sras kyis khru thams cad yongs su bskor—/ /de dag ting 'dzin ting 'dzin med par gnas/ /drang srong de yis sems can gang dag rnams/ /yongs su smin byas sangs rgyas legs 64—1448

bsgrubs pas/ /de dag pad+ma chen po de bskor zhing / /kun kyang thal mo sbyar nas lta zhing 'khod/ /gang dag ting 'dzin gnas par rab zhugs pa/ /skyes chen rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin te/ /rang gi ①slob mas kun kyang yongs bskor nas/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyis zla ba bskor ba bzhin/ /de dag ji ltar phyogs gcig ④rab 'jug cing / /zham 'bring ①sangs rgyas sras rnams ston byed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs ④rnams ma lus kun du ston/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag phyogs kyi dra ba khyab gnas pa'i/ /ting 'dzin dam pa mngon par sgrub byed cing / /kha cig mnyam gzhag kha cig ldan par ⑤yang / /phyogs rnams kun du rang gi lus ston to/ /de dag shar gyi phyogs su mnyam gzhag cing / /nub kyi phyogs su dudapa' bo rnam par ldang / /nub kyi phyogs su mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /bdag nyid chen po shar gyi phyogs nas ldang / /de bzhin phyogs bcu rnams su rab tu 'jug /gzhan kyi phyogs su mnyam par bzhag gyur la/ /ye shes yon tan phyug po gzhan nas ldang / /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o/ /shar phyogs sangs rgyas zhing rnams gang ④yin pa/ /grangs med ma lus dag na rang byung ba/ /de dag spyan sngar zhabs drung de dag rnams/ /zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rnam kyepar snang / /phyogs der mnyam par gzhag pa brtan byas nas/ /dpa' bo nub kyi zhing khams ⑨ma lus par/ /rnam par ldang zhing mngon sum rgyal kun la/ /mchod pa du ma rab tu byed par snang / /nub phyogs sangs rgyas zhing rnams gang yin pa/ /grangs med ma lus dag na bzhugs ④sangs rgyas/ /de dag spyan sngar zhabs drung de dag rnams/ /zhi ba'i ⑩ting nge 'dzin la gnas par snang / /64—1449

phyogs der mnyam par gzhag pa brtan byas nas/ /dpa' bo shar gyi zhing rnams ma lus par/ /rnam par ldang zhing mngon sum rgyal kun la/ /mchod pa du ma rab tu byed par snang / /de bzhin phyogs bcu dag gi zhing rnams su/ /phyogs rnams ma lus kun du brtan la 'jug /kha cig mnyam gzhag kha cig langs gyur cing / /'jig rten sgon ma rnams ①mchod byed par khyesnang / /de dag mig gi lam la mnyam gzhag cing / /gzugs kyi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gzugs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab ston pa na/ /de la lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs par 'gyur/ /gzugs kyi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur la//mi ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing //mig gi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag rna ba'i lam la mnyam gzhag cing / /sgra yi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang la lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs gyur pabya/ /sgra dang skad rnams lan ⑤la rab tu zhugs/ /sgra yi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /rna ba ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te—/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /rna ba'i lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag sna yi lam la mnyam gzhag cing / /dri yi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs gyur pa bu/ /dri mchog dam pa 'jug par rab tu zhugs/ /dri yi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /sna ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /sna yi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag lce yi lam la mnyam gzhag cing / /ro mchog kun gyi lam nas rnam par ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs gyur pa/ /bdag nyid chen po ro mchog 64—1450

rnam par ldang ①/ /ro mchog rnams la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /lce ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /lce yi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag lus kyi lam la mnyam gzhag cing / /reg pa'i lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs gyur pa/ /'jig rten bde ba bskyed pa'i reg la bzhugs/ /reg pa'i lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /lus ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /lus kyi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag sems kyi lam la mnyam gzhag cing / /chos kyi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs gyur pa—/ /chos la gnas pa'i 'jug par ②rab tu zhugs/ /chos kyi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /sems ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /ston pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /sems kyi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag byis pa'i lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /lang tsho shugs la gnas pa rnams las ldang / /lang tsho shugs gnas gyernams la mnyam gzhag cing / /rgas shing 'khogs pa'i lus las ④rnam par ldang / /rgas shing 'khogs pa'i lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen ma yi lus las ldang / /dge bsnyen dad pa'i lus la ⑤mnyam gzhag cing / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen lus las rnam par ldang / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen lus la du mnyam gzhag cing / /dge slong ma yi lus las rnam par ldang / /dge slong ma yi lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /dge slong mang du thos pa'i lus las ldang / /dge slong mang thos lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /slob dang mi slob lus las rnam par ldang //64—1451

slob dang mi slob lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /rkyen gyis sangs rgyas lus las rnam par ldang / /rkyen gyis sangs rgyas lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /sangs rgyas sku mchog rab las rnam par ldang / /sangs rgyas sku mchog rab la mnyam gzhag cing / /lha yi lus gzugs las ni rnam par ldang / /lha yi lus gzugs la ni mnyam gzhag cing / /rdzu 'phrul chen po klu yi lus las ldang / /rdzu 'phrul klu yi lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /rdzu 'phrul ①gnod sbyin lus las rnam par ④ldang / /'phrul chen gnod sbyin lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /'byung po kun gyi 2lus las rnam par ldang / /'byung po kun gyi ④lus la mnyam gzhag cing / /spu yi sgo gcig nas ni rnam par ldang / /spu sgo gcig la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /spu sgo thams cad las ⑤ni rnam par ldang / /spu sgo kun la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /skra rtse gcig gi khyon las rnam par ldang / /skra rtse gcig gi khyon la mnyam gzhag cing / /skra rtse kun gyi khron las rnam par ldang / /skra rtse kun gye khyon las ④mnyam gzhag cing / /phra rab rdul gyi rdul las de dag ldang / /rdul gcig la ni mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /ma lus rdul rnams kun las rnam par ldang / /rdul rnams ma lus kun la mnyam gzhag cing / /rgya mtsho rdo rje'i gzhi las rnam par ldang / /rgya mtsho rdo rje'i gzhi la mnyam gzhag cing / /nor bu'i shing thog dag las rnam par ldang / /shing thog dag 3la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /rgyal ba rnams kyi 'od zer sgo nas ldang / /rgyal ba'i 'od zer sgo la mnyam gzhag cing / /rgya mtsho'i chu yi chu klung rnams las ldang / /rgya mtsho'i chu klung rnams la mnyam gzhag cing / /bdag nyid chen po me yi lam las ldang / /me yi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur 64—1452
