cing / /rlung gi lam las dran ldan rnam par ldang / /rlung gi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /bdag nyid chen po sa yi gzhi las ldang / /sa yi gzhi la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /lha kun gzhal med khang las rnam par ldang / /lha kun gzhal med khang la mnyam gzhag cing / /dran ldan de ni mkha' las rnam par ldang / /yon tan mtha' yas bsags pa de dag gi/ /ting 'dzin rnam thar de dag bsam mi khyab/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bskal pa bsam yas su/ /bshad pa mdzad kyang zad par mdzad mi spyod/ /'gro las rnam smin bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /rgyal ba kun gyis de dag gsungs pa ni/ / lha klu'i rmye rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul dang / /bsam byed bsam gtan rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab—/ /de dag la yang dpes ston brjod par bya/ /de dag 'dra ba'i dpe lta cang med de/ /mkhas shing rig pa'i skye bo dpe rnams kyis/ /bstan na myur du don rnams shes par 'gyur/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi dbang la gnas pa yi/ /nyan thos gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur/ /mang por gyur nas phyir yang gcig 'gyur te/ /mkha' la bsam gtan 'cha' zhing 'bar bar byed/ /smad nas me 'bar stod nas chu yi rgyun/ /stod nas me 'bar smad nas chu yi rgyun//'gro dang 'greng dang nyal dang 'dug pa dang / /lus 'phrul skad cig gcig la bsam mi khyab/ /de ni snying rje che dang mi ldan zhing / /byang chub mi tshol 'jig rten yal 'dor yang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /'jig rten phan 'dod ci phyir ston mi byed/ /nyi zla mkha' las rnam par rgyu 'dod cing //phyogs rnams kun kyi chu yi ngogs dag dang / /mtsho mtshe'u mtsho bran sgod dang rin chen dang / /rgya mtsho chu klung rnams dang ②gzugs brnyan ston/ /de 64—1453

bzhin gzugs rnams bsam kyis mi khyab pa/ /skyes bu dpa' bo phyogs babyu kun du ston/ /ting 'dzin rnam thar kun kyi tshul la mkhas/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa rmyerang byung dbang / /dang ba'i mtsho la yan lag bzhi pa'i dmag /de dag so so'i rang gi zhu gzugs brnyan mthong / /ral gri mda' chen gzhu dang mda' rnams dang / /go gyon bzhon dang theg par bcas su mthong / /gang gi gzugs gang gnas gang cha byad gang / /de dang de dag de ltar chu las mthong / /'on kyang chu la byams sdang rnam rtog med/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra yi③/ /rgya mtsho'i lha mo sgra ldan zhes bya ba/ /sems can rgya mtshor ji snyed skyes rnams kyi/ /skra buyi yan lag dbyangs kyi tshul mkhas te/ /rang gi skad kyis 'gro snyekun tshim par byed/ /sgra ldan chags sdang gti mug ldan ⑥ de yang / /skad rnams kun gyi ④sgra yi tshul mkhas na/ /gzungs ④dang chos kyi stobs la dbang thob rnams/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten ci phyir mgu mi byed/ / tam bu ra ⑫yi chung ma dbyangs ldan ma/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo yid la byung ba de/ /bden dang dam bcas mi tshe ⑩dga' rnams kyi/ /sems dang yid dang kha yi sgor 'jug ste/ /dbyangs ldan chags bcas zhe sdang can de yang / /brtul zhugs grub mthun dbyangs kyi yan lag gis/ /yid 'ong skad kyis 'jig rten mgu byed na/ /ye shes yon tan phyug ⑫rnams cis mi byed/ /rig sngags tshul mkhas sgyu ma'i mkhan po ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs mang mtha' yas ston pa ⑫byed/ /nyin mtshan yud dang zla ba lo brgya dang / /khyim bzang rgyas pa shin tu mdzes pa ston—/ /'dod chags sdang ldan sgyu ma'i mkhan po yang / /sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis 'jig rten mgu byed na/ /bsam gtan mngon shes rnam thar rab bslabs pa/ /64—1454

spyod tshul mkhas rnams ci phyir mgu mi byed/ /lha dang lha min dbang po 'thab pa'i tshe/ /rgyal ldan lha yis lha min pham byas na/ /de dag 'jigs pas gdugs bcas bzhon bcas shing / /theg bcas dmag bcas go gyon bzhin du 'byer①—/ /'dod chags sdang ldan lha dbang de dag kyang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul dbang gnas dpa' ba rnams—/ /lus kyi rnam 'phrul ci phyir ston mi byed/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i glang po sa srung 1bu/ /dbang po'i 'khor gyur rdzu 'phrul chen po de/ /mgo bo sum cu rtsa gsum mngon sprul zhing / /mgo rnams kun la'ang mche ba drug drug ste/ /mche ba de dag so so re re la'ang / /rdzing bu chus 1 gang bdun bdun sprul pa byed—/ /rdzing bu re re'ang ④pad+ma sna tshogs pa/ /rnam par bkod pa bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /pad+ma re a+yola'ang lha yi bu mo dag /sgyu rtsal kun shes bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /de dag rtsed mo glu gar tshul la mkhas/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang po de dang rtse/ /glang po de yang lus ni bsgyur ⑥byas te/ /lha rnams kun dang 'grogs shing bde ④bar byed/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang longs spyod kun kyang mthun/ /glang po mchog gi rnam 'phrul de ltar snang / /glang po chags sdang gti mug ldan de yang / /'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul rab tu ston byed na/ /shes rab thabs kyis stobs la sbyangs pa rnams/ /ting 'dzin brgya yi rnam 'phrul cis mi byed/ /sgra gcan ji ltar 'dod bzhin lus sprul te/ /rdo rje'i gzhi la rkang pa 'jog byed cing / /rgya mtsho lte bar phyin pa tsam du ston/ /ri rab rtse dang nyid kyi mgo yang stoms/ /sgra gcan khyechags sdang gti mug ldan de yang / /'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul kun du ⑨ston byed na/ /'jig rten sgron ma 64—1455

bdud rnams rab 'byam ①pa/ /rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas ci ste ston mi byed/ /brgya byin rnam 'phrul bsam yas pa la ltos/ /lha dang lha min dbang po g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /lha min bye ba 'byer ba ji snyed pa/ /de snyed brgya byin rang gi lus las sprul/ /lha min dbang dang lha min phal kun gyis/ /brgya byin rang rang mdun du 'dug par shes/ /de ni rdo rje 'chang bas gzung ①ngo zhes/ /lha min dbang po kun kyang mgo myos gyur/ /'jigs par byed pa'i mig stong rab bstan te/ /rdo rje me lce 'bar ba thogs byed cing / /lus la go bgos gzi brjid bsnyen dka' ba'i/ /brgya byin mthong nas lha min dbang po 'byer/ /de yang bsod nams phal pa'i mthu stobs kyisagru/ /lha rgyal don du rnam par 'phrul byed na/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi skyabs gyur pa/ /bsod nams mi zad rnams lta cis mi 'phrul/ /lha la skul ma 'debs pa'i lha yi rnga/ /lha las rnam par smin pas grub gyur pa4/ /lha rnams bag med gnas par shes gyur nas / /rnga de nam mkha' las ni sgra sgogs te/ /'dod pa thams cad mi rtag ther zug min/ /tha shal mi brtan dbu ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /sgyu ma m+big rgyu chu zla mtshungs 'dra zhing phye/ /srid pa thams cad rmi lam sprin dang mtshungs/ /bag med thams cad dgra bcas mya ngan can/ /'chi ba'i lam yin mi 'chi'i lam ma yin / /ji snyed su dag bag med gnas gyur pa/ /de dag 'chi bdag chu srin chen pos zin/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba yongs 'dzin thams cad yin/ /skye ba thams cad 'phags pa rnams kyis gyesmad/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams kyi yul la rmongs/ /chos kyi stobs la rtag dga' gyis zhes bskul/ /rnga des bskul nas brgya byin lha rnams dang / /lha yi 'dun ⑦sa chos bzangs ④'dug nas su/ /64byed1456

gtam gang zhi zhing 'dod chags bral mthun pa/ /chos kyi gtam de lha rnams kun la brjod/ /rnga de gzugs med bstan du mi rung yang / /de ltar rnga sgras don chen rab byed na/ /bsam pa ji bzhin gzugs ni yongs ston rnams/ /'gro ba kun gyi don chen cis ①mi byed/ /lha dang lha min dbang po g.yul 'gyed tshe—/ /lha yi bsod nams khyad par ②mthu stobs kyis/ /lha la skul ma 'debs pa'i lha yi rnga/ /lha rnams ma 'jigs shig ces sgra 'byin te/ /rnga yis bskul nas lha rnams rab dga' zhing / /skrag pa med de stobs kyang skyes par gyur④/ /lha min dbang po skrag pas nyen pa rnams/ /'jigs nas dmag bcas de yi mod la ④'byer/ /de ltar rnga ⑤skad 'byin pa'i rnga 'dra ba/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen po/ /nyon mongs bdud bcom snying rje che ldan rnams/ /zhi ba'i sgra bsgrags nyon mongs sel bar byed/ /dbang po lha yi bu mo dgu bcu gnyis/ /dbang po'i sprul pas kun kyang dga' bar 'gyur/ /gcig kyang bdag dang brgya byin rtse bar shes/ /gcig ltar lha mo kun kyang de bzhin no/ /lha mo kun dang dga' bar gnas snang zhing / /chos bzangs 'dun ⑥sa na yang de bzhin 'dug /lha rnams kun la chos rab ston snang zhing //brgya byin skad cig gcig la rnam par 'phrul/ /brgya byin chags sdang gti mug ldan pa yang / /sprul pas rang gi 'khor rnams dga' byed na/ /'gro don mi skyo sbyor rnams ci yi phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'jig rten mgu mi byed/ /bdud kyis ⑦dkrugs ma 'gro ba'i dbang sgyur ba/ /de yi dbang du sems can 'di kun 'dong / /las dang nyon mongs kun du zhugs pa yis/ /so so'i skye bo thams cad bdud des bcings④/ /chags sdang gti mug ldan pa'i bdud de 64—1457

yang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur byed na/ /dbang bcu dbang thob rnams la ci rob ste/ /'gro ba thams cad rang gi phyogs ma bzhag① /stong gsum gnas kyi bdag po tshangs pa yang / /stong gsum tshangs gnas ji snyed yod pa na/ /de dag kun na 'dug par rab snang zhing / /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs shin tu yid 'ong sgogs/ /tshangs de 'jig rten pa yi tshangs lam gyi/ /bsam gtan mngon shes rnam par 'phrul byed na/ /'jig rten rab 'das bla na med pa yilce/ /bsam gtan rnam thar gnas pa cis mi 'phrul/ /dbang phyug chen po'i shes pa'i rnam 'phrul ltos/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis char thigs rab bkye ba/ /skad cig gcig la thams cad bgrang bar ④byed/ /thigs 'ga'i zer kyang ma shes de med na/ /bslabs ④pa bskal pa bsam yas rab bslabs te—/ /byang chub bla med ye shes thob pa rnams/ /ci phyir skad cig gcig la ⑪sems kyis ni/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi ⑥sems mi shes/ /sems can las smin bsam gyis kyemi khyab pas/ /'jig rten 'di kun rlung las yongs su byung / /rgya mtsho ri dang lha yi gzhal med khang / /rin chen rnam phyes ④sa bon bkram pa'ang byung / /rlung las byung gyur sprin gyis ⑨char 'bebs shing / /slar yang rlung nyid kyis ni sprin zhi byed/ /'jig rten gyi ⑩ni lo tog rlung gis bskyed—/ /'gro ba kun gyi bde mang rlung gis byas/ /rlung des pha rol phyin la ma bslabs shing / /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams la ma bslabs spyopar/ /'jig rten rnam smin bsam mi khyab ston na/ /mchog thob pa dag ci ste ston mi byed / /ces bya ba'o/ /bslab pa kun las btus pa las dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //64—1458

rnams kun du sems can don bya ba 'di yin no/ /'di ni dkon mchog sprin las—/ de stide bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten nam de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la me tog gam bdug pa'am spos gsol na/ sems can thams cad kyi ngang tshul ngan pa'i dri nga ba bsal ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri bro bar ④yongs su bsngo'o/ /de phyag dar dang zhal zhal byed na sems can thams cad kyi spyod lam mi sdug pa med par 'gyur ba dang spyod lam mdzes pa phun sum tshogs par yongs su bsngo'o/ /de me tog gi gdugs gsol na sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba med par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /de gtsug lag khang gi nang du 'gro na 'di ltar sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du gzud do snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de phyir 'byung na 'di ltar kyesems can thams cad 'khor ba'i btson ra nas gdon to snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de gnas khang gi sgo 'byed na 'di ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes kyi bde 'gro thams cad kyi sgo dbye'o snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de sgo gcod na 'di ltar ngan 'gro thams cad kyi sgo rnams bcad do snyam ④du sems bskyed do/ /de 'dug na 'di ltar sems can thams cad byang chub kyi snying po la 'god do snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de glo g.yas pas nyal na 'di ltar sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mya ngan las 'da' bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de de nas ldang na 'di ltar sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa kun nas ldang ba 64—1459

rnams las babe+eng ngo snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de lus kyi ched la 'gro na 'di ltar sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po'i 'gros su 'gro bar gyur cig snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de de ltar 'dug na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti myug gi zug rngu 'byung ngo snyam du sems bskyed do—/ /nge bkru bshal byed na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i dri ma'i skyon rnams bkru'o snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de lag pa bsnyal na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i dri nga ba rnams bsal lo snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de rkang pa 'khru na 'di ltar husems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i rdul rnam pa sna tshogs bsal lo snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de gdong 'khru na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi chos thams cad kyi sgo yongs su sbyang ngo snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de so shing za na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi dri ma rnam pa sna tshogs bsal lo snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de lus kyi g.yo ba thams cad sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar yongs su bsngo'o / /de bhude bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phyag 'tshal na 'di ltar sems can thams cad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kyis zhuphyag bya bar shog cig snyam du sems bskyed do zhes ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /yang na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las ji skad gsungs pa lta bu ste/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang gcan gzan khro bo'i dgon par song na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'jigs par mi bya ⑤skrag par mi bya dngang bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des sems can thams cad kyi don du thams cad yongs su gzung bye ba'i phyir te/ des 'di snyam du gal te gcan gzan dag gis ④bdag 64byed1460

zos na 'di ltar sbyin pa de byen par gyur cig /bdag gi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang shin tu nye bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na dud 'gro'i skye ①gnas su song ba'i sems can yong ye med par 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed do/ /shā ri'i bu rkun po'i dgon par song na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'jigs par mi bya skrag par mi bya dngang bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②de dag ni bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba la mkhas pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos lus kyang yongs su btang ba yin/ yo byad dang 'tshog ①chas kyang yongs su btang ba yin te/ des 'di snyam du gal te sems can de dag gis ④bdag gi yo byad dang 'tshog buchas rnams phrogs na de dag la sbyin pa de byin ⑥par gyur cig /gal te de dag gis bdag gi srog bcad dze+epar gyur kyang de la bdag gis ⑧zhe sdang dang khong khro ba bskyed par mi bya/ bdag gis '-ide dag la lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang nyes par ⑪ mi bya'o/ /de ltar na de'i tshe sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sdogs par 'gyur zhing / bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la shin tu nye bar 'gyur te/ ji ltar bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na nyes pa 'di ⑪dang gzhan yang yong ye rnam pa thams 64—1461

cad du mi 'byung zhing med par 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrub po ①snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu chu'i dgon par phyin na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'jigs par mi bya skrag par mi bya dngang bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni mi 'jigs pa'i chos can yin te/ des 'di snyam du bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi sred pa thams cad gcod par bslab par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos skrag ④par mi bya'o/ /gal te bdag skom pas 'chi ba'i dus byas par gyur na sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed par bya ste/ kye ma 'di ltar 'jig rten na chu'i dgon pa 'di lta bu snang bas sems can 'di dag ni bsod nams chung ba dag ste/ ji ltar bdag bla na rnged pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na chu'i dgon pa yong ye rnam pa thams cad du mi 'byung ba dang mi snang bar 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o de ltar bsgrub po/ /ji ltar yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu rnyed par 'gyur ba de ltar bsod nams kyi las la sems can rnams sbyar bar bya'o/ /ji ltar de'i tshe brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba de ltar sems can thams cad kyi don du brtson 'grus brtan pa brtsam par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu gzhan yang bkres pa'i dgon par song na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'jigs par mi bya skrag par mi bya dngang bar mi bya'o/ /des 'di ltar 'dis go cha bgo ste/ ji ltar bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi 64—1462

zhing de na bkres pa'i dgon pa 'di lta bu yong ye rnam pa thams cad du ①mi 'byung ba dang / mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang sems can de dag thams cad bde bar 'gyur zhing bde ba la dbang ba dang / bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ba de ltar brtson 'grus brtan po brtsam par bya ste/ de ltar rang gi ④sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /ji ④ltar na sems can de dag gang ci sems par 'gyur ba dang yid kyis gang dang gang 'dod pa de dang de 'byung bar 'gyur ba④/'di lta ste dper na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi yid la bsam ⑤pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / yid la bsam pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhin du de ltar bya'o—/ /ji ltar sems can de dag chos dang ldan pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad thams cad du thams cad las 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang bral bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar brtson 'grus brtan po brtsam par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o zhes bya'obu/ /de ltar dus rnams rtag dze+etu sems can gyi don bya ba 'di ni bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu ste/zhib tu ni ④spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo las blta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang /chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyur 'gyur te/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ⑨ba'i mdo las ji skad gsungs pa lta bu ste/ byams pa gang zhig thob pa dang bkur ste mi 'dod par chos kyi sbyin pa byin na/ chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med pa'i phan yon nyi shu ste/ nyi shu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/dran pa dang ldan pa yin/ blo dang ldan pa yin/ blo gros dang ldan pa yin/mos pa dang ldan pa yin/ shes rab dang ldan pa yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab rjes su rtogs ⑩par 'gyur ba yin/ 'dod chags chung ba 64—1463

yin—/ zhe sdang chung ba yin/ gti mug chung ba yin/ bdud kyis de la glags mi rnyed pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dgongs pa yin—/ mi ma yin pa rnams kyis de srung ①ba yin/ lha rnams de'i lus la mdangs 'jug pa yin/ mi mdza' snyeb rnams kyis de la glags mi rnyed pa yin/de mdza' bo rnams dang mi phyed pa yin/ tshig gzung bar 'os pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa thob pa yin/ yid bde ba mang ba yin/ mkhas pas bsngags pa yin—/ de chos kyi sbyin pa de rjes su dran par 'gyur ba yin te/ byams pa phan yon nyi shu po de dag go zhes bya ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las kyang gsungs te/ gal te kun dga' bo khyod kyis nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gang zag rnams la nyan thos kyi sa'i chos bstan la/ chos bstan pa des kyang gang dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can de dag thams cad dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas par gyur kyang / da dung nyan thos khyod kyis nga la nyan thos kyi bya ba byas par mi 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gal te khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i tshig gcig cig ④bstan nam bshad na/ de ltar na nyan thos kyis nga mnyes par byas par 'gyur ro/ /chos bstan pa snga mas gang dag stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can de dag 5 thams cad dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur ⑪ la/ dgra bcom pa de dag gi rjosbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / bsgoms ⑦pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yin pa de la kun dga' bo ji snyam du sems/64byed1464

bsod nams kyi phung po mang ba yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mang lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de lta bas kyang su zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos ston na/ nyan thos kyi theg tūpa'i gang zag de bsod nams kyi phung po ches mang du babyed do/ /kun zudaga' bo de bas kyang gang su zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos tha na nyi ma gcig ston na de bsod nams kyi phung po ches mang du bskyed do//kun dga' bo nyi ma gcig lta zhog la tha na snga dro'am/ kun dga' bo snga dro lta zhog la tha na chu tshod gcig nas skad cig gcig ces bya'o②/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ kun dga' bo 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de'i chos sbyin pa ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa thams cad dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba zil gyis mnan pa'o/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di lta bu dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di lta bu sems pa la ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de/ gang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir ldog pa de ni gnas med do zhes bya ba'o④/ /chos kyi sbyin pa ji ltar sbyin par bya zhe na/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las gsungs pa/ mkhas pa dus su sems par byed pa na/ /khang bur zhugs te de bzhin sgo bcad nas/ /chos 'di thams cad la ni tshul bzhin blta/ /langs nas zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis shod/ /64—1465

mkhas pa bde la rtag tu gnas par 'gyur/ /bde la 'dug nas de bzhin chos kyang ston/ /gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ / yangs pa'i stan ①ni rab tu bshams bting ste/ /bzang po'i tshon gyis legs par kha bsgyur ba/ /chos gos gtsang ma de ni rab bgos nas/ /rngul gzan nag po de bzhin bshams byas la/ /sham thabs che tshad legs par rab bgos nas/ /bcos bu'i ras rnams sna tshogs legs bting ba/ /rkang rten bcas pa'i khri la rab 'dug cing / /rkang pa legs par bkrus te steng 'dzegs nas/ /gdong dang bzhin gyi mdangs ni rab snum zhing / /chos kyi stan de la ni rab 'dug nas/ /sems can lhags gepa rtse gcig gyur rnams la/ /gtam mang sna tshogs mang po smra ba dang / /dge slong dag dang dge slong ma rnams dang / /dge bsnyen rnams dang dge bsnyen ma dag dang / /rgyal po dag dang rgyal bu rnams la yang //mkhas de rtag tsatu phrag dog med par ni/ /sna tshogs don ldan snyan pa'i gtam yang ston/ /le lo dag kyang rnam par rab spangs nas/ /skyo ba yi ni 'du shes bskyed mi bya/ /mkhas pas mi dga' thams cad rnam par spang / /byams pa'i stobs ni 'khor la bsgom rgyapar bya/ /nyin mtsham/ du yang chos mchog rab tu bsgomaphye / /mkhas pa de ni bye ba khrag khrig dpes/ /'khor rnams mgu zhing de bzhin dga' bar byed/ /de la nam yang 'dod pa chung zad med/ /zas dang skom dang bza' dang bca' ba dang / /gos dang mal cha chos gos rnams dang ni/ /na ba'i gsos sman dag kyang mi bsam ste/ /'khor rnams la ni ci yang mi bslang ngo / /gzhan du mkhas pa rtag tu bdag nyid dang / /sems can 'di dag sangs rgyas 'grub pya par shog /phan phyir 'jig rten chos gang 64byed1466

bstan pa de/ /bdag gi bde ba'i yo byad kun snyam sems/ /zhes bya'o/ /yang de nyid las/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rab tu ston pa na/ chos kyi dga' ba stoms ①pa byed de tha na 'ga' tsam la yang chos kyi dga' bas lhag par phan 'dogs par mi byed do zhes gsungs so/ /zla ba sgon ma'i mdo las kyang / chos kyi sbyin pa'i ched kyi phyir/ /gal te khyod la gsol 'debs na/ /rab rgyas dag gis ma brlabs du zhes/ /thog mar tshig de brjod par bya/ /khrod ni shes shing mkhas yin na/ /bdag nyid chen po'i mdun du ni/ /bdag gis ①ji ltar bshad nus zhes/ /khyod kyis de skad brjod par bya/ /'phral du brjod par mi bya yi/ /snod la brtag pa byas nas bya/ /gal te snod ni shes gyur na/ /gsol ma btab kyang bshad par bya/ /'khor ni mang po 'khor ④nang du/ /gal te ngang tshul ngan mthong na/ /khyod kyi yo byad bsnyungs mi bshad/ /sbyin pa'i bsngags pa brjod par bya/ /gal te 'dod pa chung gyur te/ /tshul khrims dag par gnas yin na/ /khyod kyis ⑤byams pa'i sems bskyed la/ /yo byad bsnyungs pa'i gtam kyis shig /gal te sdig 'dod nyung rjogyur cing / /tshul khrims ldan pa mang gyur la/ /gnyen po rnyed pa de yi tshe/ /tshul khrims bsngags pa ⑦brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las kyang / 'di lta ste/ sha me sha ma ba ti⑧ / sha mi ta sha tru ⑨ saṃ ku re/ oṃ ku re/ mā ra dzi te/ ka ro ti/ ke yu re/ khru ⑩ko hā ya ti—/ bi sha tha ni rma le/ ma khā pa na ⑪ye/ u kha re/ kha ro gra se/ gra sa ṣ+pe⑫/ he rū ⑫khā+e/ pa rā ④mu khā+e/ ā mā skekhā+e/ sha mi tā ni⑫/ sarba gra ha brnya nā ni/ ni kṛ tī twa⑩/ sarba pa ra pra bā ⑫ di na bi mugh+ra mā ra pra ⑪shās+thā 64—1467

pi ①tā/ budha mu dā⑤/ sa mut+ta ti tā sarba mā ra①/ a tsa li ta pa da pa ri shudhedu—/ bi gats+tshabye⑤/ sarba mā bur karma ṇi/ blo gros rgya mtsho sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni bdud tshar gcad ⑦pa'i tshig nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i tshig ste/de dag chos smra ba des legs par kha ton du byas la chos kyi khri la 'dug ste/byang chub kyi rnam pas ⑧mngon par sgrub pa'i byams pas 'khor thams cad la khyab par byas la/ bdag la sman pa'i 'du shes bskyed de/ chos la sman kyi 'du shes dang / chos nyan pa la nad pa'i 'du shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes dang / chos kyi tshul la yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed la/ sngags kyi tshig 'di dag mngon du byas te/ de ⑨chos kyi gtam byed na/ de'i khor ⑩yug dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams mtho btsam ⑩par bya ba'i phyir 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag 'ong ba de dag gis kyang bar chad byed par mi nus so zhes gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las gsungs pa⑫/ chos smra bas gtsang sbra dang / kun du spyod pa gzob pa dang / legs par bkrus pa dang / legs par gos bgo bar bya'o zhes so//de ltar chos kyi sbyin pa dang / /byang chub sems ni mdor bsdu na/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no/ /dkon mchog za ma tog gi mdo las ji skad du 'jam dpal 'di lta ste/ dper na spos kyi shing ljon pa sna tshogs ni khams bzhis bzung nas rnam par 'phel lo/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du tshogs sna tshogs bsags pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang byang chub kyi sems kyis ⑫ bzung zhing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos na rnam par 'phel lo zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /phyogs 'di ni las dang po pa rnams 64byed1468

'phral du byang chub sems dpa'i babe+eb pa dran par bya ba'i phyir bstan te/ rgya cher ni sangs rgyas kyi yul nyid yin no/ /'dir/ bslab pa ji ltar ①brjod pa 'di'i/ /'grub pa yang dag spong rnams te/ /bag yod pa dang ma bral zhing / /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang / /tshul bzhin du ni sems pas so /de la sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed do 'bad do brtson 'grus rtsom 1mo sems rab tu 'dzin to yang dag par rab tu 'jog go zhes bya ba 'dis ni bsrung ba'o/ /sdog pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba'i phyir 'dun pa skyed ces bya ba 'dis ni dag pa'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed 1pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed pa dang / skyes pa rnams gnas pa dang 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir zhes bya ba 'dis ni 'phel ba bstan to/ /de dag kyang rtag tu bag yod pa dang ma bral bar bya ste/ de no dge ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zla ba sgon ma'i mdo las ji skad du/ tshul khrims thos dang gtong dang de bzhin bzod/ /dge ba'i chos su brjod pa ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi ④rtsa ba bag yod 'di yin te/ /gter 'thob byed ces bde bar gshegs pas bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bag yod pa zhes bya ba 'di ji lta bu ⑤zhe na/ 'dod pa las nyams pa dang mi 'dod pa byung bar budogs pa sngon du 'gro bas gzob pa lhur len pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po drag po ④khro zhing mgu dka' ba'i bran sman gyi 'bru mar gyis ⑧gang ba'i snod thogs te/ stegs 'dred pa la 'gro bas bya ba bzhin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo las gsungs te/ de la bag yod nga gang zhe na/ gang 'di dbang po sdom spupa'o/ /de mig gis gzugs rnams mthong na mtshan mar 64—1469

mi 'dzin cing mngon rtags su mi 'dzin pa nas/ yid kyis ①chos rnams rnam par shes na mtshan mar mi 'dzin cing mngon rtags su mi 'dzin pa yin te/chos rnams kyi ro myang ba dang nyes dmigs dang 'byung ba ④yang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes pa ste/ 'di ni bag yod pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang bag yod pa ni gang rang gi sems 'dul ba dang / gzhan gyi sems rjes su srung ba dang / nyon mongs pa la dga' ba sel ba dang / chos la dga' ba'i rjes su 'jug pa la sogs pa 'di ni bag yod pa zhes bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag bo su dad pa dang ldan zhing bag yod pa dang ldan pa des ni brtson 'grus gang gis bag yod par byed pa dang dad ④par byed pa'i chos de dag yang dag par sgrub par 'gyur ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po su dad pa dang bag yod pa dang brtson 'grus dang ldan pa des ni/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gang gis byang chub kyi phyogs kyi rjochos rnams chud za bar mi 'gyur ba'i dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po su dad pa dang bag yod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan pa des tshul bzhin du sbyor ⑤ba la brtson par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po tshul bzhin la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni gang rjoyod pa de yang yod par rab tu shes so/ /gang med pa de yang med par rab tu shes zhes bya ba nas/ kun rdzob tu mig la sogs pa yod do zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du de nyid las/ sems can don brtson byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /tshul bzhin nyid kyis ⑦dben sems gang yin dang / /rtag tu bag yod 'chi med rgyu yin te/ /yongs su 'dzin med bde ba kun gyi rgyu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /64—1470

yang smras pa/ bdag gzhan mnyam nyid goms byas pas/ /byang chub sems ni brtan par 'gyur/ /bdag dang gzhan nyid ltos ①pa ste/ /pha rol tshu rol ji bzhin brdzun/ /ngogs de rang gis ②pha rol min/ /gang la ltos ①te tshu rol 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rang gis ma grub na/ /gang la ltos ④te gzhan du 'gyur—/ /gal te de la sdug bsngal bas/ /bdag la mi gnod phyir mi srung / /ma 'ongs sdug bsngal khyod la ni/ /gnod mi byed pas ci ste srung / /de tshe'ang bdag nyid yin snyam pa'i/ /rnam rtog de ni log pa ste/ /gang phyir 'chi ba gzhan nyid la/ /der skye ba yang gzhan nyid yin/ /gal te gzhan zhig der rjoskyes na/ /bsod nams kyis ni ci zhig dgos/ /ci phyir gzhon tshe lus rgas pa/ /bde bar bya phyir nor stsogs dubyed/ /mngal na gnas pa zhig pa las/ /byis par gyur pa gzhan yin la/ /byis pa zhig nas gzhon nu nyid/ /de zhig nas ni dar la bab/ /de zhig nas ni rgas gyur te/ /lus ni ji ltar gcig par 'dod—/ /de ltar skad cig so so bas/ /lus gzhan sen mo skra tshogs ④bzhin/ /ci ste byis pa'i tshang ④bor nas/ /byis pa gzhon nu nyid gyur na/ /gang zhig gnas skabs bral gnas pa/ /lus kyi rang bzhin brjod par gyis/ /lus ni sku gzugs 'dra zhe na/ /mar me thal ba la de med/ /gal te rags ⑨spangs phra dngos su/ /de la rnam par gnas she na/ /rang nyid bstan pa tsam 'gyur bas—/ /de ni lus zhes brjod mi bya/ /de la bdag ni bsam pa med/ /snang ba'i lus ni 'jig dang ldan/ /gnas skabs rnams dang 'byel ⑩gyur pa/ /kun rdzob nyid du snang ba yin/ /lung gis kyang ni de yod na/ /rigs pa dang ni lung gis bzlog /'di ltar yon tan ma gtogs par/ /gtso bo yod pa ma 64—1471

yin la/ /gtso bo gsum yang yod ma yin/ /de bzhin yon tan yod na yang //de ni ①so so rnam gsum bdag /'gro ba lhag ma rnam pa dgurarngu / /sems pa med pa gos la sogs/ /de bde'i bdag nyid ji lta bu/ /snam stsogs las skyes bde sogs min/ /snam stsogs kyelas ni bde sogs yin/ /snam bu la sogs rgyu med phyir/ /med na de bde ga la yod/ /de ltar lung dang rigs pa yis / /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ /de yi thurgyu 'bras 'byel ba ni/ /mngon sum yin pas mi gnod do/ /de ni rang gi phyergyud las mthong / /rtag 3 pa la ni ji lta bur/ /phra rab rdul yang gcig min te/ /phyogs kyi dbye ba 3 mi 'thad phyir/ /mar me'i 'bru mar zad 'gyur ba/ /zad 'gyur tshe na mngon pa med / /de ltar dngos po zad par yang / /skad cig re re mi mngon no/ /rgyud hūṃdang tshogs zhes bya ba yang / /phreng ba dmag la sogs kye bzhin brdzun/ /de la goms pas ngar 'dzin na/ /gzhan la ci phyir skye mi 'gyur/ /de phyir skye mched tshogs bzhin du/ /'gro ba gcig tu shes par bya/ /ma byung nyid nas sdug bsngal de/ /gzhan gye bdag las phyir bzlog bya/ /de yang mi rigs 'gyur zhe na/ /gzhan la'ang rang gi bdag nyid med/ /bdag gzhan mi rigs gang yin de/ /ci rigs par ni bzlog bya yin/ /snying rjes ⑩sdug bsngal mang gyur pas/ /ci phyir nan gyis skyed ce na/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal brtag byas na/ /ji ltar snying rje sdug bsngal mang / /de ltar rgyud ni goms gyur pa/ /gzhan gye sdug bsngal zhi dga' bas/ /pad+ma'i nags su ngang pa ltar/ /mnar med par yang 'jug par 'gyur/ /sems can rnam par grol ba na/ /dga' ba'i rgya mtsho gang yin pa/ /de nyid kyis ni chog min nam/ /ro med 64—1472

thar pas ci zhig bya/ /de ltar gzhan gyi ①don byas pas/ /zlas sems dang ni ngo mtshar med/ /gcig tu gzhan don la dga' bas/ /rnam m+bin 'bras bu re ba med/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can phun tshogs de'i/ /bdag gi yin par gdon mi za/ /gzhan bde bdag gir 'du shes pas/ /bdag la phrag dog go skabs med/ /sdig pa bshags ②par bya ba dang / /bsod nams rjes su yi rang dang / /sangs rgyas bskul dang gsol gdab pa/ /gzhan dang bdag gi phyir byed do/ /yongs su bsngo ba de bzhin te/ /bye brag med par rab tu 'jug /de ltar sems can khams bzhin du/ /bsod nams mtha' yas rab tu 'byung / /lam 'di dam pa mchog yin te/ /bde ba mtha' yas dus ston bzang / /byang chub sems dpa'i ded dpon ches/ /gang zhig dga' ba 'phel ba yin/ /lag na rdo rje bsel ①mchog rnams/ /bdud kyi gcan pa skrag byed cing / /sangs rgyas phyag brnyan rnams kyis kyang / /rtag tu yongs su bsrung ba yin/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i ④sras/ /byang chub sems kyi shing rtar zhugs/ /lha la sogs pas stod byed cing / /lam de nas ni 'gro bar byed/ /de ltar sems can rnams la bdag /goms byas tshul gyis sgro btags ⑤te/ /bdag gzhan sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag la sogs pa rnam kun gtang ⑥/ /gang zhig sred pas yongs zin pa/ /de yi sdug bsngal zhir mi 'gyur/ /'gyur bas rnam par chud zos nas/ /de ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal skyedaspyo/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal mes gdungs na/ /rang gi bde la dgar ci yod/ /kun nas tshig par gyur pa yi/ /lus la'ang bde ba ci zhig yod/ /bdag la chags par byed pa ni/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi rtsa ba mchog /64—1473

de ltar ①sems can thams cad la/ /bdag nor gtang 1zhing de gzhom mo/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung bsam pa yis/ /bdag la ma chags dran byas te/ /'bad pa kun gyis de'i pho nya/ /dam pa shes khe 'dod pham ①bya/ /gang gis 'jigs pas de mi gtong / /de ma byen na 'jigs rjopa yin/ /'di ltar bdag gi lus dang sems/ /skad cig re res 'gro ba nyid/ /gal te mi rtag dri 'bab pa'i/ /lus kyis rtag cing dri med pa'i⑤/ /byang chub thob par 'gyur na ni/ /de ni rin med rnyed min nas⑥/ /rtsi sman gzugs dang 'dra bar ni/ /'jig rten chos la mi sems pas/ /da ⑦ltar bdag kyang gtang byos la/ /sems can kun gyi don du spyod/ /sems can kun phyir blon por ni//rang gi shes rab bkol bar bya/ /rigs pas nor de ④bsrung byas te/ /sems can rnams la mkho bar spyad/ /bdag gi lus dang gzhan lus la/ /sdug bsngal mang sel sdug bsngal gang / /de bya bde ba'ang ⑨de bzhin te/ /bde ba mang byed bskyed par bya/ /sems can longs spyod gegs byed phyir/ /bsgribs ⑩te nyon mongs sbyangs ⑪byas te/ /'jig rten 'tsho ba'i 'bab stegs nas—/ /sbrul gyi ro bsal bzhin du bya/ /bsod nams zhing 'di dag gyur na//phun sum lo tog 'bras bu che/ /bde ba'i mu ges gdungs pa yi⑫/ /'gro ba dag ni tshim par 'gyur/ /'thob dang bkur ste lus la sogs/ /skyo la bdag gis ⑫btang min nam/ /ci phyir da dung 'khrug par byed/ /bdag gis brdzun du de smras sam/ /rang don gnod byed la sdang na/ /'o na snying rje gang du 'byung / /gal te gzhan don 'jig ④pa la/ /snying rje med pa'ang su zhig 'khrug /gla rtsi bu ram shing la sogs/ /bdag pos mi shes bzhag nyes te/ /64—1474

longs spyod du ni mi rung bas/ /spyod brgyad la sogs 'os yin bden/ /bdag po la ni phan 'dod nas/ /rim gro bya bar sems pa med/ /de la bskul ba'ang mi byed de①/ /longs spyod phyir yang 'gro mi byed/ /ma rmos 1ma btab rgyal sras rnams/ /de dag rjes 'brangs nyer song ste/ /sna tshogs mi bzad khams rnams dang / /dbang po kun gyi sman chen 'gyur/ /de dag shes byas dran byas te/ /khro ba dang ni gnod byed kyang / /sdug bsngal rnams la zhim pa yi④/ /rang bzhin mi 'dor bde bar byed/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /nam mkha' zhes bya khams lnga po/ /sems can ji srid gnas srid du/ /kun kyi don ni byed pa ste/ /nyes spyod kun kyis ④de dag ni/ /sems can don las mi sdog go/ /de bzhin bdag gis ⑤khams drug po/ /'di dag don med mi bya'o/ /nam mkha'i ④mtha' ni ji tsam par/ /'jig rten mtha' ni srid gyur pa/ /de srid 'jig rten don byed pas/ /ye shes sngon btang gnas par bgyi/ /bya ba bsrungs na tsobadag la ni/ /bdag gis mi dri nan gyis su/ /slob dpon bdag gis rtag ④par bdag /slob ma mchog bzhin bslab par bya /bdag gi bla ma bdag 'dra bar⑨ / /bdag gi bag nyal skyon sus shes/ /bdag sdug bsngal dang bdag 'jigs pas/ /su zhig de ltar sdug cing 'jigs//skyo bar mi 'gyur 'gros ⑫mi 'gyur/ /snying rje yi yang yul gyur cig /rtag tu nye bar gnas gyur pa/ /slob ma bdag 'dra ga la yod/ /nyon mongs kyis kyesbyo gti mug ldongs/ /g.yang sa mang bo'i lam du ni/ /gom pa re re rdeg 'cha' ba—/ /bdag dang gzhan rtag mya ngan gzhi/ /'gro ba rnams ni sdug bsngal mtshungs—/ /de bas 'khrul pa btsal ⑫mi rigs/ /'di la yon tan mthong na 64—1475

ni / /ngo mtshar chen po bya ba'i rigs/ /nyes pa rgya mtsho bdag gcig pu①/ /blang bar nus pa ma yin pas/ /'di na bdag la gzhan yang dgos/ /nyes las thar byed gzhan gang yin/ /pha rol bskul la mkhas pa po/ /gsol ba ma btab phan byed kyi/ /tshig ni bye bos blang bar bya/ /bdag ni kun gyi slob par bya/ /nyon mongs dgra ni mang po dang / /gcig pu bdag ni g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /de na gcig dang 'thab pa na/ /gzhan ni bdag gi bde ba 'joms / /sdang ngam mi sdang gyur kyang rung / /de na la la rgyab nas sam1/ /gzhan nas 'jigs pa sgrogs byed pa/ /de ni bdag la srog phangs sbyin/ /sbug bsngal kun gyi sman pa mchog /bde ba'i dga' ston rab tshogs zhing / /rnam pa kun du nyer 'tsho ba/ /'jam dbyangs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs kyi sras/ /rnam kun rmad du byung rnams kyi/ /spyod pa nye bar bkod pa yi/ /dge ba bdag gis gang bsags pa④/ /bde gshegs go 'phang mtha' yas ni/ /nam mkha'i mtshams par dbang mdzad pa/ /de yi bde ba mtha' yas rnams/ /lus can dag gis thob par shog /bsod nams spel ba rdzogs so// //bslab pa kun las btus pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'dul ba mdo sde du ma las btus pa/ slob dpon zhi ba'i lhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen kyi lo tsā chob ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //be+ed kyi kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ti la ka ka la sha 'udang / lo tsā ④ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis sri mda'i dgon par zhu thug legs par byas pa'o/ /ldu 61—1476

'di nyid bdud la sogs pa dang ma rungs pa thams cad las srung bar byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /thal mo brdab pa'am/ thal ba'am/ yungs kar ram/chu'am—/ blta ba'am/ yid kyis kyang mtshams gcod par byed do/ /nad kyis btab na sman gyi chu la sngags kyis btab ste btung ngo / /yang na mchod rten nam/ sku gzugs sam/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam la nags kyi me tog sems mnyam par gzhag ste 'bul zhing zla ba phyed sbyor ba byas na nad chen po dag las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la dmigs pa dang / sems can thams cad la dmigs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don bya bar 'dod pa'i sems kyis bzang po'i spyod pa sngon du byas pas bzlas brjod bya'o/ /cho ga 'di ni cho ga de'i mjug nas 'byung ba'o/ /dam tshig gsum gyi bzlas brjod byed pa ni khrus ma byas kyang nyes pa med do/ /lhag pa'i chos la ①gtsang sbra ma byas kyang nyes pa med do/ /phyag rgya 'dra ba dag mi bza'o/ /mi 'gom mo/ /khri la nyal bar mi bya'o/ /chang mi btung ngo / /mos pas spyod pa'i babe+eb pa'i gzhi dag las mi g.yo ba dang the tshom med na sngon dang tshul ngan par gyur kyang 'grub bo/ /mkhas sam mi mkhas pa'i chos te ②nges par 'grub po/ /de skad du de nyid las/ gang zhig byang chub sems brtan zhing / /blo gros chags pa med pa dang / /the tshom dag kyang mi byed pa/ /de la nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems brtan ①pa ni 'dir so so skye bo'i rjostobs dang ldan par nges par bya ba'i phyir gsungs kyi/ sar chud pa'i dbang du byas pa ni ma yin no/ /'di la ma shes na sngags rnams yi ge lhag par brjod kyang nyes pa med do/ /nyung yang nyes 64—1521

par mi 'gyur ro/ /cho ga nyams kyang nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang dad pa'i shugs dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi shugs dang / rang gi don dor ba'i sems brtsan par bya ste/ rnam par mi rtog par brjod na gdon mi za bar tshe 'di nyid la byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang ci 'dod pa yang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bslab pa kun las btus pa las 'byung ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsrung ba dang sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga /slob dpon zhi ba'i lhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1520 nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉ཿ a/①〈〈pe 〉〉glaṭī/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉tā ba le ṭ+wāṃ/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉to/ na / 〈〈snar 〉〉to ne / 0〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉ṇa / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉75/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉rto ga wa/1521 ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉tshog dang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉kyang rung ste/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stabastan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rtswa ni/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (121)64wa 1522

༄ga /bslab pa kun las btus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shik+ṣa sa muts+tsha ya a bhi sa ma ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ bslab pa kun las btus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs bcu ldan pa gang gi zhabs rdul la/ /lha rnams cod pan gyis gtugs de btud de/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs gtugs zhi ba'i lhas/ /bslab pa'i gnas rnams mdo sde kun las btus/ /dang po gnyis ni phyi ma bdun gyis bshad/ /gnyis kyi don ni rnam dgur shes par bya/ /lnga yi 'og dang gnyis kyi gong ma ni/ /dang po yin te gzhan na gnyis pa yin/ /gnyis ka'i don ni zla ba tshes pa dang / /nya dang sdeg pa gser gyi 'khor lo dang / /glang po gdugs dang thig le dang po dang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag na ral gri 'dzin/ /rin po che ni khyad par gnyis dang bcas/ /dad dang bla ma'i tshogs dang go cha dang / /byin 64—1523

rlabs ①phyir mi ldog dang spyod pa dang / /lung bstan pa ni sku gsum yon tan bcas—/ /bzhi las 'bras bur gyur pa dang po ste/ /gsum ni yang dag spong bar rab tu gnas/ /gnyen po gang la de yi ngo bo ste/ /rten dang nyes pa spong ba dang po yin/ /sun 'byin pa ni de yi gnyis par brjod/ /gnyen po spyod pa gnyis pa'i dang po ste/ /spyod pa tha ma de yi gnyis pa yin/ /mi mthun pa ni rnam pa brgyad yin te/ /las dang nyon mongs lta ba dag las ni/ /'gyur dang gyur pa'i khyad par rnam pa drug /rang gi rtsa ba tha ma gnyis dang bcas/ /'gyur ba gsum ni dang po'i chos su gzhag /gyur pa gsum ni dang po'i gnyis pa ste/ /rtsa ba gnyis kyang de dang mthun pa yin/ /gyur pa gsum ni gnyis pa'i gnyis pa ste/ /rten gyi dang po'i chos kyang de yi yin/ /gyur pa dang po stobs kyi dang po ste/ /gyur pa gnyis pa phung po'i gnyis pa yin/ /gyur pa gsum pa phung po'i gsum pa ste/ /mi mthun gnyen po'i khyad par de yis bstan//tshogs kyi lam la lnga ni dngos yin te/ /de las gzhan pa rjes su mthun pa yin//sbyor ba'i lam la bdun ni dngos yin te/ /de las gzhan pa lnga ni rjes mthun yin—/ /mthong ba'i lam la bcu ni dngos yin te/ /de las gzhan pa gnyis ni rjes mthun yin/ /tshogs kyi lam la bsrung ba gtso bo ste/ /chos gzhan gsum po mos pa mchog dang ldan/ /sbyor ba'i lam la spel ba gtso bo ste/ /gsum po dag la ji ltar 'tshal par zad/ /mthong ba'i lam la dag pa gtso bo ste//gsum po dag gis bdag dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgom pa'i lam la pha rol phyin pa ste/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po ④'gro ba tshim par byed/ /basbab pa kun las btus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //64—1524

dpal mar me mdzad ye shes dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ /gser gling rgyal po dpal ldan chos skyong gis/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mnyes byas pas/ /bslab pa kun las btus pa'i mngon par rtogs/ /ka ma la dang mar me mdzad la gsungs// //bsdur mchan/1522 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro bslab pa kun las btus kyi mngon rtogs gser gling pas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/1524 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stapos/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (122)64wa 1525

༄ga /bslab pa me tog snye ma zhes bya ba/① ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ shik+ṣa ku su ma mañja rī khyenā ma/ bod skad du/babe+eb pa me tog snye ma zhes bya ba/ dpal 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo//shin tu g.yo ba'i kun rtog rlabs kyis mi 'khrugs pa yis zab gyur cing / /rnam par 'phro ba'i sna tshogs yon tan 'byung gnas nyid dang de bzhin du/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis ma lus 'gro don phun sum tshogs pas rgya che ba'i/ /mtsho 'dra'i sangs rgyas gang yin de la 'chi med don du skyabs su mchi/ /gal te lus dang longs spyod dang ni dge ba gsum/ /btang dang bsrung ba dang ni dag dang spel ba rnams/ /gzhan don brtson pas nges par byed par 'dod 'gyur na/ /bla med bslab pa kun las btus pa la brten bya/ /mdo sde rin chen sna tshogs kyi/ /rgya mtsho chen po gcig pu yi/ /bslab ①kun bsdus pa 'di mthong na/ /sred pa kun nas gcod par byed/ /shin tu rgyas pas 'jigs pas na/ /bdag 64—1526

'dra'i sems kyi rgyud dag pa①/ /de yi gzugs brnyan 'char ba ni/ /bde blag tu ni 'dir mi 'byung / /de phyir rang gi sems kyi rgyud/ /dag pa tsam gyi don gyi phyir—/ /bdag gi dran pa las 'ongs pa/ /cung zad btus te bri bar bya/ /'phags pa zhi ba'i lha gang gis/ /bshad bya thams cad mtshon byed pa'i—/ /gang zhig basbab btus 'grel pa ni/ /yod pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa/ /'di lta ste/ bdag gi ②lus dang longs spyod dang / /dge ba dus gsum bsags pa rnams/ /sems can kun la btang ba dang / /de bsrung dag pa spel ba'o/ /lus ni 'di la ①rab grags pa'i/ /'di ltar phung po lnga po'o/ /longs spyod nyer mkho thams cad de/ /de'i gnas pa yi rgyur gyur pa'o/ /dge ba legs pa duthams cad de/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar ba'o—/ /gtong ⑤ba la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /de dag so so nas bstan te/ /snying po med pa snying blang phyir/ /gus pas sbyin par bya ba yin/ /lus sogs snying po med pa 'di/ /mngon sum dang ni lung gis grub/ /ji skad du/gang zhig byin de nyams min te/ /gang zhig khyim na gnas de nyams/ /gang de khyem nas mya ngan rgyu/ /gang zhig byin de bde 'byung byed/ /gang zhig byin de bde 'gro ba/ /mtho ris kyi ni skabs su gnas/ /gang de khyem nas ngan 'gro der/ /sdug bsngal yang dag 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /gang de khyem nas yun rings su rjo/ /'khor ba'i lam du rtsang bar byed/ /gang byin de ni thar pa yi⑦/ /grong khyer lam na ston par byed/ /khyem gnas gang de 'khor ba yi/ /dug gi sdong bu 'phel bar byed/ /gang zhig byin de nyon mongs pa'i/ /dgra yi phyogs rnams sel bar byed/ /khyim gnas gang de pha rol gyi/ /khang pa'i sgor ni 64—1527

'gro ba'i rgyu/ /gang zhig khyim stide 'dod pa yis②/ /gang ba'i khang bzangs ①'byung ba'i rgyu/ /ser snas bcings pa las byung ba'i/ /de ltar skyon rnams mthong nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sbyin pa la be+e goms par bya/ /rim gyis goms pa 'phel ba las/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje'i gter/ /gang zhig mgo dang rkang bar gyi/ /lus ni sbyin par byed pa dhin//de la rmi lam rgyu mtshungs pa'i/ /sdug pa'i bu la sogs pa dang / /de bzhin longs spyod thams cad la/ /sbyin mi bya ba yod dam ci/ /khyi dang wa dang stag sogs kyi/ /zas su 'di dag gsal bar ni/ /yang dag mthong bas 'dod rnams la/ /lus ni sbyin par cis mi bya/ /gzhan la gtang duba'i rang bzhin 'di—/ /lam du mkhas pa rnams kyis bsten/ /'gro ba'i don ni rab sgrub ched/ /gzhan dag de yis sngon dum gzigs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /rin chen rgyan ni dran pa dang / /ser sna'i nyes pa rnams mthong ba/ /gnyis po sbyin pa la 'jug rgyu/ /de dag ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //de ni sbyin par gyur kyang ni/ /bsrung ba dag ni ma byas na/ /lus sogs longs spyod du mi 'gyur/ /des na bsrung ba rnams bya'o/ /'gro ba'i don rnams bsgrub don du/ /longs spyod nyid du bya ba'i phyir/ /lta mdzes shing gi sa bon bzhin/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyis bsrung / /gzhan du dus mi shes pa yis/ /smin par ma gyur byang chub kyi/ /sems kyi myu gu nyams pa yis—/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras ster 'gyur/ /lus kyi bsrung ba gang zhe na//gzhan la gnod pa spong ba ste/ /de ni bdag cag chags bral bas/ /de ni 64—1528

dam chos yongs bzung dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams/ /ji bzhin rtag tu bsten pa dang / /sems can kun la brtse ba las/ /'byung bar mdor bsdus nas ni brjod/ /gnod par 'gyur ba gzhan rnams kyi/ /bya dang bya min blta ①ba dang / /nyes pa med par gnas pa la/ /lus dang sems dang ngag gis ni/ /nyes pa nye bar 'dogs pa dang / /de bzhin gzhan la gnod sems dang / /yang dag byang chub sems bskyed la/ /mi snyan rjod par byed pa dang / /ldig can 'di ni blta min zhes/ /gang zhig ma dad khro sems kyis②/ /byang chub sems dpa' la ni gdong / /phyir phyogs par ni byed pa dang / /chags pas 'dod rnams la zhen dang / /sdig pa'i grogs po'i rjes 'jug dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen spong ba dang / /'jig rten chos la 'dris byed dang / /tshul bzhin ma yin rab ldan pa'i/ /sbyin pa la sogs gnod pa nyid/ /sgrib pa thams cad yongs dag pa'i/ /mdo las rab tu rtogs bya ste/ /'di ltar/ sbyin pa gtong na bdag nyid ni/ /gcig pu kho na gtong byed ces/ /bdag nyid nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /ser sna can la brnyas ④'di dang / /tshul khrims srung bar byed pa na/ /tshul khrims 'chal rnams la brnyas ④shing / /bdag nyid tshul khrims ldan rig phyir/ /de skyon 'jig rten la brjod dang / /bzod pa goms par byed pa na/ /bzod med rnams la brnyas ⑤byed cing / /bdag nyid kho na sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur zhes pa'i blo ldan dang / /de bzhin brtson 'grus bsam gtan dang / /de bzhin yang dag byang chub kyi/ /rgyur 'gyur dam chos gzhan la yang / /gang zhig mdo sde gcig nyid la/ /legs zhes rab tu brjod pa dang / /64—1529

tshigs bcad gzhan dang tshig gzhan dag /gsal bar gang zhig brjod pa dang //shes rab nyid la sbyor byed kyi/ /lhag ma'i pha rol phyin la min/ /de lta'i shes rab 'chal rigs kyi/ /spyod pa yang ni blta bar bya/ /'dod yon lnga yi rol pa yis/ /byed pa'i chos ni smra ba la/ /spyod pa ldan par gnas min zhes/ /gang zhig yid kyis sems byed pa/ /de lta'i gnod dang yang de yi/ /rnam smin ches ni rtsub pa la/ /sna tshogs thams cad 'dod pa las/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dang bar bya/ /dam chos dran pa nyer gzhag pa/ /la sogs mdo sde rnams la ni/ /gus dang g.yo ba med pa yi/ /sems kyis nges par blta ba yis—/ /gnod pa dang ni spong ba la/ /gus pa yang ni bsgrub par bya/ /rang ni ngan 'gros 'jigs skrag na①/ /mthong dang ma mthong don sgrub phyir/ /sbas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnas pa'i/ /sems can rnams la thams cad du/ /nam yang khong khro ba dag gi/ /skabs ni rab tu dbye mi bya/ /gang phyir dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdor/ /gzigs pa nyams med sangs rgyas kyis/ /bla med byang chub chen po ru/ /sems can thams cad lung bstan to/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gi/ /spyod pa la ni smad mi bya/ /sems can rnams kyi spyod pa ni/ /'phags min mig gi spyod yul min/ /gang zag gzhan rmis gang zag gzhan/ /tshad 'dzin par ni byed pa dag /rang gis rang nyid nyams byed par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /mchod rten bskor ②ba bya ba dang / /yon gnas rnams dang 'dris pa dang / /de bzhin phyi ma'i dus na ①ni/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'dzin pa yi④/ /sman pa nad pa sman dang ni/ /mi bzad nad kyi 'du shes kyis/ /dge bshes bdag nyid dam chos 64—1530

dang / /nyon mongs rnams la rig par bya/ /gnod pa yongs su spang don du/ /bag yod pa ni yongs su bzung / /rnyed dang bkur ste mi 'dod par/ /bsgod cing kun dga' ra sogs yang / /de la bag ni yod pa ni/ /bag yod pa ni mdor bsdu na/ /gang zhig rang sems 'dul ba dang / /gzhan sems rjes su 'jug pa ste/ /phun sum tshogs pa kun gyi phyir/ /skye bo ngan pas bsten ①pa yi/ /rnyed dang bkur ste la gzhol yid/ /myur du 'bigs par byed pas na/ /tsher ma dang mtshungs mkhas pas spang / /'phral du bying bar byed nyid kyis/ /'dam kyi 'du shes kyis ②zhes bya/ /dran pa'i rin chen nyams byed phyir/ /chom rkun gyi ni 'du shes bya/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las ①gnod pa spang ba'o// //gnod pa spang ④ba tshul khrims te/ /de ni dran pa nyer gzhag ⑤las/ /zhi gnas mi nyams rgyar 'gyur ba'i/ /dran pa bcu gnyis dag tu gsungs/ /sangs rgyas bka' las 'das byung ba'i/ /rnam smin la grub dran pa dang / /lus mi g.yo ba gnyis gnas pa'i/ /dran pa yang ni gzhan yin no/ /shin tu ma dad pas byas pa'i/ /sbyin sogs dam pa'i dran pa dang / /spyod lam dang ni thams cad la/ /gus par bya zhes dran pa dang / /gzhan gyi don la mi mkho ba'i—/ /yan lag dag ni 'dir mthong na/ /de tshe bsdus nas sbar yang de/ /gzhan gyi don sbyor dran pa dang / /sems kyi glang chen myos pa ni/ /zhi gnas kyi ni ka ba la/ /rtag tu gdags pa'i dran pa yang / /'di ni drug par gsungs pa yin/ /ji tsam bdag dugi sgra yis ni/ /nyan pas don ni nges 64—1531

'gyur ba/ /de las lhag pa don med pa'i/ /sgra mi brjod pa'i dran pa yang / /spyod lam lhag pa gang zhig la/ /bsrung ba'i don gyi dran pa gzhag① /dran pa lhag ma mdo yi ni/ /rjes su 'brangs nas shes par bya/ /gang zhig sgo srubo chagyur pas nyon mongs dang / /bdud rnams dag gis zil gyis mi non cing / /lam min lam ngan dag tu mi lhung ba'i/ /yang dag dran pa zhi gnas kyi ni rgyu/ /dran pa gang zhig phul byung nyid/ /shes bzhin zhes ni brjod pa ste/ /gang zhig lus dang sems la ni/ /yang dang yang du rtog pa po/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin las/ /ting nge 'dzin kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin zhi gnas la gzhan min/ /tshul khrims de med par mi 'byung / /gang phyir ting 'dzin tshul khrims las/ /'byung bas ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu/ /sbyor bas gzhan dag gsungs pa rnams/ /thams cad tshul khrims khongs su 'dus/ /de phyir dran dang shes bzhin dag /ldan pa ting 'dzin don gnyer bya/ /tshul khrims 'dod pas zhi gnas la/ /rtag tu gus pas 'bad par bya/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las lus bsrung ba'o// //lus bsrung ba yang bya ba'i phyir/ /longs spyod kyang ni bsrung bar bya/ /longs spyod rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /gos dang kha zas dbye bas so/ /de la zas srung gang zhe na/ /kha na ma tho med pa gang / /de dang gzhan ni kha gsag dang / /tshul 'chos dang bral bsod snyoms so/ /gang tshe rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni//bsod snyoms la ni rgyu ba na/ /de tshe blo dang ldan pa des/ /blo ni rnam gsum bskyed bya ste/ /lus la chos 'dzin blo dang ni/ /lus kyi srin bu gso ba dang / /64—1532

gzhan yang sbyin bdag rjes su ni/ /gzung ba'i blo ni bskyed par bya/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi don du ni/ /longs spyod byas na de bsrung yin/ /gang gis rang nyid kho na spyod/ /de las nyon mongs thong bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang gzhan la zhen pa yi/ /sems kyi 'dod pas gzhan gyi nor/ /yongs su longs spyod byed pa gang / /nyon mongs min pa'i ltung bar 'gyur/ /gyi zhes nas ni rang gi nor/ /gang gis longs ni spyad gyur na/ /de ni rang lto 'gengs pa ste//brkus pa yi ni ldung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sems can don la ni/ /brtson pas dam chos 'dzin pa'i lus/ /'di ni gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /yongs su longs spyod byed pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kyis gnang chos gos las/ /lhag pa blo ldan kyis mi gzung / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsrung don du/ /ma gnang blo ldan gyis mi gtang / /'dir ni sems can mang po yis/ /smad pa yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir/ /slong bar byed pa 'ga' la yang / /chos gos gsum po sbyin mi bya/ /de dag ni longs spyod bsrung ba'o// //rnam par smin pa mi 'dod pas/ /dge ba kun du bsrung bar nyu 'gyur/ /'jig rten pa la zhubasgrags min par/ /byas te mi dge'i las bzhin no/ /de bzhin du/ nga rgyal med kyang rtag par ni/ /rnyed dang bkur ste yongs spong dang / /sems can kun la dang ba yis/ /dge ba kun du bsrung bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar yang / khengs pa med par gyur na ni/ /bde gshegs yon tan ngang gis 'byung / /ri bo yongs su spangs nas ni/ /chu bo rgya mtshor 'bab pa bzhin—/ /zhe sdang dbang du gang gyur pa/ /ngan 'gror 'gro dang dman pa yi//64—1533

rigs su skye ba yongs 'dzin dang / /mi khom pa rnams yongs su 'dzin/ /ma dad pa ni zhe sdang ste/ /khong khro zhes pa med ①gzhan no/ /gang zhig bskal pa du ma ru/ /bsags pa'i dge ba 'joms pas so/ /de phyir 'joms par brtson pa yi/ /sems can la yang dang bya ste/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen bsdigs byed pa'i/ /rgyal po'i skyes bu gcig bzhin du/ /shin tu phyi thag lta byed pa/ /de yis 'di gcig la yang mthong / /gang phyir skye bo'i tshogs chen gyi/ /rgyal po che dpung de yi dpung / /rgyal po khros pas 'dir ni dmyal bar byed nus sam/ /de bzhin gal te gus pas bde gshegs nyid mtshungs 'dir ster ④ram/ /de bzhin sems can mgu ba las byung sangs rgyas lta zhog gi/ /de ltar rang nyid snyan dang skal ba bzang ba ma mthong ngam/ /gang zhig mgu las srid gsum mtsho yi pha rol son gyur cing / /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan yun mi ring bar rdzogs/ /blo dman rnams kyis gzhan dag mgu ma byas pas dmyal ba thob/ /des na legs 'dod bdag ni sems can rnams la cis mi 'dud—/ /de bzhin du/ sems can rnams la phan sems shing / /snyan pa chen po smra byed la/ /rten pa zhes nas 'jug pa dang / /bden pa smra bar dga' ba ni/ /skye ba kun du skyes tsam gyis/ /ngang gis 'byung ba dag dang ni/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /'bad pa med par skye bar 'gyur/ /de dag ni dge ba bsrung ba'o// //'dir yang da ④ni lus kyi rjoyang / /yongs su dag pa brjod par bya/ /de yang / mdor na lus kyi sdig pa ni/ /zad dang nyon mongs sbyang ba'o/ /64—1534

bskal pa du mar bsags pa yi/ /sdig pa zad par byed pa'i rgyu/ /chos bzhi'i mdo las bsten ①pa yi/ /chos bzhi yongs su gzung bar bya/ /de la chos bzhi ni/ sun 'byin kun du spyod pa dang / /gnyen po yongs su 'dzin pa dang / /de nas nyes pa las ldog stobs/ /de nas rten kyi stobs dag go/ /mi dge'i las ni byas pa na/ /sems ni 'gyod par byed pa nyid/ /sun 'byen kun du spyod pa ste/ /de nyid sdig pa bshags pa'o/ /de la sun 'byen pa kun du/ /spyod pa 'di ni bsgom par bya/ /lus dang sems dang ngag rnams kyis/ /bdag gis mi shes gang bgyis pa/ /mgon po rnams kyi mdun gnas te/ /sdig pa de dag bshags par bgyi/ /mdo sde rgyal po gser 'od dam pa las/ /rab tu gsungs pa'i bshags pa de dag gis/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la/ /'gyod pas bdag gi 'khrul pa'i sdig bshags ⑤bya/ /bral bar bya ba 'dod pa yis/ /ltung ba thams cad bshags par bya/ /dug dang bcas pa'i kha zas ni/ /ma skyugs bde ba'i rgyur mi 'gyur/ /de yang phyi dang yang ba dang / /'dir ni ltung ba gnyis su 'dod/ /de la zhe sdang las byung ba/ /phyi zhing chags las byung ba yang / /rang bzhin kha na ma tho lci/ /bcas pa yi ni spong ba'o/ /gang phyir sdang dang chags pa las/ /sems can gtong dang 'dzin pa'i rgyu/ /zhe sdang las skyes rgyal sras kyi/ /thabs su gyur pa ma yin gyi/ /gnod pa chen po'i rgyu yin par/ /'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med/ /gang phyir kun sdud shes pa ni/ /thabs su mdo rnams las ni mthong / /shes rab kyis ni de yongs gcod/ /des ni de ltar gnyi ga ④min/ /gang tshe chags skyes sangs rgyas nyid/ /myur 64—1535

du mi 'gyur chug na yang / /gal te thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /sngon gye sems can bsdus gyur na/ /tshangs pa yi ni 'jig rten du/ /skye bar 'gyur ba gang gis zlog /gal te min na dus ring du/ /ngan song dag tu rab tshiskye bar②/ /gal te de tshe gzhan don du/ /longs spyod kyis ③gzhan bud med dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan can gzhan la/ /'dod pas 5 log par spyod mi 'gyur/ /gal te dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal yang / /bsran pa rang gis khas blangs pas/ /gzhan gyi srog ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /de tshe nyes pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar khye'u skar rgyal ni/ /snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa yis/ /chags pa'i skal ldan mchog la ni/ /srog bsrung don du zhugs srepa bzhin/ /tshangs par spyod pa la sogs pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan can rnams la/ /rnam pa gzhan du byas pa yis / /de las 'jug pa rigs ma yin/ /gzhan la gnod pa bzlog pas na//khro ba 'di las thal ba min/ /bag chags sa bon bsags pa dang / /skabs phye ba las snying rje nyams/ /gzhan yang / mi dge ba la ge bzlog na'ang gal te na / /byang chub sems dpa' la ni yid byung na/ /rtag tu ngan 'gro'i sar ni 'gro 'gyur te/ /de yis bdag gzhan gnyi ga'i bya byas min/ /'on te thabs bral rang bzhin kyi/ /chags pa la yang skyon 'di yin/ /gang phyir bdag bde la zhen pas/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal btang stoms 'dor/ /de ni ma yin te/gang gis rang gi sdug bsngal bzhin du gzhan sdug bsngal/ /snying rje dman pas mtha' gabyug tu ni goms ma byas/ /de ni rang gi bde la zhen pas gzhan sdug bsngal / /dus mtha' yas su btang snyoms 'dor bar byed pa bden/ /de dag ni sun 'byin pa kun du spyod pa'o// //64—1536

sdig pa'i las ni byas gyur kyang / /slar yang dge ba'i don brtson pa/ /sangs rgyas dmigs pa la sogs pa/ /gnyen bo kun du spyod pa yin/ /'di lta ste/ byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /de bzhin rgyal ba'i gzugs brnyan ①dang / /bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal dang / /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /mchod rten me tog 'bul ba dang / /khyad par du ni khyem gnas las/ /nges 'byung tshul khrims rdzogs pa dang / /bde gshegs la ni mchod byas pa'i/ /dman ma sel bar byed pa dang / /byug pa'am mar me chu sbyig khrugang / /dbul ba'am zhurnge tog gabyug 'dogs pa/ /yang dag rgyal ba yis gsungs pa/ /rgyu rkyen dag dang ldan pa yi/ /chos rnams gal te shes gyur na/ /ngan song dag tu 'gro mi 'gyur/ /mig gnyis btsums nas yid kyis ni/ /mdun du sangs rgyas dmigs byas te/ /gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge brgya—/ /stong phrag brgyad du bzlas par bya/ /gang na rtse gcig yid kyis ni/ /sgul byed ma yi gzungs sngags dag /ji srid sdig pa zad pa'i rtags/ /rmi lam ma mthong bar du bzlas/ /'di lta ste/ zas ngan dag ni skyugs pa dang / /zho dang 'o ma za ba dang / /nam mkha' la ni 'gro ba dang / /nyi zla dag kyang mthong ba dang / /rmi lam du ni mi dag las/ /rgyal na sdig pa zad shes byabya/ /ma te dang ni de bzhin du/ /skyes bu nag po'ang mtshon byed yin/ /sman gyi bla ma bai ḍūr+ya/ /'od kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs/ /ji bzhin yid la byed pa na//mi dge rnams ni zad par 'gyur/ /de dag ni gnyen po kun du spyod pa'o / /khyesbar yang sdom pa 'dzin pa ni/ /mi mthun las ldog stobs brjod do/ /gang zhig mi dge ba yi las/ /slar yang sdom pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de dag ni 64—1537

mi mthun pa'i phyogs las ldog pa'i stobs so // //①de la rten stobs sangs rgyas dang / /chos dang dge 'dun la brten dang / /de bzhin mi phyed dad pa yis/ /byang chub sems la brten pa ste/ /dkon mchog gsum la cho ga yis ni skyabs su song gyur pa'i/ /ches mang 'bras bu gang yin phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa las shes bya/ /gang zhig byang chub sems la brten pa las byung 'bras bu dag /de ni sna tshogs mdo rnams dag ni bltas pa las shes bya/ /de dag ni sdog pa byang ba ④ste tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //gang phyir mi bzod thos sogs la/ /brtson 'grus nyams par gyur pa yin//de phyir mi skyo brtson pa yis/ /thos pa spel phyir bzod pa bya/ /gang phyir thos pa ma gtogs par/ /bsam gtan spyod yul thabs ma gtogs/ /des na skyo ba med yid kyis/ /'bad pas thos pa btsal bar bya/ /gang phyir gong dang 'dres pa na/ /spyod lam shes par gyur pa ①ni/ /mnyam gzhag yang dag skye min pa/ /de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /nags su'ang g.yeng ba zhi med na//sems ni mnyam par 'jog mi 'gyur/ /des na mkhas pa dag gi ④ni/ /mnyam par gzhag la sbyar bar bya/ /nyon mongs sbyang ba las gzhan pa'i/ /mnyam gzhag 'bras bu yod ma yin/ /de phyir nyon mongs rnam sbyang phyir/ /mi sdug la sogs bsgom par bya/ /nyon mongs dag ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ /de ltar mdor bstan tshig rnams gsungs/ /da ni nyon mongs sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rgyas par yang dag brjod par bya/ /gang zhig dngos po bzod pa ste/ /de yang 64—1538

rnam pa gsum du dbye/ /sdug bsngal gzhan gyis ①gnod byas dang / /chos la yang ni skye bar 'gyur/ /phal cher mi 'dod byung ba dang / /sdug dang bral byung rjolas sdug bsngal/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal la ①'jigs pa/ /de bzod mi mthun phyogs su 'dod/ /de la sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i bzod pa bsgom pa'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ sdug bsngal rab sel byed pa yi/ /kun mkhyen rin chen 'dod pa na/ /chung ngu bzod pas rim gyis ni/ /gnod pa drag bo bzod 'gyur te/ /re zhig shin tu dman pa'i 'bras bu yi/ /dngos ④po la ni zhen pa'i sems/ /nya ba zhing pa la sogs pa/ /gnod pa bzod par byed mthong na/ /bdud kyi khar chud gyur pa yi/ /'gro ba bcings pa dgrol ba yis⑤//yang dag dam bcas byas pa dag /sdug bsngal mthong bas ji ltar ldog /gang zhig gnod ma byas kyang dgrar gyur zag pa yi⑥/ /dgra bo gzhom phyir skad cig kyang ni khro ba ru/ /mi byed pa de bdag lagi rigs pa'i dngos min zhing / /gang zhig khru dgra ma thub pa nga rgyal can dngos min/ /shin tu dus ring dag tu sdug bsngal gyis thob pa'i/ /dge ba'i nor ni 'phrog pa dag tu brtson gyur zhing //bsran pas bdag gi sdug bsngal tshor ba'i rgyur gyur la/ /gzhom par 'dod pa ci yi phyir na 'byung mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar mtha' gcig tu ni rim gyis goms pa phul byung stobs dag las/ /mi rnams la ni sdug bsngal la yang bde bar 'du shes stobs ldan 'byung / /de bzhin yang dag byang chub gzhol ba'i yid can 'di dag la/ /sdug bsngal la yang mtshungs med bde bar 'du shes 'byung bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las ni/ /de yi rgyu mthun 'bras bu gsungs/ /chos kun bde bar ⑨gnas pa zhes/ /bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 64—1539

yod de/ /ting 'dzin de ni thob tsam gyis/ /dmigs pa'i dngos po thams cad la/ /byang chub sems dpa' bde ba yi/ /tshor ba nyid 'byung gzhan du min—/ /'di ltar/ mgo bo gcod par byed pa'am/ /de bzhin rkang lag la sogs pa/ /sba yis gzhu ba byas kyang ni/ /bde ba'i 'du shes 'ba' zhig 'byung / /dmyal ba dang ni mi yi 'am/ /sdug bsngal dag ni byed pa na'ang / /gshed ma rnams la dga' ba ni/ /mngon du byed pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bdag la lus can 'di kun kyis/ /gal te 'bigs sam gcod byed pa/ /de lta na yang gnod pa'i sems/ /bdag gis bya ba'i rigs min te/ /gang phyir bdag la sems can gyis/ /gnod byas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la/ /stong phrag dag tu byas pa yi/ /char yang phod pa ma yin no/ /gnod sems dag ni 'byung ba'i rgyu / /bdag nyid la chags bkur ba dang / /chen por mngon par zhen pa ste/ /de yi gnyen po bzod par 'dod/ /bdag gi dgra dang bshes kyi dgra/ /dgra bo'i bshes las 'gyur ba yi/ /gnod sems rgyu dgu las byung ste/ /re re dus gsum dbye bas so/ /de dag ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //de ltar bzod pa la gnas pas/ /thos pa la ni brtson 'grus brtsam1/ /gang phyir thos las shes rab ste/ /shes rab las ni nyon mongs spong / /de yang rnam pa brgyad cu yis/ /thos pa gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de la 'dun pa'i rnam pa dang / /gzhan yang rten gyi rnam pa dang / /gzhan yang lhag bsam rnam pa dang / /sbyor ba'i rnam pa zhes bya dang / /sems ni dga' ba'i rnam pa dang / /chog shes pa yi mtshan nyid dang / /dran pa bskyed ②pa'i 64—1540

rnam pa dang / /gtong ba spel ba'i mtshan nyid dang / /gzhan yang sangs rgyas chos kun la/ /mi ngoms pa yi rnam pa dang / /ma thos nyams ①pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /mngon ⑧ shes nyan pa'i rnam pa dang / /de bzhin sdug bsngal stong pa dang / /mi sdug bdag med zhi rnams dang / /rang sems bsrung ba'i rnam pa dang / /brtson 'grus spel ba'i rnam pa ste/ /'di yang rgyas pa ④'phags pa ni/ /blo gros mi zad mdor shes bya/ /thos pa nyid la chos kyi ni/ / tshogs zhes ④bya ba ming gzhan yin/ /gang tshe yongs su smin pa ni/ /de nyid ye shes tshogs yin te/ /chos kyi tshogs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /mthun rgyu dag tu brjod pa ni/ /don nyung bya ba nyung nyid dang / /smra ba nyung la mngon dga' dang / /yang dang yang du thos pa'i don/ /sems shing chos la gzhol nyid dang / /sems dang ba dang yo byad dag /nyung la mngon par dga' ba dang / /dgon par mngon par phyogs pa dang / /gzhan yang gcig pur dga' ba dang / /dran mi nyams dang rtag tu ni/ /gtong dang tshul khrims phyogs dga' dang / /chad pa lugs kyi bstan bcos sogs/ /gang yang rol mo'i bstan bcos dang / /'jig rten rgyang 'phen phye pa dag gi/ /bstan bcos kun ni yongs spong ba'o/ /de dag ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //drag shul can gyis zhus pa las/ /khyim sogs nyes pa'i phung por ni/ /mthong nas thos pa ldan pa yis/ /de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /khyim gnas rmongs pa 'di ni bu dang nor dang chung ma la sogs pa/ /dga' ba'i spyor bas sems g.yengs gyur pas rab tu zhi ba ga la 'gyur/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas 64—1541

rnams kyi rga dang 'chi med zhi zhing mtshungs med pa'i/ /go 'phang bdag gzhan phan pa phun tshogs gnas gyur pa yang 'thob ①'gyur ram/ /nor dang chung ma bdag nyid zhes pa 'chi ④ba dam pa'i gsum po 'di/ /zhen pa med cing lhan cig skyes pa rtogs pa'i gnas la gnas pa ste/ /'di rnams la ni gang zhig gang tshe gang gis ji ltar skye bar 'gyur/ /min pas snying po med pa nyid du shes pa'i dpyod pa de 1 stobs ldan/ /thos pa ldan yang rnyed sogs la/ /zhen na sems sbyong mi 'gyur te/ /de tshe lhar bcas 'jig rten na/ /de ni gcig tu bslus pa'i mchog /ji ltar rgya mtsho chen por khyer ba yi/ /mi shes skye bo skom pas dus byed ltar/ /de bzhin dal 'byor thob nas skad cig kyang / /sems ma sbyangs na 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis byis pa rnams ni 'thab mos bskrad pa ma yin te/ /gang phyir mkhas pa rnams ni snying rjes bkur ster byas nas de dag gtong / /de bzhin sdug pa rnams la dang po mtshungs par bde ba nyer bstan nas/ /slar yang dgra byed gang yin de dang lhan cig dga' bar ga la 'gyur/ /de phyir nyon mongs spangs pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten pa dang 'dre ba yang ④/ /de dag nyid ni sems can gyi⑪/ /dge ba mngon par 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /yang ni gal te skal mi mnyam pa'i sems can gyi/ /tshogs la rjes su chags las 'khor 'dod yid 'byung zhing / /rnyed dang grags pa'i rgyu phyir 'dud par gyur na ni/ /nags 'di yang ni khyem dang khyad par med min nam/ /bsod snyoms rgyu ba'i yul dag dang / /shin tu ring ba ma yin zhing / /nye ba yang ni ma yin pa'i/ /nags de dag tu gnas bya ste/ /yul gang na ni dri ma srog chags las byung ba'i/ /skyon dang bral ba'i chu dag kyang ni yod pa dang / /64—1542

gang na 'bras bu'i lcid kyis dud pa'i shing yod cing / /gdug pa'i sbrul dag dang ni bral ba'i phug yod pa/ /de ru 'di ni nyin dang mtshan du yang ni gsung rab 'don pa dang / /slar sngags gang yin de ni slar yang rigs pa'i tshogs kyis dpyod par byed/ /de nas bsod nams las byung mtshan ma rnams ni 'dzin par byed gyur cing / /bying dang rgod pa'i dug dang bral bas rang gi sems la dga' ba bskyed/ /rgyal po 'am ni rgyal bu 'am/ /bram ze'am blon po la sogs pa/ /dge slong dgon pa pa dag gi/ /drung du 'ongs par gyur na ni//des ni de la gus pa yis/ /legs par byin nam zhes bya dang / /ji ltar bshams pa'i stan dag la/ /rang gis mkhyen bzhin bzhugs zhes bya/ /rgyal po 'greng na rang stan la① / /bdag nyid kyang ni 'greng bya la/ /bzhugs na 'dug par byas nas ni/ /dga' bar byed pa'i gtam bya ste/ /skal ldan khyod kyi yul du ni/ /thos mang tshul khrims ldan pa yi/ /dge sbyong bram ze la sogs pa/ /rtag par bde bar gnas lags zhes/ /gal te brtan ⑤zhing dul ba dang / /dbang po kun ni zhi gyur na/ /las dang rjes su mthun 'byung ba—/ /rnam smin bcas pa'i gtam bya'o/ /gal te rgyal po yid byung ldan/ /yid byung rjes mthun grubarjod pa 'am/ /zab dang rgya che'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni che brjod na④/ /byang chub sems dpa' nags phyin na/ /yid ⑤ni 'di ltar bsam bya ste/ /bdag ni khyem gye gnas spangs nas/ /ci yod ⑥don du nags su 'ong / /lha la sogs pas mchod bya'i dge slong go 'phang ni—/ /gal te nags su gnas pa tsam gyis 'dir 'byung na/ / nags na rgyu ba'i spre'u dang chom rkun seng ge rnams/ /de dag kyang ni dge sbyong go 'phang yon 64—1543

tan gyis brgyan 'gyur/ /gzhan yang nga rgyal khengs pa'i yongs su gdung ba dang / /ser sna sdang chags rtag tu 'jigs mang dang / /reg gzugs ro dang dri yis ①'jigs pa dang / /phung po bdud kyis zhu'ajigs pas 'dar ba dang / /nyon mongs bdud kyis 'jigs pa'i ①mes gdungs shing / /lha yi bdud kyis 'jigs pas de bzhin skrag /'chi bdag bdud kyis pyayang yang bltas pa yis/ /da lta bdag ni nags su 'ongs min nam/ /de phyir nags su gnas pa 'di/ /bdag nyid dbe+en pa'i phyir bsten nam/ /ji ltar bdag la 'jigs rnams yod/ /de ni ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni 'jigs pa rnams kyi rgyu/ /'jig tshogs lta ba gcig pu nyid/ /gang phyir 'jigs pa thams cad ni/ /de las kun du 'byung ba yin/ /ma rig nyer ⑤bslad 'khrul pa dang / /gnyis sbyor bdag tu rig pa rnams/ /phyin ci log las kun byung tshib/ /'jig tshogs lta ba'i rnam grangs so/ /gzugs sogs phung po lnga rnams la/ /bdag ces yang dag mi 'dzin pa'i/ /'jig tshogs lta ba rtsa ba ni/ /srid pa'i lcug dze+em 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /de phyir 'jigs pa kun gcad lduphyir/ /bdag tu zhen pa spangs pa la/ /da ni bdag gis bstan pa ru//rab tu 'thad pa dag tu bya/ /dgon pa chen por gnas pa yi/ /ljon shing gel pa lcug ma sogs/ /de dag su la'ang mi 'jigs na/ /bdag ni de las lhag par sngar/ /'di na 'ga' zhig bdag gam ni/ /skyes bu 'am ni gang zag gam/ /shed las skyes sam shed bu 'ang ⑨/ /tshad mas dpyad na yod ma yin—/ /de ltar 'jigs pa dag gi rgyu/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog 'di/ /de phyir lung dang tshad ma yi/ /mig gis ⑩de nyid gzhom par bya/ /gzhan yang /64—1544

dbye ba med pa'i chos rnams la/ /'byed 'di tshul bzhin ma yin pa/ /tshul bzhin ma yin rkyen ①can te/ /de yang skye ba med pa'i dngos/ /gzhan yang 'dir ni dgon gnas pa/ /chos rnams kun la 'dre med de/ /ma 'dres rab tu mi gnas dang / /dpyod sno med rjes su 'dzin byed pa'o/ /gal te yon tan ma thob par/ /gcan gzan khro bo nyer 'ongs nas/ /'jigs pa spangs pa lce/bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /des ni 'di ltar sems gdul bya/ /sngar ni sems can don bsgrub phyir/ /lus 'di bdag gis byabatang ba yin/ /sbyin pa byin nas mi shes pas/ /de la ji ltar bdag gdung byed/ /gang las kyang 'jigs mi bya ste/ /rang gi nyes byas kyis 'jigs bya/ /gang phyir 'jigs kun 'di las te—/ /thams cad de yi sprul par gsal/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa dag /ji ltar bdag med gel pa dang / /lcug ma la sogs skye /spudang ni/ /'jig byu'agyur de bzhin bdag gi yang / /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa yi/ /rgyu dang rkyen ni tshogs pa las//rtswa dang 'khri shing skye ba dang / /'jig pa de bzhin bdag gi yang / /skye dang 'jig ste don dam min/ /de dag ni dgon pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa'o// //nags tshal nyid la brten nas ni/ /ting nge 'dzin la sbyar bya ste/ /gang phyir mi g.yeng med par 3 ni/ /'jig rten phun tshogs kyang med pas/ /dang por 'dun pa'i ming can gyi/ /sems bskyed khrunye bar bzung nas ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /gnod pa spang spuphyir 'bad par bya/ /'di ltar/ spyod yul gzugs ni mthong ba na/ /brnab sems yid mi bde ba 'am—/ /gzhan yang mi dge ba yi chos/ /sems la skad cig byung gyur na/ /64—1545

de tshe bsdams phyir de dag gi/ /mig gi dbang pos tshar gcad bya/ /tshar gcad pa ni mtshan ma dag /gsal bar rjes su gzung las byung / /de bzhin rna ba sna dang ni/ /lce dang lus kyi dbang po rnams/ /rtag tu sems ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /so so dag tu bsdam ①par bya/ /sad pa dang ni nyal ba dang / /'dug dang 'gro dang smra ba dang / /mi smra gyur dang kun du yang / /mnyam par gzhag pa 'dor mi bya/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bstod smad dang / /bde dang sdug dang snyan mi snyan/ /yid bde byed dang gzhan pa rnams/ /sprul pa bzhin du bsam par bya/ /des na zhu'adi ni mi rgod cing / /lus zhi sems ni ma 'khrul zhing / /rtag tu dbang po mi g.yeng zhing / /spyod lam dge ba'i spyod yul dang / /dmigs pa gsal bar rgyu ba ni/ /gang tshe sems la ma mthong zhing / /bying na gzengs ni bstod pa'i phyir/ /yid la dga' ba bsgom par bya/ /rgod pa 'jig rten chos rnams la/ /gal te bdag med pa skyes na/ /kun mkhyen kyis gsungs mi rtag pa/ /myur du mngon du bya ba dang / /gnyi ga'i don du gnyen po ni/ /rnyed dka' dal ba phun tshogs pa/ /dran bya de bzhin bskal pa ni/ /bye bar rnyed dka'i rgyal byung ba'o/ /gzhan yang sdug dang phrad pa 'di ni nyi ma 'ga' zhig dag tu bde ster te/ /phyis ni dran par gyur nas mtshungs pa med pa'i gdul ldub skyed byed pa/ /de bzhin skye dang skye bar dran pa'i yul du gyur nas 'jig rten pa/ /ji ltar srid pa'i 'khrul pa spong bar mi nus 'gyur ba de ltar byed/ /rga dang nad dang 'chi bdag rgud pa zhes bya bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /gnod pa chen por skrag pa'i yid kyis nyin mtshan so so dran bya ste/ /gang phyir nad kyis bde dang 'chi bdag gis ni srog ni 'phrog byed cing / /rgud las phun 64—1546

tshogs nyams byed lang tsho dag ni rga ba dag gis so/ /gnad rnams gcod par byed pa dang / /grogs med gcig pur gyur pa dang / /'jig rten 'di ni yongs spangs shing / /'jig rten gzhan du 'pho 'gyur te/ /'chi bdag khar ni zhugs pa la/ /dge ba'i las las ①gzhan pa yi/ /chung ma nor dang grogs dang gnyen/ /srung bar byed pa yod ma yin/ /snabs dang kha chu dri ma gcin gos shing / /dbugs kyi lhag ma 'dzin par byed pa'i lus/ /yang srid pa ni dmigs par byed pa na/ /legs byas ma gtogs skyob byed 'ga' thuyod min/ /grang bas nyen la me dang ni/ /skom pas nyen la chu ji bzhin/ /ji ltar ngal la grib ma ste/ /de bzhin chos ni gzhan dag kyang / /de phyir skyes bu rnams kyi 'khor dang nor dang lang tsho dag /glog dang mtshungs par mthong nas 'jig pa'i chos can du/ /skye dang ldan pas ma lus de ltar rtogs rjunas ni/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba 'jigs ④las grol phyir 'bad par bya/ /yang ni g.yeng ba chen po'i rgyu/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /byams pa h+yerten 'byel bsgom pa ste/ /rtag tu sgyu spyoyang spong byed cing / /gnyen po yang ni bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags dag ni skye ba'i rgyu/ /bud med gcig pu kho na'o/ /mi sdug bsgom pa gang zhe na/ /mi gtsang la sogs 'du shes kyis/ /mgo bo nas ni rkang pa'i bar/ /gang zhig bsnyus nas spyod pa ste/ /'di ltar skra dang ba spu dang / /sen mo so dang pags pa rtsa/ /sha rus rgyus pa snying dang mchin/ /rgyu ma zhag dang dri ma dang / /gzhungs pa mchi ma chu ser rngul/ /tshil dang snabs dang glo ba dang / /glad pa dang ni glad rgyas dang / /gcin dang rnag dang khrag dag gis/ /dang po 'di dag la rmongs pa'i/ /shes rab 'chal pa 64—1547

gzhan dag ni/ /gcig la sogs pa rlom pa las/ /dge ba dga' bar ga la 'gyur—/ /'byung ba bzhi las grub pa'i rang gi lus po 'di la slar yang ni/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung zhes so so dag tu rtog byed la/ /de nas ji ltar sna tshogs 'bru yis gegang ba'i phur ma bzhin/ /de bzhin lus 'di yang ni brtan pa'i blo yis rnam par blta bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni dur khrod zhugs nas su/ /gang tshe ro yi ngo bo yongs su lta byed pa/ /de tshe des ni nyin zhag 'das las byung ba yi/ /rul ladangos dag tu rang gi lus dang mtshungs par rtog /shin tu 'phongs ④gdangs kha ni zangs ltar gyur pa yi/ /sa steng ltung bar gyur pa'i ro yi lus po ni/ /srid pa'i bde la zhen pa'i sems ldan mi rnams la/ /rang gi mi sdug dngos po ston par byed pa 'dra/ /de dag ni 'dod chags la kun du spyod pa'i gnyen po'o// //gzhan la phan dang bde sred dang / /'dod dang smon dang dga' ba yi/ /rnam pa 'dir skye gang yin pa'i/ /byams de rnam gsum du dbye ste/ /de la sems can la dmigs shing / /chos la dmigs pa yang ni gzhan/ /ngang gis ④'byung zhing dmigs med pa/ /byams pa chen po rab tu gsungs/ /dang po'i sems la dang po ste/ /gzhan ni spyod la dga' ba yin/ /dmigs pa med pa mi skye ba'i/ /chos la bzod thob spyod yul lo/ /de dag kun la goms bya'i phyir—/ /bsgom bya'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /de la dang po sdug pa bzhin/ /bar ma rnams la bsgom par bya/ /gang phyir sdug bzhin shes pa ni/ /lhag ma rnams la skye bar 'gyur/ /de tshe goms pa phyi nas yang / /dgra yi phyogs la bsgom par bya/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor pa yis phyini/ /phyogs gcig tu ni dgra 64—1548

dag kyang / /grogs po bzhin du snang gyur na/ /de tshe phyogs kun la bsgom bya//ji ltar sems can la dmigs pa/ /bsgoms rmye las nye ba skye 'gyur ba'i/ /ngal ba chos la dmigs pa dag /la sogs pa ni yod ma yin/ /de bzhin du/gal te rang gi dge ba skye bo gzhan rnams kyis/ /bde gshegs nyid thob bya phyir yongs su sngo byed na/ /de yi byams pa 'di ni shin tu mchog 'gyur zhing / /rang gi byang chub sems ni rdo rje ltar brtan /mibyed/ /gzhan yang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi dge ba dang / /de bzhin rgyal sras dang ni sems can gzhan gyi yang / /de dag ma lus pa yang 'gro ba srid pa'i btson ra yiṭu bcings pa grol bar bya phyir yongs su sngo byed pa/ /sna tshogs snying rje'i snying po can/ /yongs su bsngo ba gang dag yin/ /de kun byams pa nyid kyi ni/ /rjes su 'jug par the tshom med/ /de dag ni zhe sdang la kun du spyod pa'i gnyen po'o// //gzhan yod pa la brten nas ni/ /me long gi ni gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gang gi dngos po snang gyur pa/ /de la rang dngos ga la yod/ /de phyir rkyen las byung ba yi/ /dngos bo rnams ni dngos med nyid/ /rang gi mtshan nyid ma skyes pa/ /stong nyid shin tu zab pa nyid/ /dngos po de dag mi spong zhing / /des kyang dngos po mi spong ste/ /med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir/ /gre dang sreg par byed pa bzhin/ /rten 'byel yan lag bcu gnyis 'di/ /phyi ma phyi ma 'bras bu dang / /snga ma snga ma rgyu yin par/ /ma rig la sogs rim shes bya/ /ma rig pa ni gang zhe na/ /yang dag min pas khams lnga la/ /gcig dang bdag dang rtag sogs su/ /ma rig skye ba gang yin pa'i/ /'du byed yul ni 'di dag la/ /'dod chags la sogs 'jug pa'o/ /rnam shes 'di las skyes 64—1549
