pa yi/ /dngos po brtags ①pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /gzugs min phung po bzhi dang ni/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi rnams la/ /gcig tu mngon par bsdus pa nyid—/ /'di la ming dang gzugs zhes brjod/ /de skyes mig la sogs pa ni//skye mched drug gi ming can no/ /gsum rnams 'dus pa dag la ni/ /reg pa zhes su mngon par brjod/ /reg pa stsong ba ma lus pa'i/ /bde sogs rnam pa'i rang bzhin can/ /tshor ba zhen pa sred pa ste/ /de ni 'dod pa'i rnam pa'o / /sred pa nyid ni 'phel ba la/ /len pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /len pa las ni srid pa ste/ /de la phung po dngos 'byung skye/ /phung po rnyings ④pa rga ba ste/ /yang ni nyams pa 'chi ba'o/ /rang nyid ces las shi 'dod pas//nang gi gdung ba mya ngan te/ /bde ba dran pa las byung ba'i/ /smre ba gang yin smre sngags 'don/ /sdug bsngal rnam shes lnga po yi/ /lus 'byung kyemi bde tshor ba'o/ /de ltar mtha' gnyis las grol ba'i/ /rten cing 'byel ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sna tshogs mgal me'i ④'khor lo ltar/ /phan tshun rgyu yis 'khor ba yi/ /sā 3 lu ljang sogs mdo las ni/ /phyi dang nang gi dbye ba yis//rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba de/ /rnam pa gnyis su blta bya ste/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyi rgyu las ni/ /de ni slar yang rnam pa gnyis/ /de la dang po nang gi ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su dbye bya ste/ /ma rig la sogs phan tshun du/ /rgyu yi ⑥dngos por gnas pa dag /de ni rgyu yi rgyur ni 'dir/ /bdag gis ⑦gong du bshad zin to/ /yang ni rkyen gyi rgyu dag nyid/ /sa dang chu dang me dang ni/ /rlung dang nam mkha' rnam shes rnams/ /gcig tu 'dus par gyur pa ste/ /lus la sa khams gang zhe na/ /sra ba 'dzin pa gang yin pa'o/ /rlan la sogs pa rjes 64—1550

'dzin gang / /de ni chu yi khams su brjod/ /zos dang 'chos dang 'thungs pa dang / /thams cad rim gyis 'ju byed pa'i/ /lus 'di dro ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /de ni me yi khams su bshad/ /bya ba bdun la rab 'jug pa'i/ /dbugs 'byung rngub pa'i bya ba dang / /lus 'di la ni byed pa gang / /de ni rlung gi khams su bstan①/ /lus 'di la ni yongs mthong ba'i/ /gang gi stong pa'i rang bzhin gang / /kun gyi go skabs 'byed pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i khams zhes rjod ②par byed/ /rnam shes khams ni gang zhe na/ /'dir ni zag bcas yid gang dang / /de bzhin rnam shes lnga yi ni/ /tshogs na zhukun du sbyor ba'o/ /ming dang gzugs kyi myu gu yi/ /sa bon ngo bor gnas pa yi/ /nang gi bdag nyid rang bzhin la/ /rkyen gyi rgyu zhes brjod pa yin/ /de bzhin du/ rnam shes sa bon rang bzhin te/ /las ni zhing gi rang bzhin no/ /sred pas rnam shes rlan byed de/ /ma rig pa ni sa bon 'debs/ /las ni 'di ltar bdag gi ④ni/ /'du byed las byung rang bzhin kyi/ /rnam shes sa bon dag bya dang / /zhing gi bya ba byas mi sems/ /sred pa'ang 'di ltar bdag gis ni/ /rnam shes rlan zhes shes pa med/ /ma rig pa yang 'di ltar bdag /sa bon de ni gdab mi sems/ /sa bon rnam shes de la yang / /rkyen 'di dag gis 'bad pa yis/ /bdag ni bskyed pa yin zhes pa'i/ /de lta'i shes pa yod spyom yin/ /'on kyang rnam shes sa bon ni/ /las kyi zhing gis brten pa dang / /srid pa'i rlan kyis brlan pa dang / /sa bon ma rig gis btab pas/ /skye ba de dang de dag dang / /rim pa de dang de dag gis/ /ma yi dkur ni dus kyis su/ /ming gzugs myu gu bskyed pa ni/ /bdag las 64—1551

ma yin gzhan las min/ /dbang phyug gis kyang sprul min la/ /ming dang gzugs kyi myu gu 'di/ /rgyu med las kyang skye ba min/ /de ltar bdag med chos rnams ni/ /sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid dag tu 'byung / /rgyu dang rkyen ni tshogs pa las/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung 'gyur te/ /mig dang gzugs dang snang ba dang / /de bzhin nam mkha' de skyed yin/ /rgyu lnga dag ni tshogs pa las/ /mig gi rnam shes 'byung 'gyur la/ /rkyen 'di dag ni med pa na/ /mig 1gi rnam shes 'byung min ming ༄bye/ /'di dag so so dag la ni/ /btsal na rnyed pa ma yin no/ /de ltar dbang po lhag ma las/ /skyes pa rnam shes rim pa 'di/ /nam mkha' 'ja' tshon dag mtshungs par/ /rkyen ma rig las shes par bya/ /yang ni rkyen las byung ba de/ /mtshan nyid lnga ru shes bya ste/ /rtag dang chad dang bral ba dang / /de bzhin 'pho ba spangs pa dang / /yang ni rgyu ni chung ba las / /'bras bu chen por 'byung ba dang / /'dra ba dag dang ldan pa yi/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu 'byung ba'o/ /gang phyir skye ba la phyogs pa'i/ /phung po dag ni 'chi ba la/ /phyogs pa 'byung ba de yi phyir/ /rtag pa min par 'di shes bya/ /chad min gang phyir phung po rnams/ /rgyu rnams yod pa dag dang ni/ /med pa dag las skyed min phyir/ /srang mda'i mthon byedaman ci bzhin no/ /gang phyir chophung po rigs mthun phyir/ /slar yang skye ba gzhan du ni/ /rigs mi mthun par skye 'gyur ba/ /de phyir 'pho ba las kyang min/ /gang phyir las chung byas pa las/ /'bras bu chen po 'byung 'gyur te/ /de phyir rgyu ni chung ngu las—/ /'bras bu chen por 'byung dze+eb yin/ /gang phyir ci 'dra'i las byas pa/ /de yi gzugs brnyan mi 'dor ba/ /de 'dra'i rgyu ni 'byung bas na/ /des na 64—1552

rgyu dang 'dra bar brjod/ /chos gang 'jig rten 'di nas ni/ /gzhan du 'phel ba 'ga' med kyang / /'on kyang las dang 'bras bu dang rmye// /yod pa ru ni brtags pa yin/ /ma rig len pa sred pa zhes/ / byas pa lanyon mongs bsdus pa ste/ /'du byed srid pa zhes bya ba/ /las kyi ming du shes par bya/ /rnam shes ming dang gzugs dang ni/ /de bzhin skye dang reg pa dang / /rga shi dang ni lhag ma dag /sdug bsngal ming can 'du shes bya/ /stong pa nyid ni ston pa che/ /'og nas ston par 'gyur bas na/ /zlos pa'i skyon du thal 'gyur phyir/ /phyi yi mtshan nyid ma bstan to/ /gang gis 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rkyen las byung ba ru/ /ji lta ba bzhin 'di dag shes rab kyis rtogs pa/ /phra ba'i blo ldan de yis de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /kun gzhi dag dang yang dag ldan pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /'di dag ni gti mug la kun du spyod pa'i gnyen po'o// //de ltar sems ni las rung bas/ /lus dang tshor ba nyid dang ni/ /sems dang de bzhin chos rnams la/ /dran pa nyer gzhag gus pas byebasgom/ /rkang lag byen pa brang dang sum mdo mgrin pa phrag pa lto ba brang / /'gram pa rgyab dang nang khrol dang ni mgo bo'i tshogs rnams 'dus pa'i lus 'di ni/ /de bzhin slar yang kun nas nyon mongs so so'i dug can gnas su gyur pa 'di/ /mi rtag pa zhes ku sha'i tse ④'dra'i blo can rnams kyis legs pa'i don du spyadadze+e/ /yang dag min la brtags las gzhan/ /lus po 'di ni sngon gyi mtha'/ /gang zhig nas kyang 'ong ba yin/ /phyi ma'i mtha' yang 'gro min pas/ /thog ma tha 64—1553

ma dbus rnams su/ /gang yang gnas pa med par brtag /des na rtsad nas med pa yilku/ /lus po 'di la yongs 'dzin med/ /de ltar cha yi tshogs 'di la/ /lus po don dam du med pas/ /mkhas pas lus po nam mkha' bzhin/ /rjes su dran pa rtag par gzhag /de yang 'jig rten pa yi tha snyad du/ /grub pa'i lus po dang ni phung po dang / /khog pa dang ni gnas 'di zhes bya ba/ /'di dag ma lus glo bur ba yin no/ /lus la rjes dran bsgom ④pa las sems can rnams kyi lus gzhan la/ /rang lus dang mtshungs bstan ①pa ru/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'du shes skye/ /snying po med pa'i lus po las④/ /lus dang longs spyod snying po dang / /de bzhin 'tsho ba'i snying po ste/ /snying po gsum ni ⑤blang bar bgyi⑥/ /bdag gi lus 'di mi rtag ces/ /sems can rnams kyi ④slob ma ru/ /'gyur bar bsgrub pa gang yin pa/ /de la lus kyi snying por brjod / /lus gsob yin phyir longs spyod la/ /gang zhig dga' bar mi byed pa/ /de ni thams cad gtong dang ldan/ /de yis longs spyod snying po 'thob / /snying po med pa'i lus dran na/ /'tsho ba'i don du bdag nyid kyis//sdig pa'i las rnams byed min pa/ /de yis 'tsho ba'i snying po 'thob/ /lus 'di rtag tu yongs su ma bskyangs na/ /'phel mi nus pas byis pa rnams dang mtshungs—/ /khang pa rnying pa dang mtshungs lus po 'di/ /'bad pas legs par bskyangs nas gzung bar bya/ /bka' stsal mang bas rgyal po rnams dang mtshungs—/ /slu bar byed pa'i rang bzhin grib ma bzhin/ /shin tu 'bad pa'i sgo nas gzem dgos pas/ /lus 'di so ma btang ba'i bum pa mtshungs/ /chu bo chen po tshogs kyi rgyun 'bab bzhin/ /lus kyi tha ma 'chi ba'i mtsho la 64—1554

gtugs—/ /mdung thung bzhin du sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /rtag tu phan mi byed pas dgra dang mtshungs/ /nam yang yid ches rdul phran tsam gyi yang / /gnas med pas na rkun ma rnams dang mtshungs/ /reg pa'i bsran 1mi bzod pas rma dang mtshungs/ /sgyu ma bzhin du stong pa'i bdag nyid yin/ /ji ltar 'o ma yis ni bkrus gyur kyang / /sol ba nam sdeyang dkar por 'gyur ma yin/ /gtsang zhing dag pas byi dor byas gyur kyang / /de ltar lus kyi rang bzhin 'dor byemi byed/ /des na bdag po med pa yi/ /'khrul 'khor lta bu'i lus po 'di/ /bza' btung sogs las byung ba'o/ /zhes rgyas par yang dang yang du brtag /de dag ni lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o// //de ltar rab tu bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /lus g.yeng rab tu zhi ba des/ /tshor ba dran pa nyer gzhag pa/ /brtan pa yis ni rnam par bsgom/ /de la log par mngon zhen las/ /tshor ba rnam pa gsum yin te/ /bde dang sdug bsngal dang gzhan ni/ /bde min sdug bsngal min rig bya/ /'di la tshor byed 'ga' med cing / /tshor ba'i dngos po ④yod min pas/ /rten cing 'byel ba las byung ba'i/ /tshor ba 'di ni bdag med pa'o/ /de ltar nam mkha'i dngos gyur pa/ /gang zhig la ni zhen byed pa/ /de ni rmongs pas chu nang gi/ /zla ba len par 'dod pa yin/ /de bzhin snyug bsngal gyis gdungs pa/ /gang zhig phyir zhing 'joms byed pa/ /de ni rmongs pas mig nang gi/ /gzugs brnyan kha la 'o byed yin/ /rmongs pa gang zhig bde min zhing / /snyug bsngal yang min rig pa ste phye/ /'gro tshe rtsa la reg pa la/ /gzung ⑥bar mngon par 64—1555

rlom dang mtshungs/ /gzhan yang tshor ba thams cad la/ /ming gzhan du byas 'khor ba ste/ /chos yang dag par bsdus pa'i mdor/ /kun mkhyen rang nyid kyis gsungs pa/ /nyer len dang ni phyin ci log /nye bar dmigs dang yongs su 'dzin/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed pa/ /tshor ba yin zhes nges par gsungs/ /'di ltar gang tshe sdug bsngal gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' la reg pa/ /de tshe sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa'i/ /sems can rnams la brtse bas dmigs/ /gang gi tshe na thugs rje can/ /tshor ba bde ba myong byed pa/ /de tshe chags pas gdungs rnams la/ /de yi brtse ba cher drag skye/ /gang tshe bde min sdug bsngal min/ /rgyal ba'i sras pos pyong byed pa/ /de tshe rmongs par bying rnams la/ /'di yi brtse ba shas cher 'phel/ /'ga' zhig byang chub sems dpa' la/ /mngon du gyur par skye gyur pa①/ /de nyid kyi tshe dmigs med pas/ /dmigs pa byas pa lta bur skye/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa yin pas na//tshor ba nyid la sred par brjod/ /gang tshe de nyid mi gnas pa/ /de tshe mya ngan 'das par brjod/ /de dag ni tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o// //de ltar gus par tshor ba la/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bsgom byas te/ /de yi rjes la 'bad pa yis/ /sems rjes dran pa nyer gzhag bsgom/ /mi gtsang gtsang bar 'du shes pas/ /sems ni sbrang ma rnams dang mtshungs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed pas na/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo dang yang mtshungs/ /'dod pa sngar bag yud tsam la/ /bde ba nyid du 'du shes dang / /mchil pa'i gzan la chags pa yi/ /nya yi lce dang de yang mtshungs/ /gzhan dag rnams la glags tshol phyir/ /mdangs 'phrog gnod sbyin dang yang mtshungs/ /64byed1556

dge ba'i nor rnams 'phrog pa'i phyir/ /de ni chom rkun dang yang mtshungs/ /sems ni skad cig nyid tsam gyis/ /'jig ⑫pa'i phyir na glog dang mtshungs/ /rkyen la rag las skyes pa'i zhuphyir/ /mar me'i 'od kyi rgyun dang mtshungs/ /sems ni sdod pa ma yin pas/ /chu bo chen po'i rgyun dang mtshungs/ /nyon mongs glo bur ba rnams kyi/ /bsgribs 1pas sems ni mkha' dang mtshungs/ /'di ltar gzugs la dmigs nas gzugs rnams la/ /dga' ba phye ma leb kyi mig dang mtshungs/ /sgra la dga' bas sems ni mngon pa yi/ /klu ④la snyan pa'i e na ⑤ ya dang mtshungs/ /sems ni mar nag snod kyis reg pa la/ /dga' bas chags pa'i sbrang ma rnams dang mtshungs/ /ro la dga' bas zas kyi lhag ma la/ /brkam zhing chags pa'i bran mo rnams dang mtshungs/ /dri la dga' bas mi gtsang phung po la/ /shugs drag rgyug pa'i phag phrug rnams dang mtshungs—/ /de lta na yang brtags shing dpyad pa na/ /sems de gang nas kyang ni rnyed ma yin/ /'das pa'i sems ni 'gags ⑥ pa yin pas med/ /ma 'ongs sems ni ma thob pas yod min/ /da ltar gnas pa bcings nas yod min te/ /gang ltar yang de tshad ma'i dpyad byar med/ /sems de shin tu 'bad pas btsal gyur kyang / /'das pa yod min da lta ba yang med/ /ma 'ongs pa yang yod min de ltar na/ /de ni dus gsum dag las 'das par 'dod—/ /gang zhig dus gsum las ni 'das pa de/ /yod pa nyid ma yin zhing med pa'ang min/ /de ltar mtha' gnyis las ni rnam grol ba/ /de ni gang gi'ang spyod yul ma yin no/ /sems ni gang na'ang dga' med cing / /gang na'ang mi dga' yod min te/ /nam mkha' bzhin du ma skyes pa/ /sun 64—1557

phyung ma yin rmongs bya min/ /sbar yang 'di yi rang bzhin 'bad btsal na/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams la ni/ /gang yang gang du'ang nam yang ma mthong ba'i/ /sems kyi rgyun de 'dod par bya ba'am ci/ /dmigs pa las ni sems skye ba/ /re zhig 'di ltar brtag bya ste/ /dmigs pa las ni tha dad dam / /tha mi dad ces yongs su brtag /tha dad mngon par khas len na/ /khams gsum thams cad sems med 'gyur/ /tha mi dad na bdag nyid la/ /nang gi bya ba bzlog ①par dka'/ /'dzub byemo'i rtse mo de nyid kyis/ /de nyid la reg nus ma yin/ /de bzhin ral gri'i so de yis/ /de nyid gcod par nus ma yin/ /legs par basbabs kyang rang nyid kyis/ /phrag pa la ni 'gong min ltar/ /sems kyis ①sems ni reg min zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /drag la 'khor zhing 'tshubs pa'i rlung dmar ltar/ /yid kyi rgyu ba shin tu rtogs dka' 'di/ /gang gis ④de las bde gshegs dpal 'byung ba'i/ /zhi gnas la ni 'bad pas rnam par bsgrubs/ /rtse gcig rnam par ma 'phros dang / /ma yengs pa dang rab tu zhi/ /zhi gnas kun du gnas pa'o zhes/ /sems rjes dran pa rgyas par bsgom/ /sems kyi chos nyid mi spong thuzhing / /de bzhin rnam par sbyong ba'ang min/ /sems 'di sgyu ma lta bu zhes/ /bya ba sems kyi chos nyid do/ /gang dag dngos kun yongs btang nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du yongs dag par/ /rab tu bsngo ba de rang gi/ /sems kyi rnam par spyor bar gsungs/ /de dag ni sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o// //de ltar sems rjes dran pa nyer gzhag labhu/ /yang dag gnas nas chos dran nyer gzhag bsgom/ /de ni mdor na chos rnams thams cad la/ /spong 64—1558

len spangs nas 'bad med rtogs pa yin/ /nyon mongs rnams la yang dag tu snang ba/ /'dod chags yod min zhe sdang yod ma yin/ /gti mug yod min zhi ba yod ma yin/ /'dus pa yod min phung po'ang yod ma yin/ /de ltar rtogs pas don dam du spyad ①na/ /kun nyon mongs med rnam byang yod min pa//de ltar chos rnams yin zhes nges pa gang / /de 'dir chos rjes dran par yang dag brjod/ /de ltar chos rnams sus thos pa/ /de yis chos dang sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub dang ni lam rnams dang / /chos kun tha dad mthong ma yin//slar yang nyon mongs kun la 'di/ /bcos ma'i 'du shes skyed byed pa/ /de bzhin chos gzhan rnams la yang / /sgyu ma'i rnam par rab tu brtag /nges 'byed ②de bzhin nyid kyi bcud kyis ni/ /phug nas chos rnams thams cad yongs su rtog /rab rib sgrib pa ma lus rnams ①spangs pa/ /de ni thugs rje chen pos rgyan du byed/ /ji ltar me dang 'bru mar sdong bu dang / /kong ④bu rnams las mi yis me mar mthong / /de ltar rkyen rnams las ⑤skyes chos rnams la / /stong nyid snying po can zhes tha snyad byed/ /chos rnams thams cad mdor bsdu na/ /phung po khams dang skye mched de/ /rkyen la rag las skye bzhin du/ /'pho ba spangs nas yod ma yin/ /ji ltar rgya la brten nas ni/ /gang du rgya yi rjes mthong ba/ /rgya de 'phos pa ma yin zhing / /de med par yang med bzhin no/ /bdag dang gang zag shed bu gso ba po/ /srog dang shed skyes byed pa tshor ba po/ /gang yang cung zad mtha' gcig tu med pa'i/ /nyon mongs des gang 'ching byed grol bar byed/ /'di rnams thams cad ming gis stong pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams thams cad ming des stong pa yin/ /sna 64—1559

tshogs rang bzhin ming gis gang brjod pa/ /de ni kun rdzob bden par 'phags pas gsungs/ /rang bzhin gang zhig ming gis brjod pa de/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ma gsan gzigs ma yin/ /skye med 'gag pa med pa'i rang bzhin phyir/ /'jig rten 'di ni brda tsam las la min/ /de dag ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so// //de ltar sems las rung nas des/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /'gron ཿgdon pa yi zhubasam pa yis/ /stong nyid rab tu gsal byas pa'i/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa ni/ /mdo sde zla ba sgon ma las/ /yon tan rin chen gyis rab brtan/ /stong nyid mthong ba bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /bslab pa'i lam la nges par ldog ma yin/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dbang por gyur pas na//nam yang bud med dbang du 'gyur ma yin/ /yun mi ring bar lhar bcas 'jig rten 'dir/ /'di nyid rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /yang dag chos rnams nges par shes nas ni/ /ngan song du ni ltung bar mi 'gyur zhing //mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs pa dang / /mngon par shes pa lnga yang thob byepar 'gyur/ /chos rnams la bdag med pa dang / /de bzhin rang bzhin med pa dang / /las dang 'bras bu ji lta bar/ /'byel pa la yang 'gal ba med/ /byang chub sems kyi spyod pa dang / /mthong ba'i chos la 'gal med ces/ /de skad yab sras mjal ba las/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ④ gsungs/ /khams drug reg pa'i skye mched drug /yid kyis ⑤nye bar spyod pa ni/ /bco brgyad po rnams 'dus pa la(kye/ /re zhig skyes bu zhes brjod do/ /rnam shes nam mkha' rlung dang me/ /chu dang sa rnams ma lus pa/ /64byed1560

lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa yis/ /sna tshogs 'dzin par byed phyir khams//rnam par shes las skye zhes brjod/ /de ni rgyun du mched byed pa'i/ /mig la sogs pa rnam drug po/ /de dag skye mched du brjod do/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba'i mig la ni/ /reg pa'i skye mched du 'dod de/ /rang rang gis ① don gsal byed phyir/ /skye mched lhag ma'ang de bzhin no/ /mig la sogs pa rang rang gis/ /reg pa drug 'dir skyed par byed/ /so sor yid bde la sogs pa'i/ /dbye ba ④de ni rnam pa drug /de ltar yid kyi nye ba ni/ /spyod pa bco brgyad gsal bar brjod/ /'di rnams kun du tshogs pa dang / /'dus pa skyes bu zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig nang gi sra ba nyid/ /lus 'di la ni dmigs pa yi/ /sen mo so sogs dbye ba ni/ /nang gi sa yi khams yin no/ /gang yang phyi yi 'jam pa dang / /cung zad sra ba nyid mthong ba'i/ /sa 'dzin sogs byed gang yin pa/ /de ni spyi yi khams yin no/ /nang gi bdag nyid skye bzhin pa/ /'di ni gang nas kyang 'ongs min/ /de bzhin 'gag pa'i tshe na yang / /gang du'ang nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /de ltar bud med rnams kyis zhuslar—/ /nang du bud med nga zhes rtog /brtags nas slar yang phyi rol du/ /skyes pa'o zhes mngon par rlom/ /de nas yang dag chags sems de/ /skyes pa dang ni lhan cig tu/ /phrad par 'dod cing rtse ba dang / /za bar 'dod na shas cher spro/ /skyes pa'ang de bzhin nang 'di la/ /skyes pa'o zhes rtog byed cing / /ma rig stobs kyis bskyed pa yi/ /grong ba'i chos kyi 'dod pa 'byung //des na de gnyis bde ba ni/ /'dod pas dben par song nas ni/ /gang gis nur nur po bskyed ④ pa'i/ /sbyor ba de 'dra byed par 'gyur/ /de la 64—1561

brtags pa gang yin dang / /rtog pa las byung kun rtog gang / /yang dag min par brtags las gzhan/ /de dag rang bzhin gyis grub min/ /de bzhin mo la bud med med/ /skyes pa la yang skyes pa med/ /snyoms par 'jug na snyoms pa med/ /nur nur la yang nur nur med/ /nur nur rang bzhin med gyur pa/ /de tshe yang dag ji bzhin rig /de gnyis yod par ma gyur phyir/ /skye ba med pa yin zhes gnas/ /ma skyes pa yis ji ltar na/ /sra ba nyid ni skye bar 'gyur/ /des na yod min kun rtog las/ /sra nyid 'byung bar shes par bya/ /phyi rol kyi ni sa yi khams/ /lcags ri dang ni ri dbang po/ /ri bo mchog rab la sogs pa/ /'jig rten khams rnams ma lus pa'o/ /de yi srid pa nyid gang de/ /'ongs pa med cing 'gro ba med/ /khams yin no zhes 'jig rten pa'i/ /tha snyad byed pa tsam du zad/ /gang gi tshe na sa chen 'di—/ /me yis yongs su bsregs nas ni/ /chu rnams kyis ni rnam par bkrus—/ /rlung gis shin tu gtor gyur pa/ /de tshe mar nag bsregs ⑫pa 'am//mar gsar bsregs la rmye ji bzhin du/ /sdong ro yi ni phye ma 'am/ /thal rjes tsam yang med par rung / /de ltar sa yi khams kyi ni/ /skye ba stong pa nges pa ltar / /de bzhin gnas dang stongs pa yang / /rang bzhin nyid kyis stong pa yin/ /yang ni chu khams gang zhe na/ /lus kyi rdul dang mchi ma gcin/ /snabs mkhris khrag tshil 'o ma rnag /gzhan yang gsher ba gang yod pa'o/ /de la mya ngan zug rngu dang / /byams dang phrad las mchi ma 'byung / /bsod nams ldan pa la la la/ /chos kyi shugs kyis ④'byung ba yin/ /de yang gang nas kyang 'ongs min/ /bskams tshe gang du'ang song ba med/ /byung ngo 64—1562

bskams stiso zhes pa yang / /tha snyad 'jug pa tsam du bas/ /gang tshe sprin stug chu rgyun gyis/ /'jig rten 'di ni 'jig byed cing / /sa chen tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar/ /rgya mtsho gcig tu byas gyur pa/ /de tshe de 'dra'i chu yi tshogs—/ /gang zhig nas ni 'ongs par 'gyur/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis me yis ni//bskams nas brlag tshe gang du song / /gzhan la ltos dzu nas byung ba yi/ /khams gzhan rnams kyi skye ba dang / /gnas pa dang ni 'jig pa yang / /de ltar dngos med shes par bya/ /sa sogs 'byung ba bzhi po la/ /brten pa'i dang ba gang yin pa/ /mched ①cing 'di gsal byed pa'i phyir/ /mig gi skye mched du brjod do/ /sa yi khams kyi dang ba 'dir/ /mig gi skye mched du mi 'dod—/ /de bzhin chu dang me dang ni/ /rlung khams dang ba 'dod ma yin/ /de ltar de ni brtag bzod pa'i/ /mig gi skye mched 'ga' yang med/ /tha snyad tsam las ma gtogs pa/ /'di dag bya ba dang bral yin/ /khams rnams so so snang ba la/ /dang ba 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa'i phyir/ /dang ba de dngos gang zhig yin/ /des na mig gi skye mched la—/ /thog ma med cing tha ma med/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis na/ /gnas kyang dmigs pa ma yin no/ /gang zhig rang bzhin dang bral te/ /skyes pa ma yin bud med min/ /rlom sems rlom sems min pa yang / /rang bzhin gyis ni dgag ④ pa nyid/ /mdo rjes 'brangs nas rigs pa 'dis/ /rna ba sogs la'ang shes bya ste/ /de dag rnams kyi rtogs pa'ang mthar chos kyi dbyengs la thug phyir ro/ /mig ni yul gzugs las min thuzhes/ /gsungs pa yin pa de yi phyir/ /gzugs rnams nyid la dmigs pa'i mig /64—1563

gzugs rnams la ni thogs dang bcas/ /de ltar sgra la sogs pa la/ /dmigs pa'i rna ba la sogs pa/ /rang rang yul la thogs bcas zhes/ /yul dngos rim pas shes par bya/ /mthun pa la sogs dbye ba tha dad pa'i/ /gzugs rnams la ni dmigs par byed pa'i mig /mthun pa las ①ni sdug par 'du shes shing / /mi mthun pa la mi sdug par 'du shes/ /mthun pa ma yin mi mthun pa yang min/ /gzugs la btang snyoms tshul byas 'du shes te/ /de ltar yid kyis lduchos rab rim bzhin du/ /rang blo rab tu gsal ba las mtshon bya / /de ltar drug la so sor gsum gsum du/ /phye ba las 'dir yid kyis nye ba ru/ /spyod pa rab tu brtags pa'i yid kyis ni/ /nyes par spyod pa bco brgyad du gsungs so/ /de ltar khams sogs rang bzhin gyis/ /sgyu ma lta bur shes byas nas/ /kun la chags pa las grol ba/ /sprul pa'i glang chen bzhin du spyad/ /rmi lam gzhon nu ma dang phrad pa yi/ /dga' bde nyams pyong ①gnyid log sad pa'i tshe/ /'di na byes pa'i rigs can las gzhan min/ /de ltar zhen cing kun du chags pa des/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi dbye ba yis/ /'dod chags las ni rab tu skyes pa'i las/ /rnam pa bcu ni mngon par 'du byed do/ /gang zhig mngon par 'dus byas pa/ /de kun gdod nas rab mi gnas / /gang phyir phyi rol nang dag la④/ /ma brten pas na gnas pa med/ /gzhan yang ji ltar tha mar 'gag pa yi/ /rnam shes de ltar dang po'i rnam shes skyed—/ /las dang dmigs pa'i dbang por gyur pa ni/ /nyin mtshan 'gro ba rnams la so sor sbyar/ /rang bzhin mtshungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ /sems kyi rgyun ni rab tu 'jug na yang / /gang du bde dang sdug bsngal spyod pa yi/ /64—1564

rnam par smin pa yang dag myong bar byed/ /shes 'gag tha ma gang yin pa/ /de la 'chi 'phor 'dod pa yin/ /dang po'i rnam shes 'byung ba la/ /'dir ni skye bar 'dod pa'ang yin/ /de lta bas na shes pa'i dang po ni/ /skye ba'i tshe na gang nas kyang 'ongs min/ /de ni nges par 'gag pa'i tshe na yang / /gang du song ba'ang spungs nas yod ma yin/ /de ltar dang bo'i rnam shes dang / /las rnams kyis ni skye ba dag /rang bzhin stong phyir gang nas kyang / /'ongs pa'am gang du'ang song ba med/ /thog ma tha ma gnyis kyi ①ni/ /shes pa shes pa nyid kyis stong / /de bzhin du ni 'chi 'pho yang / /'chi 'pho'i rang bzhin nyid kyis stong / /de lta'ang bde sdug sogs kyi ni/ /dbye bas bkag pa med pa yirjo/ /sna tshogs las kun rnam smin dang / /so sor rig pa shes par byed/ /'jig rten pa yi spyod pa yi/ /ming dang brda tsam nyid las gzhan/ /yang dag brtag byar bzodra pa yi/ /byed po med cing za po med/ /ji ltar rmi lam spyod yul du/ /dgra dang g.yul ngor dgye 1nas ni/ /sad tshe zhen par gyur zhe na—/ /de 'di mkhas par brjod dam ci/ /de bzhin shes rab 'chal pa yi/ /rigs ④can mig gi spyod yul ni/ /yid mi bde bar brten pa la/ /bltas nas mngon zhen dang ldan 'gyur/ /de nas rab tu rlag pa yi/ /ngan pas 'dod chags las byung las/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis sngar bzhin du/ /slar yang mngon par 'du ⑤byed do/ /btang stoms gnas la bltas nas ni/ /gang zhig gzugs la zhen pa yi/ /rmongs pa de yis sngar bzhin du/ /las ni rnam bcu sog ⑥par byed/ /de bzhin so sor rnam pa gsum/ /sgra la sogs pa'ang shes par bya/ /gang gi rmi lam snang ba bzhin/ /snang ba 'di ni skye ba med/ /64—1565

kun rdzob dang ni don dam dbye ba yis/ /'dir ni bden pa rnam gnyis rgyal bas gsungs/ /stong nyid legs par mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces brjod/ /'jig rten pa yi spyod pa la/ /mgon pos 'jig rten kun rdzob gzigs/ /don dam sna tshogs shes pa yi①/ /spyod pa ④las ni shin tu 'das/ /rgyu med rnam par shes pa med/ /brda yod ma yin rten yod min/ /yung po lnga min de las gzhan/ /don dam pa yi mtshan nyid min—/ /shin tu zab par gyur don stong nyid de/ /rim gyis yang dag sgol ba'i rgyu mtshan nyid/ /'gro ba dang ba bskyed phyir 'di kun rdzob/ /thugs rje cher grags thub pa'i dbang pos snegasungs/ /gzhan yang rten med pas na 'jig rten pa'i/ /chos rnams kyis kyang dga' bar mi byed de/ /skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin brgyad po yis/ /stong nyid gang yin dngos su ston par byed/ /mdor na sems ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ /gzhan la gus par bya rngo dang / /bdag nyid la ni brnyas pa ste/ /gzhan yang 'di gnyis ④ 'bad pas bsgom/ /gzhan bde gzhan ni ma yin na/ /gzhan la dngos su brnyas ⑤byed ltar/ /gom 4pa gnyi ga de lta bur/ /nus par 'gyur ba dka' ba med/ /gal te rtag tu phung po rnams/ /mnyam pa nyid du yod 'dod na/ /de tshe gcig la bdag nyid dang / /gzhan nyid ji ltar sbyar bar bya/ /yod min pa yi dmigs pa la'ang / /de ltar yul can spyod pa ni/ /thog ma med pa nas rtogs nyupa/ /goms pa'i phyir na dka' byab med/ /chags la rag las skyes pa ni/ /khong khro rjes chags yin pa'i phyir/ /chags pa spangs las myur du ni/ /sems kyi dga' ba rab tu skye/ /gang la khong khro chags yod pa/ /de la gzhan 64—1566

la smod pa dang / /ser sna brkam chags nga rgyal sogs/ /thams cad 'bad med 'byung mi khegs①/ /de dag ni bdag gi lus dag pa'o// //yang dag 'tsho ba sbyangs pa yis/ /'dir ni longs spyod dag par 'dod//chos kyi longs spyod tshol ba ni/ /yang dag 'tsho ba sbyong ba ni/ /mkhas pas sbyin bdag las legs len pa ni④/ /rnyed pa'i don du spyod lam 'chos mi byed//gnya' shing gang tsam las ni mi blta zhing / /gom ④pa rim gyis bdal nas 'dor mi byed/ /byang chub sems dpas ngag kyang ④gcam bu dang / /'jam par phyebaskyungs shing nam yang smra mi byed/ /rnyed pa dang ni bkur ste'i don dag tu—/ /de ni mthun 'jug nam yang byed ma yin/ /tshig tu 'dod pa chung bar byas nas ni/ /sems la sred pa chen po skyed na ni/ /nang du gdung bar byed pa 'di las gzhan/ /'dir ni lhag pa yod pa ma yin no/ /rnyed pa dang ni bkur ste'i rgyu mtshan du/ /dbang po sdom par pyabyed pa tshul 'chos yin/ /rnyed pa dang ni bkur ste'i rgyu mtshan du/ /gsong por snyan par smra byed kha gsag yin—/ /tshul 'chos kha gsag spangs pa ni/ /'tsho ba dag pa nyid yin pas/ /g.yo zol sgyu bhuthabs spangs pa las/ /longs spyod dag par shes par bya/ /de dag ni longs spyod dag pa'o // //④gang tshe sbyin pa la sogs lnga/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /rnam pa kun nas byed gyur pa/ /de tshe bsod nams dag pa yin/ /rgyu dang ldan pa mtshan ma dang / /yid nyid rnam par dag pa dang / /bdag dang bdag gir byed pa rnams/ /dag pas sbyin pa dag pa yin/ /gtong ba'i tshe na yang dag 64—1567

rdzogs pa yi/ /kun mkhyen nyid du yongs su sngo byed cing / /'bras bu la ni phyogs par mi byed na/ /sbyin pa'i dag pa mkha' dang mnyam skyed yin/ /brtse bas gang sbyin sbyin pa dag pa yin/ /rang lag gis ①sbyin sbyin pa dag pa yin/ /gzhan phan gang sbyin sbyin pa dag pa yin/ /dug mtshon min gang sbyin pa dag pa yin / /'o na drag shul can zhus las/ /gang gis gang zhig gang gi tshe/ /mkho ba de la de sbyin zhes/ /gsungs pa dang ni 'gal zhe na/ /de min spyi mdo las gzhan par / /de ni bkag pa yin phyir ro/ /thugs rje ②can kyi sems can ni/ /bsdu bar bya phyir bkag pa gnang / /thugs rje dang ni ldan pa yis/ /dad pa bskyed du thabs gzhan med na/ /gang gis bsdu ba'i sems can la/ /mthong nas chang sogs sbyin pa gnang / /gang zhig gzhan la gnod de sbyin ngan yin/ /gang zhig dus min byen de ④sbyin ngan yin/ /de dag ni sbyin pa dag pa'o// //sems can kun la rlom byed pas/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang / /lta ba rnam par dag pa yis/ /yang ni tshul khrims dag pa bskyed / /nyan thos bse ru la sogs rnams ⑤spangs te/ /rnam par ma nyams sems kyis ni/ /chos rnams kun la mkha' dang mnyam pa yi bu/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /khong khro rnam par spangs pa las/ /bzod pa'i dag pa ④skye bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la/ /mnyam pa nyid kyis sems pa ⑧la thang shing gi ni nags bcad kyang / /khro med mun pa med pa ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' bcad kyang ni/ /bzod pa dag pas de bzhin no/ /gzugs brnyan dang ni mtshungs pa ru/ /rang gi lus la yang dag lta/ /64—1568

ngag la'ang brjod du med par lta/ /de bzhin shin tu zhi ba yi/ /shes par sems la lta byed na/ /brtson 'grus dag pa ①rab tu 'thob/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung sbyor ba yis/ /brtson 'grus dag pa bla na med/ /de bzhin brtse ba chen po'i sems/ /byin gyi rlabs kyis byen brlabs lapa'i/ /byams pa'i go cha'i tshogs kyis ni/ /dgra yi dpung tshogs rnam par 'joms/ /rnam kun med na mi 'byung ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid don mthong ba las/ /bsgrim ⑦mi dgos par bstan bugyur pas/ /bsam gtan dag pa bla na med/ /rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa yi⑤/ /stong nyid gang zhig yin par 'dod/ /ce na byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /thams cad ma spa ngas gang yin dang / /tshad med rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam dgu dang / /pha rol phyin pa rnam drug dang / /mtshan dpe rnams kyang ma spangs pa'o/ /rang bzhin zhi ba nyid yin yang / /nyon mongs las kyis zhi ma yin/ /chos rnams btang stoms nyid yin yang / /rang mtshan de bzhin nyid la rmongs/ /'gro don bya bas 'brel gyur kyang / /bya ba snying po yod ma yin/ /rang bzhin bsel ba nyid gyur kyang / /rab tu 'bar bar sems can 'tshed/ /de ltar phyogs tsam bstan pa yis/ /bsam gtan dag pa yongs su brjod/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /dag pa de ltar rnam par bsgom/ /de dag ni bsod nams dag pa mdor bsdus pa'o// //len par byed pa rab mang la/ /bsags pa 'di ni nyung gyur na/ /da ni gsum gyi spel ba yang / /nyung zad rnam par bshad pa ni/ /'di ltar 64byed1569

sangs rgyas mdzad tshim byed/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'dir 'dod pa yin/ /gzhan du dag pa tsam gyis ni/ /nyan thos rnams dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /bdag lus spel ba gang zhe na/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus spel ba'o/ /stobs ni mi nus med pa ste/ /rgyu bcu las ni stobs de 'byung / /gal te byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /lus dang srog la bab gyur kyang / /dam chos nam yang mi gtong ba/ /de ni stobs kyi rgyu gcig yin/ /rgyal ba 'phel ba med par ni//sems can kun la phyag byed dang / /nyam chung rnams la bzod pa yis/ /kha zas rab mchog ster ba dang / /nad pa rnams ni gso ba dang / /sems can phongs par gyur rnams la/ /longs spyod gtong bar byed pa rnams/ /de bzhin bde gshegs mchod rten la/ /rdo thal 'byug ①par byed pa dang / /sems can kun la thams cad nas/ /dga' bas smra bar byed pa dang / /phongs pas snyug bsngal gyur rnams la/ /longs spyod dgod par byed pa dang / /sems can ngal dub can rnams kyi/ /khur bu khyar bar byed pa po/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs mthong bas/ /ngo mtshar skyes nas ma skyes dgras/ /zhus nas thub pas stobs kyi rgyu/ /rnam pa bcu ni gsungs pa yin/ /brtson 'grus spel bar gang brjod de/ /le lo med par spel ba yin/ /'di la yang dag rdzogs pa yi//bla med byang chub thob mi dka'/ /snyom ①las can gyis ①nyan thos kyi/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang mi 'grub na/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas myang 'das smos ci dgos/ /de dag ni bdag gi lus spel ba'o// //stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /sbyin las longs spyod spel ba ste/ /64byed1570

rdo rje gcod pa la sogs su/ /sbyin pa de ltar rgyas par gsungs/ /byang chub sems dpas gang gi tshe/ /rab tu mi gnas sbyin btang ba/ /bsod nams de yi phung po'i tshad/ /gzung bar nus pa ma yin no/ /yang dag rab tu rtsol ba dang / /bsam pa brtan par byas nas ni/ /thog mar snying rje bskyed nas su/ /dge ba 'bad pas spel bar bya/ /rtag par rab tu ngu ba ltar/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten ①pa ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi chos kyi rgyu/ /rtsol ba 'di ltar shes par bya/ /'phags pa gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis④/ /'jig rten pa yi dam pa'i las/ /sngon bsags bye ba snyed ④bzung nas/ /'phags pa byams pa'i drung phyin ltar/ /'das pa'i lus ni bye ba snyed④/ /'bras bu med min bsams ⑤nas ni/ /de ⑥ltar byung ba'i lus po yang / /rnam par dag pa bla med bsam/ /dga' ba rgya chen dang ba yi/ /shugs kyis rgya mtsho rab 'phel zhing / /khyad par du ni 'gro ba'i phyir/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan ④par byed/ /'gro don rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyurarjo/ /grogs med gnyis pa med kyang ni/ /go cha chen po'i sbyor bar ldan—/ /gzhan yang / 'di na bdag nyid gcig pu ste/ /gzhan yang stobs bcas bdud kyi tshogs/ /bdag gis byang chub chen po'i lam/ /'thob la gal te gags 'byung srid/ /de lta'ang de dag sems kyi ni/ /skad cig gcig gis nges bcom nas/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin sa gzhi la/ /bdag gis slar yang bsdad par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba bsam pa yin par gsungs/ /bsam pa med na bde gshegs kyi/ /yon tan rnams ni thag bsrings nas/ /lag pa dang ni rkang pa dag /med na 'gro 'ong 64—1571

med pa dag /yan lag mchog gi mgo med na/ /'gro ba rnams kyi srog med dang / /bud shing med par gyur na yang / /me yi 'bar ba med pa ltar/ /de bzhin bsam pa med na yang / /sangs rgyas chos dang phrad pa med/ /bsam pa yang dag dag gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi sgra ni nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'byung //bsam pa dag na shing dang ni/ /rtsig pa las kyang gdams ①ngag rjes bstan 'byung / /'dir ni dge ba spel ba yi/ /yang ni snying rje rab bsgom par/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sngon du 'gro bar deng 'dod do/ /de lta yin pas rgyal ba yi/ /sras po mkhas pa yis ni chos/ /mang po la ni mi bslab ste/ /chos gcig la ni babe+eb bya zhing / /chos gcig la ni legs par brten / /sangs rgyas chos rnams mtha' yas pa/ /de las kun du 'byung ngo zhes / /chos yang dag par sdud pa las/ /gcig pu brtse chen ldan pas gsungs—/ /ji ltar 'khor los ②sgyur ba de'i/ /dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa ni/ /'khor lo rin chen rjes 'brang bzhin/ /sangs rgyas chos ni brtse rjes 'brang / /yon tan dang ldan bu gcig pa'i/ /rkang la thug par pha brtse ba/ /de bzhin lus can rnams la yang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtse bas khyab/ /'khor ba'i rgyun las sems can rnams/ /kun nas gdon par 'dod pa yi/ /dmigs pa'i dbye bas snying rje de/ /slar yang rnam pa gsum du dbye/ /byung nas 'byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i/ /sdug 'jigs bdag nyid mi 'dod pa/ /bsgoms nas medaga' ba la sogs pa/ /snying rje byams pa bzhin du bsgom/ /snying rje la sogs de dag de lta bur/ /phan tshun rjes su 'byel pas bsod nams 'phel—/ /phung po gsum pa rtag 0par bton pas kyang / /bsod nams rab 64—1572

'phel spungs phyir phung po yin/ /sdig pa bshags ②/dang sangs rgyas la/ /gsol 'debs bsod nams rnams la ni/ /rjes yi rangs dzu rnams bsod nams kyi/ /phung po yin phyir phung po gsum/ /sangs rgyas la ni phyag 'tshal nas—/ /sdog pa bshags zhes 'byung bas na/ /phyag 'tshal sdeg pa bshags pa las/ /log par tha snyad mi bya'o/ /nye ba 'khor gyis ①zhus pa las/ /'thad pa dang bcas rab brtan phyir/ /gsol ba 'debs dang bskul ba yi/ /don ni gcig pa nyid yin no/ /yo byad med pas mchod pa ni/ /nges med phyir na ma bstan to/ /ngag yid mchod pa gsungs pa ni/ /mdo sde rnams su rab tu grags/ /rgyal ba gang zag zla med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad dang / /zhes pa la sogs tshigs bcad bzhis/ /phyag btsal bub ni yongs su bsgrags/ /bzang spyod la sogs tshigs bcad dang / /bstod pa blo la gang yod dang / /dkon mchog sprin sogs mdo sde ru/ /gsungs pa bzung la mchod par bya/ /'di lta ste/ gang zhig 'di na bdag gir ma byas gzung med pa'i/ /'bras bu lo tog 'bru yi bye brag gang skyes pa/ /de dag ma lus rgyal ba byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la sogs la bdag gis phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /bzang phyespyod du gsungs tshigs bcad kyis/ /de bzhin rjes su yi rang bya/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan las gsungs pa'i/ /bsngo ba gus pas yongs su bsngo/ /smon lam ji ltar gdab pa yang / /mdo sde sa bcur blta bar bya/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam sbyang phyir/ /rtag par yongs su bsngo bar bya//bsod nams gang las shes par bya/ /zhe na mdo sde kun na snang / /phan yon bcas par rab gsungs phyir/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs rnams kyis so/ /bsam pa 64—1573

dag pas yang nas yang / /sangs rgyas la ni phyag byas las/ /mi khom brgyad po rnam spangs nas/ /dal zhing khom pa thob par byed/ /de la mi khom pa brgyad ni/ /sa stengs su ①ni rgyal bas dam chos bstan kyang byol song yi dwags 'gro ba dang / /gzhan yang lha ni tshe ring po yi nang du skye dang 'gro gzhan dmyal ba dang / /mtha' 'khob yul du skyes pa dang ni lkugs pa nyid dang log par lta ba dang / /mi yi bzang po yongs su zin kyang thub pa dang bral de dag mi khom brgyad/ /de dag ni phyag btsal ba la sogs pa'i cho ga bsod nams 'phel ba'o// //dad dang gus dang nga rgyal spangs/ /brtson 'grus shes bya 'di rnams kyis/ /yongs su nyams kye par mi byed cing / /khyad par du yang 'gro bar byed/ /de la dad pa gang zhig gis/ /'phags pa rnams dang nyer sprod cing / /de bzhin bya bar mi 'os pa/ /mtha' dag gang gis mi byed pa'o/ /gus par 'di ni khyad par du/ /bsod nams skyed par byed pa dang / /gang zhig gis ni dam pa'i chos/ /mnyam par gzhag pas nyan pa'o/ /nga rgyal spangs pas yon tan rnams/ /'phel ba'i rgyur gsungs gang yin dang / /gang gis yon tan lhag pa yis/ /'phags par sems shing phyag byed pa'o/ /brtson 'grus de bzhin khyad par rnams/ /'thob phyir yongs su mi nyams shing / /lus sems las su rung 'di dag /gang gis myur du thob pa'o/ /de dag ni dad pa la sogs pa bzhi'o// //de bzhin bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /dang po rnam pa lnga gsungs pa/ /dad brtson dran pa ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab rnams la rim ①bzhin bshad/ /64—1574

dad pa'i dbang po gang yin pa'i/ /dad pa de ni chos bzhin byed/ /de la gang gis dkar po dang / /nag po'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu/ /bde sdug rang bzhin so so ru/ /'byen par byed pa chos dang po/ /rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyis ①ni/ /spyod pa gnyis pa zu yin par gsungs/ /gsum pa'ang 'dir ni gang zhig gis/ /chos rnams thams cad mi spong zhing / /lta ba kun la yang dag par/ /de bzhin zhen par mi byed pa'o/ /gang zhig thub pa rnams kyi chos/ /mi 'jigs la sogs mtha' yas la/ /dad par byed pa bzhi pa ste/ /de dag dad pa'i dbang por 'dod/ /dad pa'i dbang po'i chos rnams gang / /nges par 3dad par byas nas ni/ /gang gis yang dag 'phel byed pa/ /de ni brtson 'grus dbang po yin/ /brtson 'grus dbang pos chos rnams gang / /gsal por 'phel bar byas nas ni/ /gang gis nyams par mi byed pa/ /de ni dran pa'i dbang por brjod/ /dran pa'i dbang pos chos rnams gang / /nyams pa ru ni ma byas la/ /gang gi rtse gcig tu byed pa/ /de ni ting 'dzin dbang por 'dod/ /ting 'dzin dbang pos chos rnams gang / /slar yang rtse gcig byas nas ni/ /bdag nyid so sor shes byed pa/ /de la shes rab dbang por brjod/ /de dag ni dbang po lnga'o// //dad brtson dbang po lnga po nyid/ /stobs kyi rang bzhin nyid gyur nas/ /gang tshe bdud rnams kyis rgyal bas/ /mi nus de ni stobs 'phel ba'i /stobs kyi nyan thos la sogs kyis/ /theg dman 'dod par mi byed cing / /snga na theg pa chen po la/ /dam bcas mi ldog bstan ④par 'gyur/ /de dag ni stobs lnga'o// //64—1575

bsod nams spel phyir dkon mchog gsum/ /slar yang rjes su dran par bya—/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa ni/ /yul 'khor skyong gis zhus par gsungs—/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas che ba nges bsam ①pas—/ /sems la gzugs brnyan bzhin shar na/ /dge ba mngon par rab tu 'phel/ /de dag ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bstan pa'o // //sneyon tan mtha' yas sgrub byed pa'i/ /chos la rjes su dran par bya/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' yas gang / /chos 'ba' zhig las rab tu skye/ /de bzhin 'jig rten pa dag dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba kun/ /chos la rdzogs par 'grub pas na/ /de phyir gus pas spyad par bya/ /ji ltar sems can thams cad la/ /chos rnams snyoms par rab tu 'jug /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /de ni bdag gis mnyam par bsgrub/ /ji ltar nyin dang mtshan mo ru/ /chos ni mtshungs par rab 'jug pa/ /chos bzhin mtshungs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /da ni bdag kyang 'jug par bya/ /'phags pa 'phags min mi mtshungs shes/ /zhing du lta ba rnam spangs te/ /chos ni rab tu 'jug pa bzhin / /bdag kyang mtshan nyid gcig tu 'jug /sems can rnams kyis chos mi bsrung / /chos kyis sems can srung bar byed/ /'gro ba'i skyabs ni chos yin gyi1/ /chos kyi skyabs ni 'gro ba min/ /chos ni srid pas mi 'jigs shing / /mya ngan 'das la rjes mi 'gal/ /de bzhin bdag kyang 'jigs ④pa dag /spong zhing de dag rjes su gzhol/ /de dag ni chos rjes su dran pa'o / /bye dge 'dun chos kyi smra ba po/ /don du chos gnyer chos la sems/ /chos kyi zhing ste chos kyi mchog /des na snedage 'dun rjes dran bya/ /de dag ni 64—1576

dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'o// //de ltar bdag gis lus sogs gsum/ /byang sems bzung ①ba sngon 'gro can—/ /kun mkhyen nyid du yongs bsngos pas/ /khyad par du ni rnam par 'phel/ /bdag nyid dran par bya phyir dang / /dang po'i las can sems can la/ /bdag gis phyogs tsam 'di bstan byas/ /bye brag 'phags pa'i spyod yul yin/ /rgyal ba'i bslab bcu de dag bsdus byas las/ /dri med ston ka'i zla zer ltar 'bar ba'i—/ /'dir ni dge ba cung zad ci bsags pa/ /de yis 'gro ba'i bslab pa'i rgyan gyur cig /babe+eb pa kun bsdus ljon shing las/ /phyogs cha tsam zhig blangs pa yi/ /bslab pa'i me tog snye ma 'di/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi rna bar zung ge/ /bslab pa'i me tog snye ma zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //bi kra ma la shī la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bai ro tsa na rak+shi ta'i zhal snga nas sbyar ba'o//dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag bod rje lha btsan po 1 bkra shis nam mkha' dbang phyug btsan gyi bka' lung gis rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti tīrti dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong zha ma ④seng rgyal dang / glog skya gzhon nu 'bar byis bsgyur ba las/ slad nas bod kyi lo tsā ba ban de mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //64—1577
