⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ska/ // du〈〈pe 〉〉ni/1577 ①②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉khri/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉smon ma dge slong /bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (123)64wa 1581

༄ga /pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba/1 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pā ra mi tā sa mā sa ṭunā ma/ bod skad du/pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song bas/ /ston pa gzhan la phyogs pa yi/ /ser sna'i dogs pa yongs su spang bye / /bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas sku/ /dpal ldan skyes chen mtshan 'chang la/ /ci nas shigs par mi nus pa/ /thob rtsol sangs rgyas skyabs song yin/ /'jig rten skyabs med skyob ④pa'i phyir/ /spyod cing rang gi don btang ste/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub phyir blo brtan na/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su thusong ba yin/ /rga shi nad dang 'chi ba las/ /sems can mgon med bskyab pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub smon na/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su song ba yin/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pa dang / /dri tshor ro myang skyecis 64—1582

kyang rung / /'gro ba kun la bde smon na/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su song ba yin//sems can rnams la snying brtse zhing / /bde gshegs yon tan thob mos na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /mdor bsdus skyabs su song ba yin/ /byang chub mchog tu smon byed de/ /rang gi ①don la mi lta zhing / /gzhan don brtson yang nga med na/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su song ba yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod chen la/ /gang zhig skyo med zhum med cing / /mos pa chen po skyed byed pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas skyabs song yin/ /skyabs kyi mchog ni stobs bcu dang / /stobs bcu'i chos zhes de tshol zhing / /yon tan tshogs la dad skyed na—/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su song ba yin/ /'jig rten 'di dag skyabs med pa—/ /skyabs su bya zhes dam brtan na/ /de ni 'gro ba'i skyabs yin te/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su song ba yin/ /nyon mongs bcas pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /sems can gang tshe mthong gyur pa/ /de tshe mos pa che bskyed cing / /gcig las rnam mang sprul byas te/ /'jig rten dpag yas thams cad la/ /phan pa kun stobs lus dang sems/ /bdag gis bsgrub ④par bya'o zhes/ /su sems sangs rgyas skyabs song yin/ /skyabs su 'gro ba dang po'o// //dam chos 'khor los sgyur ba yi/ /rgyal por gyur te 'chi med pa'i/ /lam gyis 'gro ba skyabs smon na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /bdag kyang 'jig rten mtha' med kyang / /snying rjes yongs su mi gtong zhing / /dam chos bstan par gang mos pa/ /de ni chos la skyabs song yin/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis zhudam chos bstan bya zhes/ /64—1583

sems can don la sems mnyen ①na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /mang thos nan tan rgyan ldan dang / /gzhan la bstan pa'i don bsgrub ①na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /mtshan ma shin tu gsal ba yin/ /'jig rten ma lus thams cad la/ /chos 'di skyabs kyi mchog yin zhes/ /rtog cing dam chos tshol byed na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /chos kyi slob dpon bsnyen ④byed cing / /nyan 'dod tshul bzhin yid byed la/ /ston cing nan tan lhur byed na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /dam chos yongs su gzung ba'i phyir/ /spyod pas yang dag spyod byed cing / /lus dang srog la mi lta na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /byang chub mchog gi ④phyogs kyi chos/ /bdag don ma yin gzhan don du/ /snying rje chen pos spyod byed na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /gang zhig bde la chags med la/ /sdug bsngal rnam ⑤pas mi 'jigs shing / /'jig rten phan spyod chos shes na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /dam chos tshul 'di ma thos pas/ /'jig rten 'di dag dman 'gyur zhes/ /ston cing nan tan don byed na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyang / /bdag gis buchos la dgod bya zhes / /sems bskyed nan tan spyod byed na/ /chos la skyabs su song ba yin//skyabs su 'gro ba gnyis pa'o// //mos pa shin tu rnam dag pas/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun drung 'gro ba/ /gang gis ⑦bsam pa mi bzlog ④pa/ /de ni dge 'dun skyabs song yin/ /nges par lhung bar gyur pa yi/ /nyan thos theg la gnas pa rnams/ /byang 64—1584

chub sems ni skyed byed na/ /dge 'dun skyabs su song ba yin/ /dge 'dun yon tan dran byas shing / /dge 'dun bzhin du bkur gnas ①su/ /'jig rten thams cad bkur mos na/ /de ni dge 'dun skyabs song yin/ /byang chub go cha brtan sdebyed cing / /dge 'dun rnams la cher mos pas/ /dge 'dun bsnyen bkur gang dad pa/ /dge 'dun skyabs su song ba yin/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol de shes ston la sogs/ /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen gyes/ /'jig rten brgyan snepar mos pa dang / /dge 'dun dag la dad brtan pas/ /'gro ba mang po kun gyis kyang / /dad pas bzlog par mi nus na/ /de ni dge 'dun skyabs song yin/ /skyes bu dam pa rin po ches/ /bcas pa'i mu stegs gtsang ma ste/ bdud la shin tu dpa' ba yinadu/ /skyes mchog de ni dge 'dun yin/ /yang dag ji bzhin smra byed cing / /de la chung phul yongs ⑤'gyur zhes/ /de 'dra'i rnam dag sems 'chang na/ /dge 'dun skyabs su song ba yin/ /byang chub mchog sems mi ldog dang / /dbang dang tshad med yon tan gyis/ /brgyan pa'i yon tan gang tshol ba/ /de ni dge 'dun skyabs song yin/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song ba/ /sems can 'jigs med don 'gyur bas/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs ldan ni/ /de phyir mi 'jigs sbyin bdag yin/ /skyabs song bsod nams gzugs yod na/ /khams gsum 'di yang snod du chung ④/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu yi gter/ /phul gyis bcal bas gzhal mi nus/ /skyabs su 'gro ba gsum pa'o// //64—1585

skyabs 'gro gsum byas phyin chad sbyin pa la/ /ci nas lus kyi yan lag babe+engs gyur kyang / /tshul ngan gtong la zhum par mi 'gyur bar/ /'jig rten phan par brtson pas sbyor ba bya/ /ser sna'i skyon ni gang gis ①'phel 'gyur ram/ /yongs su gtong sems 'phel bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /yongs 'dzin bgegs su 'gyur ba'i slu ba dag /byang chub sems dpas ma lus yongs su spang bye/ /gang zhig gtong sems gnyen por 'gyur ba dag /yang dag byang chub lam la sgrib byed na/ /de 'dra'i nor ram rin chen rgyal srid kyang / /byang chub sems dpas blang bar 'os pa min/ /thub pa rnams kyi spyod mchog dran byas shing / /de gzhol rang gi dam bcas bsam byas te/ /yongs 'dzin chags pa rnam par brtsal ① ba'i phyir/ /sems la rtogs pa'i dam pa 'di dag rtogs / /'gro ba kun la bdag gi lus btang ste/ /de btang chos kyang 'di lhag bdag gis spang ④ bya na/ /phyi rol dngos la bdag gis chags bya ba/ /glang po'i khrus bzhin bdag la reg ⑤pa min/ /sha la don gnyer sha 'di bskur dubar gyis/ /rkang 'dod sems can rkang yang brus te khyer/ /bdag gi lus 'di 'di ltar bskur ④ba yang / /'jig rten don na ⑪/phyi rol dngos ci smos/ /ji ltar sman gyi sdong po skyes gyur la/ /lo ma me tog skye bo 'thog byed kyang / /'di dag bdag la blangs shing khyer byed ces/ /rnam par rtog pa de la rgyu ba med//de bzhin 'jig rten don la brtson pa yis/ /drin med rtag tu mi gtsang sdug bsngal ba'i/ /lus 'di gzhan la phan zhing mkho gyur na/ /bdag gir bya snyam rnam rtog chung mi skyed/ /nang gi kyes dang chu la sogs pa dang / /phyi rol 'byung ba chen po'i tshogs mtshungs na/ /'di ni bdag gi 'di ni gzhan gyi s+dza64—1586

zhes—/ /ma rig 'dam gyi rtog bskyed ① tshul ma yin/ /bdag gi 1lus kyang ci bder blang bar gyis/ /'di la gzhan gyi yin snyam blo ma bskyed zu/ /'di dag thams cad khyed kyi dngos yin te/ /'di la bdag gis ④ nga rgyal bdag la med//de 'dra'i rmad byung bsam pa rnams dang yang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan rjes 'brang ba/ /gang la yod pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes/ /sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab skyes mchog gsungasaṭu / /de ltar sbyin la nan tan brtson pa de/ /lus la nam yang chags par mi byed pas/ /de yi ngag lus yid kyi las rnams kyang / /lhun gyis grub par rnam par dag par 'dod/ /rnam dag las can gzhan la phan byed na/ /tshegs su 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal med par byed/ /de ltar rigs pa'i tshul la mngon zhugs pa/ /tshul dang tshul min mkhas pa dngos su thob⑥/ /sbyin pa'i 'bras bu spangs pa ⑦thob gyur nas/ /srid pa'i mun nang 'thoms pa'i skye bo la/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen gyes//nyi ma shar ba'i 'od pas gsal bar byed/ /'jig rten phan pa'i don sgrub snyam bye pa de/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'grub gzhir gyur pas/ /nyi shar zer bkye 'od chen mi zad bzhin/ /de yi bsod nams yun du zad mi shes/ /de 'dra rmad byung sbyin pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan gyur pas—/ /de phyir sbyin pa snying rje sngon 'gro la/ /yongs su sbyong ba'i yon kyetan rnam pa mang / /tshe dang spobs pa sangs rgyas stobs la sogs/ /'gro ba kun la bdag gis bsgrub bya zhing / /zang zing sbyin pas bsdus pa'i sems can dag /bdag gi dam chos snod du 'gyur ro zhes/ /de ltar kha zas skom rnams gtong bar byed/ /rang gi phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub 6phyir min/ /khyon mongs skom 64—1587

pa gzhil phyir btung ba dag /'jig rten phan byed 'jig rten rnams la gtong //sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che ba'i rnam pa dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba thams cad kyang / /'jig rten 'di dag ji ltar thob 'gyur zhes/ /theg chen smos pa jeg pa ①yongs su gtong / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku mdog gser 'dra dang / /khrel ltas rgyu las byung ba'i gos sgrub ②par/ /gos kyi rnam pa grangs med mang po dag /lus la bde bar rim gro sbyin par byed/ /snying po byang chub gnas phyir stan gtong 1ste/ /mal gsum don du mal kyi sbyin pa byed/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan mchog bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mchod rten gtsug lag khang du mar me dbul/ /lha yi rna ba thob ④phyir rol mo dang / /sangs rgyas tshul khrims bsgrub phyir spos kyang 'bul/ /skyabs su 'gro ba yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /khyem dang btung gnas ra ba gnas rnams gtong / /bro ba ro mchog yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /shin tu zhim sbyar ro rnams gtong bar byed//'jig rten 'di dag rga shi med stobs par/ /sman gyi mchog rnams grangs med sbyin par byed/ /nyon mongs tshogs kyis 'khor ⑤ba'i 'jig rten rnams/ /rab byung bdag nyid mnyam par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /de ni rtag tu bran dag gtong byed cing / /sems can bla med chos kyi rjer yang bsgrub/ /mtshan rab bzang po phun sum tshogs bsgrub par/ /mu tig byi ru gser la sogs pa gtong //dpe byad bzang po sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rin chen sgon ma rgyan gyi sbyin pa byed/ /bsam gtan bsgrub ⑥phyir brtul zhugs nags tshal dang / /chos mdzod thob phyir nor mdzod yongs su gtong / /thub dbang rgyal po thob phyir skyon med par/ /rgyal srid bkas brgyan sbyin pa gtong bar byed/ /byang chub 64—1588

mchog la mos phyir skyon med par/ /bu dang bu mo sdug pa'i sbyin pa byed/ /gcig tu chos la dga' zhing mos pa'i phyir/ /dga' ba'i rgyur gyur rtsed mo sna tshogs gtong / /'khor los brgyan pa'i rkang pa mchog thob ste/ /byang chub snying por gnas pas ①mos pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten don chen bsgrub par brtson pa de/ /rtog pa med par rkang pa yongs su gtong / /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor skye shi'i chus g.yengs pa'i/ /'jig rten chos kyi lag pas bskyab po zhes/ /lag pa pad+ma rgyas 'dra gtong bar byed/ /dbang po lnga dag rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /sna dang rna ba skyon med yongs su gtong / /'jig rten thams cad sgrib pa kun spangs te/ /rnam dag mig ldan bsgrub phyir mig kyang gtong / /sa chu me dang rlung ltar rtog med cing / /'jig rten nyer 'tshor bdag gi lus sgrub ces/ /sha bcad khrag dang bcas pa gtso bo de/ /snying rje chen pos yongs su gtong bar byed—/ /rmad du byung ba'i spyod pa brtan pa de/ /rdo rje lta bu'i char pa bab gyur kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mchog mi shigs ②pa/ /'jig rten kun gyis ①thob phyir rkang yang gtong / /'jig rten blar gyur ye shes mnyam bzhag phyir/ /skye bo slong du 'ongs pa thams cad la/ /lus kyi dam pa mgos kyang mchod byed na/ /lus kyi yan lag gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /de la sogs pa rgyun du skyon med par/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod las yongs btang ba'i/ /sbyin pa'i char gyis 'gro ba tshim byas shing / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor mngon par 'gro/ /de ni mi rigs btsal zhing sbyin pa dang / /gzhan la gnod pa ④btsal zhing sbyin mi bya/ /de la gzhan la btang bas dma' ba med/ /de ni sbyin pas snyems ⑤pas bdag mi bstod/ /gzhan la smod pa nam ⑥yang 64—1589

byed pa med/ /log pa'i sbyor ba yongs su mi gtong ste/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas ma zin sbyin mi byed/ /khro ba'i skyon gyis ⑫ dma' bar mi gtong ste/ /byen rjunas de la rjes su 'gyod mi byed/ /gcam byas sgur dze+ezhes mang du sbyin mi byed/ /khrel gyis dogs sam 'jigs pa'i rgyu ④ phyir ram/ /sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gyur phyir gtong ba minaphye/ /bzang po yod bzhin ngan pa gtong ba'am/ /sbyin pa'i gnas min zhes te brnyas pa'am/ /rnam smin re bas dogs par byas pa'am//rim gro med cing smad par de mi gtong / /tshul khrims ldan la phul bas mi mthong zhing / /khengs shing brnyas byed ⑥nyung bar gtong ba med/ /gang gis ⑦log pa'i nan tan rgyur gyur dang / /slong ba rnams la gnod par sbyin mi byed/ /de ni dus min sbyin par mi byed de/ /dus dang mi mthun sbyin pa'ang de mi byed//lhar smon ma yin rgyal por rton phyir min/ /theg pa dman smon tshul gyis 2gtong mi byed/ /de ni ngor bltas gtong bar mi byed de/ /grags pa'i sgra dang bzhad rmyegad don phyir min/ /bdag gis nus su zad ces mi rlom zhing / /gzhan kyi srog la gnod phyir sbyin mi byed/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par ma bsngos pa'am/ /skyes bu dam pas smad par gtong mi byed/ /de phyir pha rol phyin pa'i ming 'thob cing / /shin tu rnam dag sbyin par yang dag 'gro/ /de yi sbyin las byung ba'i bsod nams tshogs/ /'jig rten kun gyi bsod nams yongs bsdus kyang / /de dag kun gyis kyizil gnon mi 'gyur bas/ /de phyir 'jig rten kun kyi gtso bor 'gyur/ /mngon shes lnga la shin tu nges 'gyur zhing //'jig rten kun la sbyin pa'i char 'be+ebs pas/ /phyogs rnams kun du de yi tshad mi zin/ /rtag par rgyun du 'byung bas zad mi shes/ /de bas mi zad 64—1590

'gro la phan par 'gyur/ /ye shes mi zad rgya chen rgyu yang yin/ /khams gsum zad par 'gyur ba'i dngos po dang / /mkha' dang sprin ltar rtag tu 'dre ba med/ /de ni stong nyid rnam par mnyam gzhag cing / /mtshan ma'i skyon rnams yongs su spang ba ①dang / /nyon mongs bsal zhing dman pa med pas na//thub dbang chen po rnams kyis mi zad gsungs/ /skyes bu dam pas ched du brjod byas shing / /bde ba rgya chen rgyu yi sbyin pa ni/ /byed par 'dod pas mi rtag rnal 'byor dang / /'jig rten rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed/ /longs spyod rnam pa mi rtag mthong gyur cing / /snying rje chen po rang gi ngang gyur na/ /byin pa ⑤bdag gi ①khyim bzhag gzhan gyi bar/ /shin tu rig pa'i tshul khrims ④ rtogs par 'gyur/ /gang byen de las 'jigs ⑧pa skye mi 'gyur/ /khyim na gang bzhag de las 'jigs pa 'byung / /mi chog ⑪thun mong rtag tu bsrung dgos te/ /byin na nyes pa de dag gnod mi 'gyur/ /byin pas 'jig rten pha rol bde ba bsgrub sde/ /ma byin tshe 'di nyid la'ang sdug bsngal bskyedadu/ /mi yi nor rnams skar mda'i rang bzhin ltar/ /yongs su ma btang de dag med par 'gyur/ /ma byin nor rnams mi rtag med 'gyur te/ /byin pas de dag yod pa'i gter du 'gro/ /sems can phan par gzhol bas gang byen pa'i/ /nor rnams snying po med pa'ang yod par 'gyur/ /gang zhig yongs su btang ba mkhas pas bsngags/ /skye bo byis pa de dag sog ⑨la dga'/ /yongs su bzung ⑩bas mi 'bral gang yang med/ /byin pas rtag tu phun sum tshogs pa 'byung / /btang bas nyon mongs yongs su 'dzin mi 'gyur/ /'jungs pa 'phags pa'i lam min nyon mongs bskyed/ /gang zhig byin pa de ni lam gyi 64byed1591

mchog /de las gzhan gyur 'phags pas lam ngan gsungs/ /slong ba sngon du 'ongs tūn rgyal sras des/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshogs ni spel ba'i phyir/ /des gzhan 'du shes bdag la gzhag byas shing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'du shes de la skyed/ /slong ba 'ongs pa thos na che ba rnams/ /nyon mongs mi dga' rnam par srab 'gyur bas/ /dga' ba'i ston mo chen po 'byung ba bas /slong ba sngon du 'ongs la de dag dga'/ /ci ste slong ba sngon ③du 'ongs gyur kyang / /shin tu mthu chung sbyin par ma nus na/ /ci nas slong ba sma bab ma gyur pa/ /'jam pa'i tshig gis de yi yid kyang bzho/ /phyin chad slong ba drung du zu'ongs gyur na/ /ci nas kho chad dma' bar mi 'gyur bar/ /'jungs pa'i skyon rnams rnam par bsal ba dang / /srid pa yongs su spang phyir nan tan bya / /gang zhig zang zing nor la chags byed pa/ /de la byang chub mchog sems skye ba med/ /sems mchog de ni skyon dang mi 'grogs te/ /rgya mtsho chen po ro dang mi 'grogs bzhin/ /de bas rtag tu skyon rnams kun spangs te/ /byang chub tshol bas rtag tu thams cad sbyin/ /'jig rten thams cad gcig pu ngas bskyab ④pa'i/ /sems dang spyod dang zhum pa'i ngang mi mthun/ /sbyin pa de 'dra'i rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de 'dra'i sbyin pa gtong 'dod de mi gtang ⑤/ /'jig rten nang na gtong 'dod sems ldan pa/ /gtong ba'i nang na mchog ces rgyal bas gsungs/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u'o// //rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshul khrims brgyan bye ldan par/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgrub don gang brtson pa/ /rang gi tshul khrims thog mar yongs su sbyangs⑦//64—1592

tshul khrims dag pa'i mthu yi stobs kyang bskyed/ /ci nas rmi lam rmi yang 'tshe med par/ /'jig rten kun la byams pa bskyed par bya/ /gzhan la phan par gcig tu brtson pa des/ /gzhan gyi longs spyod sbrul bzhin reg mi bya/ /kha ton spyod pa'i blo las phyir log pas/ /thog mar gzhan gyi bud med bslu ba'i blo//yongs su gtang ⑨bya 'jig rten phan byed pas/ /lus kyi spyod pa skyes bu mchog ltar bsgrub/ /snyan cing yid 'ong dus dang ldan pa'i tshig /dbyen du mi 'gyur bden dang mthun pa dag /dam chos yang dag khong du chud 'gyur ba/ /gnyen pos btsal zhing rtag tu brjod par bya/ /gzhan gyi bde ba phun sum thob gyur na/ /bdag gi ②zho shas ba/nga zhig bsgrub ④bya ba/ /de dag kho bdag nyid kyis ④rnyed gyur ces/ /dga' sems bskyed bya chags sems yongs su spangs⑤—/ /nyon mongs dbang gyur bdag phan mi reg par⑥/ /'di ni bdag nyid mthu chung zhan pa'i mtha'/ /gzhan gyi nyes pa kun kyang de bzhin zhes—/ /gnod sems me 'bar gzhil phyir nan tan bya/ /log lta'i 'du shes mun nag thibs po dag /ye shes snang bas yid la gsal ④byas te/ /lha mi phul gyi yon tan bsgom byas shing / /dad pa mi 'phrogs rtsa ba brtan par gzugs—/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bde lam gyur pa dedze+e/ /las lam bcu po 'di las nyams mi bya/ /'di la gnas pa 'gro la phan bsam ⑪ pa'i bsam pa'i khyad par 'bras bu yod par 'gyur/ /ngag lus yid rnams yang dag bsdam bya ba/ /mdor bsdus tshul khrims yin zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /tshul khrims ma lus 'dul ⑩ba'i gzhi yin pas/ /de phyir 'di dag rnam par sbyang bar gyis/ /srog gcod spangs pa des pa'i ngang 'chang ba⑩/ /'gro ba thams 64—1593

cad bsten zhing nyuphebs par 'gyur/ /de yi bag chags sems la skyon gyur pa//nan tan ma byas rang gis ②yongs su 'chad/ /byams pa'i khyad par rjes mthun sems ldan zhing / /khon gcugs rnam pa yongs su zhi 'gyur na/ /mya ngan rnam pa'i nyes pa kun spangs shing / /bde bar de nyal bde bar sad par 'gyur—/ /gnod sbyin srin po dag kyang phan par byed/ /lam ngan rgyud kyis de la 'jigs pa med/ /nad med yon tan rgyan dang ldan pa yi/ /bde lam brten pa'i tshe ring thob par 'gyur/ /de nyid rgyu yin tshibyang chub brnyes pa yisabya /bde gshegs rnams kyi sku tshe dpag phyeyas shing / /'jig rten bde ba skyed 0 cing don mdzad pa/ /dgongs pa'i rjes su snyegs ④pa yongs su 'grub/ /gzhan gyi longs spyod ma byin ma blangs pas/ /'jig rten gzhan du longs spyod rgya chen dag /bud med dbugs kyis ri rab mi sgul (9ltar/ /bgo skal ba dang 'phrogs pas mi 'phrogs 'grub/ /spyod pa dag pas kun gyis ⑫yid 'ong zhing / /ston pa'i snod du tshe 'di nyid la 'grub/ /de phyir pha rol du yang dogs med cing / /lam kyi gegs su gyur pa'i rnam pa med/ /skyid longs yengs tsol snying po med rtogs pas/ /ched du ma bsgrubs ⑫sbyin pa'i ngang du 'gyur—/ /de phyir nye ba'i nyon mongs rnam dag pas/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub ngang gis thob⑫/ /'dod pa rnams la log par spyod spangs pas/ /dbang po thul phyir rab tu zhi la mos/ /'jig rten bstod pas phyogs rnams kun gyi mthar/ /grags pa khyab 'gro gsal ba kun thob ⑫'gyur/ /bud med kun la ma ltar bltas pas na/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags gang la'ang mi 'byung ste—/ /de phyir de yi bsod nams bsags ④pas na/ /thub dbang skyes chen 64byed1594

dbang po mtshan ldan 'grub/ /tshig tu gang smras brdzun las phyir bzlog pas/ /rab tu dga' ldan g.yo sgyu 0rnam dag sems/ /tshig rnams kun gyis blang bar grub lagyur pas/ /sems can mang po chos gzhom ④kun gyis 'grub/ /bden dang ldan la lha rnams byams gyur pa/ /lha yi rang bzhin yon tan phyogs byed pa//de yi spyod pa kun la mngon sum pas/ /'di 'dra de la ngo mtshar che ba med/ /'jig rten gzhan byams tshad mar byed pa ni/ /'jig rten phal cher yon tan mi 'chang la/ /rang gi tshad kyis gzhan la tshod 'dzin kyang / /de 'drar gyur pa de ni ngo mtshar che/ /me tog at+pa la yi nags bor zhing / /bde ldan kha ni pad+mo 'phags tshul du/ /dri zhim sim byed yid du 'ong ba dang / /de yi mkha' ④la gnas 'cha' rten par 'gyur/ /ye shes 'bar ba ngan 'gro'i skar lta bu/ / rigs dang mi rigs rnam par shes gyur pas/ /ci dga' sdug pa'i rnam rtog byung gyur na/ /bdag nyid dbang du gyur pa khrel gyis 'dzem/ /de ltar rang bzhin rnam dag tshul gyur pas/ /gzhan la dogs med gzhan gyi ④dogs mi bya/ /de phyir de yi bden pa'i rjes bsnyegs ⑥tshig /sangs rgyas grub tshe bsrung ba med par 'gyur/ /phra ma dbyen spangs g.yog 'khor mi 'phrogs shing 2 / /gzhan gyi gnod pas lus la mi tshugs te/ /nan tan lhur byed dad pa dbyer med 'gyur/ /byams pa slu med 'jigs pa mi 'gyur dang / /'gro don mi gtong snying rje mi nyams thob⑧/ /thub dbang grub tshe slob ma'i dge 'dun yang //tshe rabs bskal pas phye bar mi 'gyur 'grub/ /khro ba'i rdul mang dpung du gyur pa la/ /rnam rtog rlung gis kun du 'tshub du/pa rnams/ /grags pa'i lus la grib mar 'gyur ro zhes/ /zhe gcod rnam pa byams pa'i chus bkrus shing / /64—1595

de las phyi rol tshig snyan 'jam pa yis/ /'jig rten bsam pa bde ba'i dbang du 'gyur/ /'jig rten dga' ba rtsa ba zug gyur pas/ /de yi tshig ni kun gyis blang zhing gzung / /de phyir 'jig rten rnam pa brgyar btul zhing / /de dag sdug bsngal lam ngan gcad ①bya ste/ /bsod nams las ldan 'di dang pha rol du/ /chos kyi tshul bsrungs ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /rgyang ring gnas nas zab gsal grags pa dang / /dpal ldan nye na rang bzhin bde skye ba/ /de bzhin 'brug sgra zab la gsal ba yi/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs kha yi rgyan kyang byed—/ /'khyal pa'i tshig las phyir log gyur pas na/ /mkhas pa rnams la shin tu dbe+en par 'gro/ /de yi blo yang bden par smra mos pas/ /skyon med che ba nyid kyang des thob ldupo/ /bsod nams des na thub pa'i rgyal gyur tshe/ /dka' zhing zab pa yongs su bris pa yi/ /zhu ba rnam mang grangs med dus gcig tu/ /thogs pa med pa'i tshig gis lung yang ston/ /chags sems don med 'di dang pha rol du/ /gnod pa'i 'bras bu sgrub byed blos gsal ④te/ /phrag dog med pas bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod rgyas pa thobakru/ /rnam shes dag pas de la brten pa yi/ /lus ngag yid kyi las kyang shin tu gtsang / /dus dang mthun pas gsal ba'i mkha' dbyings la//skar tshogs dri med dkyil 'khor ji bzhin 'bar/ /de yi longs spyod mchog rnams bsod nams la/ /rtag tu sbyar ba de yi blo 'jug ste/ /khengs ⑤pa nga rgyal can kyis kyeglags med cing / /rgyal po dag gis de ni bstan 3par 'gyur//de yi las dges bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu bas/ /dbang po nam yang nyams par 'gro ba rnged/ /de phyir 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod 'os pa'i/ /'khor lo 64—1596

zlog byed ston pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /gnod sems gdung ba'i rims nad yongs bsal zhing / /rang bzhin dge tshul phun sum tshogs pas na/ /shin tu zhi zhing gsal ba'i ngang tshul gyis/ /yid kyis ① mos pa shin tu gsal bar 'gyur—/ /byams pa'i ro bde khyad par thob pas na/ /'tshe ba'i tshul lam 'thab mo 'khrug ldan dang / /'phags min spyod pa las ngan rnam pa la/ /de yi blo ni nam yang 'jug mi 'gyur/ /las rung 'jam pa'i yid kyi dzulas ldan pa sha/tshangs pa'i 'jig rten de la dkon pa med/ /'jig rten kun du 'phags dang mnyam 'gyur zhing / /'gro bas lha bzhin gus pas mchod par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la phan dga' yang dang yang / /dbyar gyis bsnyogs ④pa'i chu klung chu bo dag /ston dus gsal bar dngas par 3bya ba bzhin/ /'gro ba kun gyi yid la dang ba bskyed/ /kun gyis rngu blta na yid 'ong bzang ba dang / /ye shes rgyus byung tshul mchog rmad byung ba/ /'jig rten rnam shes so sor bsgrub ④pa dag /sangs rgyas bsgrub dutshe rnam pa gcig tu bsgrub/ /log par lta ba'i 'dam la mi 'dug na/ /de bas bsgrub rmyepa'i grogs dang phrad par 'gyur/ /rang gi las bzhin 'gyur bar lam mthong bas/ /sdig pa'i las rnams de ni yongs su spongs/ /rgyal ba rnams la dad pa mi bzlogs shing tre/ /ngo mtshar bkra shis rnams kyis ⑪nyon mongs med/ /'phags pa'i lam la gnas pa de 'thob ste/ /de phyir de ni khyad par 'gro ba 'thob⑫/ /'jig tshogs lta bas 6 yang dag 'phags pas na/ /rgyu rnams zad phyir ngan 'gror de mi 'gro/ /chags med ye shes mchog dang de ldan pas/ /sa dang mtho ris chags pa med par 'gro/ /'gro ba'i don la mthu che dpa' ba yi/ /thams cad mkhyen myur 64—1597

rgyal dbang chos kyi rnams/ /rang ①rgyal la sogs thob par ma gyur pa'ang /thams cad de la de phyir mngon du 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i longs spyod yon tan rgyan ldan zhing / /rang la dbang yod bsgom 'os de dga'i rgyu/ /mkhas pa su zhig yang dag len mi byed/ /sems can phan dga' de len ci zhig smos/ /lha rdzas dga' rgyu mi yi longs spyod dang / /bde mchog ro mchog lha yi phun sum tshogs—/ /tshul khrims rgyus byung ci zhig ngo mtshar che/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams de las byung ba ltos/ /tshul khrims nyams pas rang don mi nus na/ /gzhan don tshul la mthu yod ga la 'ong / /de phyir gzhan don legs par brtson pa yis/ /'di la rim gro glod par rigs pa min/ /de bas mi bzad 'jigs pa mthong bya zhing / /spang 'os chung yang rnam par spang bar ④gyis/ /byang chub sems dpas lung bstan rmyetshul khrims dag /rang gi bde la brkam pas bral jemi bya/ /bud med lus dang tshul spyad mthong stsogs ⑤pa'i/ /skabs kyi nyes pas shag shig tshul mi bcang / /mi srun 3 skye bo nyon mongs rnam pas kyang / /tshul khrims 'dran 'dren rnam pa yongs su spangs④/ /gcig tu dkar chos tshogs ni bsags byas shing / /rnyog dang rnam bral tshul khrims bsten par bya/ /rang dbang gyur las zunyams su bde ba dang / /mkhas pas bsngags pa'i rgyan ldan tshul khrims bsrung ⑨/ /bslab pa'i gnas skabs tshang bar yongs sdogs pas⑫ / /kun rdzob bsnyems ⑫med tshul khrims yang dag bsten/ /rnam dag sems la gzugs brnyan gyur pa yi/ /gzhan don ro gcig sbyor bas de dag bsrung / /dran pa'i gzhi ldan dbang po bsdams ⑫byas shing / /tshul khrims bsrung la shin tu brtson par bya/ /'jig rten tshul khrims 'chal pa mang 64—1598

po'i mun/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis gsal ba ji bzhin gsal/ /sdug bsngal gnyen po'i don du bsten pa yang gyo/ /lus kyi rma bsku'i rngurdul la sogs pa dang / /rigs pas 'thob pas cho ga bsam byas shing / /gzhan gdong lta ba'i re ba med par bya/ /tshul dang mthun zhing yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /yid bzhin dga' ba kun gyi spyod gyur kyang / /ngo mtshar med pas nga rgyal spang bya zhing / /de las byung ba'i grags pa bsnyems mi bya/ /thob pa'i yon tan rnam pa gzugs brnyan dag /mdza' ba'i tshul gyis ①dgra dang nye ba bzhin/ /④pad+ma'i nags la zla ba'i 'od gsal ltar/ /brtul zhugs lhod pa rnams la bde ba gnod/ /tshul khrims yon tan bsgom pa'i tshul du gsungs/ /yon tan ma lus byang chub sems la gnas/ /byang chub mchog sems snying rje'i rgyu las byung / /de bas snying rje'i ngang tshul ldan par bya/ /gang zhig 'dod pa'i khams la mi gnas shing //gzugs kyi khams la'ang de bzhin mi gnas te/ /gzugs med khams la'ang de bzhin mi brten ④pa/ /de ni tshul khrims yang dag yin par brjod/ /gang zhig 'jig rten dpag yas sems can dag /mtha' dag tshul khrims dag la dgod mos shing / /'jig rten rngan phyir tshul khrims sten byed pa/ /de ni tshul khrims pha rol phyin par gsungs/ /de bas ngan song 'jigs dang rgyal srid dang / /mtho ris phun sum tshogs pa smon btsal te/ /tshul khrims dri med yang dag bsrung bya zhing / /'jig rten don la brtson pas tshul khrims bsten—/ /tshul khrims de ni khyad par thob pa'i lam/ /snying rjes ngang can rnams dang mnyam par bsgrub/ /ye shes gtsang ma lus kyi rang bzhin te/ /skyon bral rgyan du 'gyur ba'i mchog ces bya/ /khams gsum kun du yid 'ong dri 64byed1599

bsung dang / /rab tu byung dang mi 'gal byug pa yin/ /cha lugs mthun yang tshul khrims ldan gyur na/ /mi yi nang na de ni 'phags par 'gyur/ /tshig tu ma brjod tshigs su ma gyur kyang / /nyams su mkho ba'i longs spyod rim gro 'du/ /sdig ①pa med par 'jig rten kun sdud de/ /chags med ma bsgrubs dbang phyug thob par 'gyur/ /brjod du mi 'os rigs su 'byung ba dang / /phan zhing dbe+en pa gang yang ma byas shing / /sngon chad mi shes skye bo thams cad dang / /tshul khrims ldan pa'i skye bo de la 'dud/ /rkang pas bkra shis gyur pa'i rdul dag kyang / /spyi gtsug dam pas blangs shing lha dang mi/ /phyag 'tshal mgos gtugs thob pa kun du khyer/ /de phyir tshul khrims dpal ldan rigs mchog yin/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u'o// //bdud rnams thams cad yongs su rmongs byed cing / /rnam thar thob byed bde bar gang gsungs pa'i/ /bzod pa shin tu phan pa sgrub byed pa/ /de la su zhig nan tan mi byed yod/ /gzhan la gnod byed nam yang mi shes pa//brtan pa rnams kyi yid 'ong ngang tshul te/ /'jig rten don byed snying rje'i tshul bsnyems 3pa/ /yon tan mthun pa'i ming ni bzod pa yin/ /gzhan don mthun pa'i yid dang ldan pa la/ /tshul gyi dam pa bzod pa yin zhes gsungs/ /'jig rten legs pa phun sum tshogs pa dag /khro ba'i skyon la bzod pas yongs su skyob/ /mthu ldan rnams kyi rgyan kyi dam pa ste/ /dka' thub tshul 'chang rnams la stobs kyi tshul/ /gnod sems 'brog gi me la chu yi rgyun/ /'di la gzhan la gnod dgu bzod pas sel/ /skye bo mchog gi bzod pa'i go cha 64—1600

la—/ /mi srun ①skye bo'i tshig gi mdas rdugs rngupas/ /de dag bstod pa'i me tog bzang 'gyur zhing ①/ /grags pa'i phreng ba yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /skye bo gdug ④pa'i ngag gi mtshon gyi rma/ /ye shes zla ba bzhin du sem par byed/ /brtul zhugs 'chang ba brtan pa'i rang bzhin te/ /bzod pa de ni yon tan tshogs kyi gnas/ /zab cing brtan pa'i snying por gyur pa ste/ /khro ba'i gdung ba gzhil ba dbyar dang 'dra/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis brlabs pa yi/ /sgra snyan khyab pa bzod pa'i mthu las byung / /tshangs ris 'jig rten dag tu 'dzegs ⑪ pa la/ /skas kyi them bzhin skyo ba'i skyon dang bral/ /yon tan mdzes ldan mtshan rab brgyan pa yi/ /gzugs bsgrub bzo yi gnas kyang bzod pa yin/ /skyon gyi shing chen khon bzod chu bo bzhin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems kyis spel ba yin du/ /bsod nams chu yi tshogs dang rtag tu mthun/ /'jig rten gzhan du phan dge rdzogs par bsgrub⑨/ /'gro la phan don 'phel ba'i mchog kyang yin/ /grags pa'i snyan pa'i rang bzhin phul gye rgyu/ /yon tan yid bsgrub gnas kyang bzod pa yin/ /snying rjes sems can dben par mthong bas na/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas de ni skyo mi 'gyur/ /rang gi las dge 'jig rten phan byed pas/ /'jig rten kun du grags pa'i tshogs su 'gyur/ /ye shes mchog gis sbyangs pa'i bzod ldan na/ /mtshar 'dzin dpya ba kun gyis 'go ba med/ /mi rtag bzod pa'i mthu dang ldan pas na/ /bde ba'i rnam pas dga' bar 'gyur ba med/ /gnod pa'i rnam pa mi bzad mang pos kyang / /skyes mchog de dag yid ni 'gyur ba med/ /bzod pa'i stobs kyis shin tu brtan pa na/ /byang chub mchog sgrub mos pa mang bar 'gyur/ /bzod pas 64—1601

brtan pa'i spyod pa dam pa des/ /dka' thub dka' ba kun du ston byed cing / /mu stegs dregs pas mtho ba'i bsam pa dag /phan pa'i bsam pas bcil zhing dma' bar byed/ /'jig rten rmongs pa bdag snyam chags gyur te/ /lhag ma gzhan snyam nga rgyal 'chang ba dag /de yi gnod pas zil gnon sems gyur cing / /bzod dang mi ldan yongs su gdung bar 'gyur/ /skyes mchog bsam pa snying rje'i mgon ldan zhing / /bzod pas bkra shis bsgrub ①pa 'chang ba dang / /bdag tu lta ba yongs su spangs pa la/ /gnod byed gzhan dang nye yang gnod pa med—/ /brtan pa nyam chung sems kyi skyon gyur pa'i/ /khro ba log pa rnam par rtog las byung / /yang dag rtog pa yid la zhi skye zhing ④/ /bzod pa'i rnam pa mnyam par gzhog par byed/ /chu la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan yod 'dra ba'i/ /bzod pa'i rnam rtog zhi la brten pa las/ /'phags pas rtag tu skabs med 'phags par bya/ /rnam rtog zhi ba don dam bzod pa zhes/ /bzod pa'i yang dag nyid mkhyen de dag gsungasazhu/ /de bas 'jig rten mi 'dra rtogs bya zhing //rnam rtog nye bar zhi la nan tan gyes/ /mig ni mig tu zad na ci ste khro/ /rna ba la sogs der zad khro med ces/ /de ltar gang bzod skye mched ltos pa ste/ /de ni don dam nyid du bzod pa min/ /sgra dang tshig ni mi rtag rang bzhin te/ /sgra dang rnam rtog 'di yang mi rteg ④ces/ /gang bzod de ni mi rtag rtog pa ste/ /bzod pa'i mchog tu de yang gsungs pa minakhya/ /nyes pa byed pa gang la'ang yod pa min/ /gang la bya ba de yang med do zhes/ /gang bzod de ni bdag med sbyar ba ste/ /de yang bzod pa'i phul du phyin pa min/ /bde dang sdug bsngal bstod dang smad pa dag /kun kyang rten cing 'byel 'byung dngos po zhes//64—1602

gang bzod de ni rten 'byel rtogs bya'i sa/ /bzod pa shin tu mnyam bzhag de ma yin/ /'di ni yongs su rmongs pas bslus gyur pas/ /bsam pa log gyur de 'dra bdag min zhes/ /gang bzod de ni mthon ①dman bsam pa ste/ /bzod ④pa'i phul gyi go skabs de la med/ /sgra skad yi ge sgra snyan ji bzhin te/ /re re brjod cing de bzhin 'jig zhupas na/ /su la su zhig ji ltar gnod 'gyur zhes—/ /bzod pa de yang bzod pa'i phul ma yin/ /'di ni bdag gi sdig pa zad bya'i phyir/ /rang gi chos la gnod pa'ang mi lta ma// /bde gshegs dam pa ci rob ma yin ④zhes/ /gang bzod de ni ming tsam bzod ⑤pa min/ /rang gi las bzhin 'gyur ba rtogs bya zhing / /de yi yon tan rdzogs pas bzod byed pa / /de 'dra'i bzod pa'ang rnam rtog sbyor can te/ /bzod pa'i mthar phyin mchog ni de ma yin/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal mi gtsang bdag med pa/ /bdag la bzod kyi bzlog pa ma yin zhes/ /gang yin de ni gnyen po zhi bzod 'ukyi—/ /gnyis kyi rjes 'brang don dam bzod pa min/ /skye bo 'di ni yang dag mi shes pas/ /de phyir gzhan la gnod par dga'o zhes/ /gang bzod de yang mnyam nyid mnyam mi 'gro/ /bzod pa de yang rnam rtog skyon can yin/ /mtho dman mnyam pa'i rnam rtog rnam pa dag /gang tshe ma lus yar dag zhi gyur pa/ /de ni bzod pa bla med dam pa zhes/ /gnyis med lam la spyod pa de dag gsungasa3//rang dang gzhan dang gnyi ga rgyu med las/ /dngos po gang yang 'byung ba med pa dang / /rang dang gzhan dang gnyi ga rgyu med las/ /dngos po gang yang 'jig par 'gyur ba med/ /yod dang med la skye ba med pas na/ /skye ba med phyir gang yang 'gag pa med/ /dngos po'i rnam rtog rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /64—1603

yang dag mthong na bzod pa'i ①phul zhes bya/ /de thob gyur na rgyal ba 'dir 'gyur zhes/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis rnam mang lung yang bstan/ /de ni rtag tu yang dag mnyam gzhag kyang / /'jig rten phan 'dod grangs med kun du 'byung / /chos dang smon lam las la dbang thob ste/ /mos pa rdzu 'phrul skye ba'i dbang yang thob/ /de bzhin sems dang yo byad rnam pa dang / /ye shes mchog dang tshe la dbang ba thob/ /dbang gi nor mchog yun du mi zad cing / /gzhan don che sgrub de 'dra thob gyur nas/ /'gro ba mi bde'i rgyun du dzultung ba dag /yongs su bzung phyir dbang ldan de dag skye/ /de phyir gzhan don phal cher bkur spro bas/ /bzod pa thabs tshul 'di 'dra ①bsnyen par bya/ /de la gnas la gzhan don che bsam pa'i/ /spyod yul yon tan 'bras bu'i rgyan ldan 'gyur/ /'di la dad pa rtsa ba brtan gyur na/ /des kyang thub rgyal nges par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /chos kyi lam la dad pa rgyun chags na/ /bsam pa yid bzhin shing rta chag mi 'gyur/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u'o// //thams cad bzod pa'i mthu ni skyes gyur nas/ /spyod pa'i mthu chen mtha' dka' brtson 'grus kyis/ /dpa' bo brtul ④zhugs thams cad rtsom ⑤byed pas/ /lha'am bdud rnams las kyang 'phags par 'gro/ /tshe 'dir mthar phyin 'jig rten don dag kyang / /brtson 'grus med pas mthar phyin bya ba dka'—/ /yongs su skyo med brtson 'grus che ldan na/ /mi 'thob mi 'grub rnam pa gang yang med/ /skye bo ma rabs thog mar brtsams mi mos brtsams 64—1604

nas dbus su sgyid lug brtson 'grus gtong / /gzhan don ngal med brtson 'grus ldan pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das stong ①spyod pa rgya chen rtsom/ /le los bslus pa'i 'gro ba phal cher ni/ /brtson 'grus rang dbang yod kyang bdag don gtong //brtson 'grus che ldan gzhan la ltos med ni/ /gzhan don khur chen skyo ba med par 'khyer/ /snga phyi 'khor ba'i mtha' dang mnyam tsam du/ /rgya che ring ba'i nyin dang mtshan gyur la/ /de 'dra bsags pas lo gyur dus ring ba'i/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i chu thigs grangs snyed kyis/ /byang chub mchog gi sems gcig skye 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i rnam pas tshogs gzhan de re zhing / /bsgrub dgos gyur kyang snying 1 rjes skyo bsal te/ /byang chub dam pa sgyid lug med par bsgrub1 —/ /'khor tshe rang gi sdug bsngal sems gtang ④zhing / /go cha brtan pa dpag yas de bskyed na/ /brtul zhugs dpa' bo snying rje'i ngang can la/ /yang ⑤dag blangs pa dang po yin par brjod/ /'jig rten mes bkang rkang gis 'bog bya zhing / /sa chen mtshon gyis dkrigs pas byugazigs byas te/ /bde gshegs lta bar mos dang gang ldan zhing / /chos kyi bdud rtsi zhi ba mchog bsrung dang / /'khor ba'i 'dam nas skye bo 'di dag kun/ /bdag gis bton te byang chub bde dgod 3ces/ /goms pa bteg cing bor ba'i dus dag tu/ /gang zhig de 'drar mnyam 'jog '-isems 'chang dang / /'jig rten phan phyir brtson 'grus che bskyed cing / /gzhan la phan pa'i bsod nams mang bsgrubs spupa/ /de ni mi zad ⑫pa yi brtson 'grus te/ /dpal ldan yang dag blangs pa gnyis zhes bya/ /bsod nams rnam pa ci sgrub dus na yang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du sngo ⑪byed na/ /de ni mi zad yang dag 64—1605

bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yang dag len pa'i mchog ces thub pas gsungs/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu thigs gcig bor ba/ /rgya mtsho ma zad dus su zad mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub mchog tu bsngos pa yi/ /bsod nams rnam pa zad par 'gyur ba med/ /de yang snying rje rnam dag sems ldan zhing / /'gro ba rgyu dang mi rgyu ma lus kun/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par bsgrub bya zhes/ /sems can dam pa bsod nams de dag rtsom/ /stong gsum chen po'i 'gro ba ji snyed pa//nyi ma gcig gis ①la la sgol byed la/ /bskal pa du mar de bzhin bsgral byas kyang / /sems can khams las mang po ma bsgral zhes/ /sems can mi zad de 'dra thos gyur kyang / /ma lus sems can bsgral bar rab mos shing / /sgyid lug skyon gyis ma bzung bsgon ldan na/ /don gyi ②snying po de la ring ba min//'gro ba kun gye bsod nams gcig bsgrub zhupa/ /de snyed bcu sde'agyur bsgyur bas bde gshegs kyi/ /ba spu'i khung gcig mngon par 'grub 'gyur la/ /spu rnams gcig nas re rer mngon 'grub cing / /ba spu mngon sgrub bsod nams de dag tshogs/ /brgya 'gyur dag tu bsgyur ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /dpe byad bzang gcig 'grub cing de bzhin du/ /dpe byad bzang po'i lhag ma kun 'grub cing / /dpe byad bzang pos bsdus pa'i bsod nams tshogs/ /de snyed stong du bsgyur ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon par sangs rgyas tshe/ /mtshan ni thusna tshogs re re byu'agrub 'gyur la/ /mtshan rab bskyed 3pa'i bsod nams rgyur gyur te/ /stong du bsgyur ba'i bsod nams phung po las/ /zla ba nya ltar mdzes shing gsal ba yi/ /mdzod spu mdog bzang yid 'ong 'grub 'gyur ba/ /mdzod spu mngon sgrub khrubasod nams de snyed tshogs/ /64byed1606

brgyar 'gyur stong du bsgyur ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /spyi gtsug bltar mi mthong ba'i mtshan ldan pa'i/ /gtsug tor rgyan mdzes sangs rgyas dbu 'grub ste/ /de 'dra'i bsod nams sgrub tshul de dag kyang / /bdag gis bsgrub ces byang chub sems mthong na/ /brtson 'grus 'dor ba de la gang gi sgorakhye/ /sgyid lug le lo'i cha shas skabs su 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams kun sems can ma lus par/ /rang rgyal rnams dang thams cad 'drar gyur kyang / /bzod la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig /ye shes dam pas de dag kun pas 'phags—/ /de snyed bzod pa'i stobs la gnas pa bas/ /mi ldog byang chub sems dpa' gcig 'phags te/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dge la bsgrub pa de ni ngal mi shes/ /mi ldog byang chub sems dpa' de snyed pas//skye ba gcig thogs ④rgyal sras de 'phags te/ /brtson 'grus brtan dang ldan pa'i nang na yang / /byang chub shing drung phyin pa ci zhig smos/ /rnam pa de 'dra'i ye shes rnam dag dang / /'jig rten ma lus sems can kun ldan yang / /byang chub snying po'i shing drung phyin gyur la/ /bdud 'dul skye ba tha ma'i char mi 'gro—/ /de 'dra'i ye shes rnam pa dag ldan pas/ /'jig rten ma lus khams kun gang gyur kyang / /yon tan rnam mang de dag gcig sogs pas/ /bde gshegs stobs kyi cha la'ang mnyam mi 'gro/ /de 'dra'i ye shes rgya mtsho rmad byung ba//gzhan sems shes pa'i mthu la thogs med cing / /ye shes snang ba mkha' ltar yangs pa la/ /snying rje ldan pa gcig pu pha rol rgal/ /sems can ma lus kun la khyab pa yi/ /snying rje chen po 'jig rten kun du 'byung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi rnam pa dag /rmad byung ma lus de phyir yang dag grub/ /64—1607

de 'dra'i sems can dma' bas mnyan khye dga' ba'i/ /yang dag blang ba'i buyon tan kun ldan na/ /yang dag nyid lam yan lag brgyad ldan zhing ④/ /brtson 'grus phul byung shin tu rnam par mdzes/ /brtson 'grus rnam gsum dge ba sbyor ba ste/ /lus dang ngag yid brtson 'grus rnam pa las/ /'jug dang gnas dang mnyam par bzhag pa yi/ /brtson 'grus phul byung yid las byung ba yin/ /byang chub sems la mos shing zhi ba dang / /snying rje che dang bdag med bzod pa ④dang / /'gro ba sdug bsngal bsdu ba rnam bzhi dang / /chos rnams kun la yongs su 'dzin med dang / /'khor ba'i 'dam na yongs su skyo med dang / /khams gsum thams cad nye bar mi dmigs shing / /bdog pa kun gtong nga rgyal 'gyur med dang / /bslab pa kun la yang dag slob pa dang / /gzhan gyi gnod pas mi 'gyur brtan ldan zhing / /sems la rnam 'khrug ⑤nam yang mi 'byung dang / /dge ba'i las la brtson pa brtan pa dang / /dbe+en la dga' ba'i ro gcig sems ldan dang / /bsam gtan bzhi por mnyam par gzhog pa dang / /bdag med nges par rtogs pa'i sems ldan dang / /thos pa mang pos ngom khupar mi 'gyur zhing / /rigs par 'jug cing de la rtog pa dang / /ji ltar thob tsupa yang dag ston byed cing / /brjod med chos nyid yang dag shes pa dang / /mngon shes lnga la mthu chen ldan pa dang / /mngon shes drug la sgom tsam byed pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa mngon par sgrub pa dang //spyod pa tshegs 4med shin tu gsal spub dang / /yang dag spong la sbyor ba byed pa dang / /dge dang mi dge'i phyogs las rnam grol zhing / /dbang po nges par bya la mkhas pa dang / /chos rnams dbang bo med par shes gyur cing / /las 64—1608

kyi tshogs rnams yongs su tshol byed kyang / /gar yang 'gro med rmad byung zab pa dang / /de la sogs pa sems spangs brtson pa'i lus/ /gzud cing dgod pa'i khyad par 'phags pa can/ /de nyid mi zad yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /dgon pa'i brtson 'grus khyad par rgyu yang yin/ /ye shes mchog gi las la gnas 'cha' yang / /mtshan ma'i las la de ni 'jug pa med/ /snying rje chen pos 'dus byas mi gtong zhing / /brtson 'grus che yang 'dus byas med mi be+eng //sngon chad ma thos chos thos gnod pa med/ /cis kyang mi tshugs thos pa'i chos kyang 'dzin/ /mi min kun kyang de la phan par dga'/ /ting 'dzin rnam pa kun kyang thob par 'gyur/ /nyin mtshan dus rnams 'bras bu yod par zla/ /yon tan tshogs kyis ①dma' bar 'gyur ba med/ /mi yi chos las 'phags pa'i don rnams kyis/ /me tog at+pa la bzhin rnam par 'phel/ /grags pa yang ②dang bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /ser sna dogs 3spangs yid tshul mchog kyang 'thob/ /tshe 'di'i yon tan ji snyed snang ba kun/ /brtson pa'i tshul 'byung yon tan che ba med/ /yon tan che mnga' rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /khams gsum mchod 'os nyid kyang de las grub④/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i yon tan de 'dra na/ /brtson 'grus che la gang zhing brtson mi byed/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u'o// //de nas ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bsam gtan tshul la brtson par bya/ /'jig rten phan pa'i rnam pa dag /ye shes snang bas bde bar 'grub/ /bsam gtan tshul gyis sems dag na/ /ston kyi dus kyi sprin bsal ba'i/ /64—1609

mkha' la zla ba gsal ba ltar/ /ye shes khyad du dang bar 'gyur/ /rnam dag tshul khrims ldan byas shing / /dge phan grogs dang brten ①byas te/ /bya ba nyung zhing zhi ba'i ngang / /dran pas byin rlabs tshul bcang ste/① /shing drung brtul zhugs gnas dag gam/ /ṣ+pe'u gseng snyug gu'i sa gzhi 'am/ /ched du ma byas mdangs dga' ba'i/ /nags kyi me tog dri zhim pa'am/ /bsam gtan rkyen du 'os pa yi/ /chog shes 'gro ba'i gnas dag gam/ /'gro ba'i sgra skad mi 'byung bar/ /zab mor gnas pa'i gnas dag gam/ /dgon pa'i sa gzhi bzang po 'am/ /stong pa'i gnas dang khyim dag gam/ /sman ljongs ri khrod dbe+en pa dag /seng ge'i nga ro grags zuganas sam/ /'du 'dzi dhinyon mongs dben gyur pa'i/ /gang yang rung ba'i gnas dag tu/ /skyil mo krung du bder 'dug ste/ /drang po'i lus ni bsrang byas shing / /drang ba'i bsrung ba sems gzhi la/ /nye bar yang dag gzhag bya ste/ /snying rjes log par rtogs pa rnams/ /skabs med tshul du dam bcas shing / /shes par rab shes bya ba'i dus / /'di yin mya ngan 'das dus min/ /sems can mya ngan ma 'das su//mya ngan 'da' bar mos med ces/ /de ltar 'jig rten phan bsams khrute/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mos bskyed cing / /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsam gtan bsgrub la brtson par bya/ /yang dang yang zhing ngal bso na/ / gtsubs pas hūṃme phyin me 'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor tshul la'ang de bzhin du/ /khyad par ma thob gtong khye mi bya/ /dmigs pa gcig la brtan tshul du/ /yid kyi bsam pa brtan par bya/ /dmigs pa mang po brgyud ④pa las/ /'di ni nyon mongs 'khrug par 'gyur/ /lhag mthong brtson pa'i stobs kyi mthus/ /64byed1610

zhum par gyur na gzengs ①yang bstod/ /rgod par gang tshe gyur pa'i yid/ /zhi gnas tshul rmis bzlog par bya/ /ting 'dzin mthu ni mi g.yo zhing / /yang dag gyur na btang snyoms gzhag /bde gshegs ting 'dzin thob bya'i phyir/ /de la chags par yod mi bya/ /bsam gtan dga' ba'i ro myang rngu bas rang dbang med pa'i nyam mi blang / /bdag gi bde tsam thob kyedon du/ / brtsam pa ④rgya chen 'di sgrub min/ /lus dang srog la lta ba yi/ /zhum pas non gyur sems gyur cing / /rang gi mgo bo ⑤tshig gyur kyang / /brtson 'grus lhod par des mi bya/ /mtshan ma'i rnam pa shes byas shing / /yid ni mnyam par gzhag pa'i phyir/ /dmigs las bsam pa nyams gyur na/ /dran pas phyir yang bsdu bar bya/ /sgrib pa rnams las rang gi yid/ /glang po rang dbang thob bye'agyur na—/ /lcags kyus bzlog par bya ba bzhin/ /log pa'i phyogs las bzlog par bya/ /de nas sgrib pa'i nad kyi rnams/ /bsal bas sos pa'i yid gyur cing / /dbul po nyam thag phongs pa las/ /longs spyod skyid thob thar pa bzhin / /bde dang ldan pa'i yid kyis ni/ /'dod pa'i skyon rnams bsal bar bya/ /de dang bral bas dmigs pa yi/ /bde ba gcig nas gcig brgyud kyang / /glog ltar mi rtag 'gyur ba dang / /dbu ba gsog ltar bdag med pa'i—/ /rmi lam bzhin du don med parathu/ /bslu ba'i don du 'ongs 'dra dor/ /pha rnams bu la byams pa dang / /bu rnams pha la de bzhin te/ /mdza' la mdza' bo byams pa dang / /'gro rnams phan tshun byams pa dag /yon tan tshogs kyis bsgrub ④byas shing / /brtan pa'i snying pos brtan byas te/ /g.yul du gru gdong 'dren bzhin gyispu/ /mdza' byams sa mtshams 'jigs byed 64—1611

kyang / /'di tshe brtsal ba'i snyug bsngal dang / /gzhan du ngan 'gro skyed byed pa'i—/ /rgyur gyur 'dod pa'i rnam pa yin/ /de bas 'dod pa bsten mi bya/ /rnam rtog rnams kyi gzhir gyur cing / /bdag dang gzhan rnams kun gyi yang / /shes rab mig ldongs byed pa'i rgyu/ /mi bde sna tshogs skyed pa yang / /bdag 'dod don la brtson par bya/ /rnam pa kun du yongs spangs pa'i/ /'dod pa de dag gzhan don la/ /brtson pas dran byar 'os pa min①/ /'dod pa de dag thob pa dang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bsten pa dang / /mang du ②bsags pas mi ngoms na/ /de las nad chen gang zhig yod/ /btsal tshe ro med nyon mongs la/ /bsrung tshe 'jigs pa skyed byed cing / /med 'gyur ①mya ngan che bskyed rjon/ /de la 'dod byed su zhig yod/ /gang gi ro la stsos gyur na/ /rang don nyid kyang mi rigs te3/ /myos 'gyur sbyon chu ji bzhin pa'i/ /'dod pa sems ldan su zhig bskyedablu/ /de ltar rnam pa thams cad du/ /'dod pa skyon ldan shes gyur na/ /de las sems ni ldog 'gyur te/ /'byung lam chos la mos par 'gyur/ /dbe+en las skyes pa'i dga' dang bde/ /bag yangs 7thob las skyes pa 'byung / /yan lag de dang ldan pas na/ /bsam gtan dang po thob pa yin/ /der ni rnam rtog rnam dpyod 3dag /'dod ldan skyon ldan mthong 'gyur zhing / /de dag zhi ba tshol byed pas/ /ting 'dzin dga' skyes bde ba thobakye/ /nang ni yongs su dang gyur zhing / /de sems rtse gcig gyur pa ni/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa'i bsam gtan zhes/ /gnyis med drang srong mchog gis gsungs/ /yid kyi 'khrug long yin shes nas/ /dga' las 'dod chags bral gyur pa/ /dran pa btang snyoms ldan pa yi/ /61—1612

bsam gtan gsum pa thob par 'gyur/ /bde ba'i bsam pa yongs btang bas//bde dang sdug bsngal med gyur cing / /btang snyoms dran pas rnam dag pa'i/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa 'thob gyopar 'gyur/ /de nas mngon shes lnga thob ste/ /chos rgyal rgyal srid gnas pa na/ /dpal ldan grags pa khrel dang gzungs/ /de yi burjes su 'brang bar 'gyur/ /gzhan kyi don du mngon bsgrubs pas/ /rang rgyal nyan thos yon tan la/ /de dag shin tu 'das gyur cing / /shin tu khyad 'phags mthu dang ldan/ /gtong ba kye'ajungs pa 'god byed cing / /tshul khrims med pa tshul la 'god/ /khro ba bzod byung des pa dang / /sgyid lug brtson 'grus chen po dang / /'khrug pa'i sems ldan bsam gtan dang / /shes rab 'chal pa shes rab la/ /snying rje chen po skyo med par/ /brtson 'grus spyod pas sbyor ba byed/ /de nas mtha' yas spyod yul can/ /nyi ma 'od chen ji bzhin du/ /mi nyams gsal ba'i 'od chen gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad snang bar byed/ /de nas sems can sdig can dag /ngan 'gror ltung bar gyur pa dang / /bsod nams tshe dag zad gyur cing / /lha las ltung bar gyur pa dang / /'jig rten sdug bsngal de dang des/ /yongs su gdung bar gyur pa dag /'jig rten khams na gang yod pa/ /lha mig jegasal bas mthong gyur cing / /snying rje chen po skye 'gyur te/ /snying rje ldan pas bag med spong / /gzhan don sgrub la bag yod pas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mthu dang ldan//de nas 'jig rten khams mang na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mang bzhugs dang / /sangs rgyas zhing gi rgyan dag dang / /dge 'dun phun sum tshogs mthong zhes/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog gi/ /rnam dag spyod yul spyod mthong ste/ /64—1613

sems can gzhan la phan don du/ /dpal ldan spyod pa mthong gyur pas/ /de la smon lam che skyed cing / /smon lam dkyil 'khor 'grub 'gyur te/ /gzhan don rgya chen sngo byed pas/ /rgyal sras tshul mchog yongs su 'grub/ /mi las 'das pa'i rna ba ste/ /lha yi rna ba rnam dag pas/ /rgyang ring sgra rnams nye ba bzhin / /che chung rnam pa kun thos shing / /snying brtse med pas gang smras pa'i/ /zhe gcod ro med tshig gi rnams/ /khro ba'i me las byung ba yi/ /me stag rgal 'dra thos 'gyur zhing / /lha mo'i glu ru ⑨snyan pa dang / /rgyan gyi phar phur sel khrol dang / /lha rdzas rol mo'i sgra snyan pas/ /mi rtag tshul thos sgra thos shing / /'jigs dang sdug bsngal rnam pa las/ /mi bzad mya ngan drag po'i sgra/ /nyon mongs nyams bab thos pa dag /mi dga'i rnam pa thos gyur na/ /skul ④ma drag pos bsgul ba bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu ldan zhing / /khong nas snying rje che ldan te/ /brtson 'grus mchog ni rtsom ④par byed/ /'jig rten sna tshogs 'jig ④pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams las chos thos te/ /mya ngan 'das la mos pa'i blos/ /sems can don mang sgrub 3par byed/ /gzhan sems tshul la de mkhas shing / /bag la nyal dang bsam shes pas/ /ye shes yo byad ldan pa de/ /bsod nams myu gu gsar yang bskyeda'u/ /bskal pa bye ba mang po yi/ /sngon gyi gnas rnams rjes dran zhing / /'jig rten bsod nams rnam pa dang / /stobs dang stobs med mthong gyur nas/ /de dag bsam pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam pas lus bsgyur cing / /snod bzhin ston par byed pas na/ /don yod rjod byed mchog tu 'gyur/ /la lar gzugs mdzes yun kluldan zhing / /nyi ma brgya 3lta'i 'od ldan te/ /ri mo 64—1614

gsal ba'i mtshan rgyas pa/ /thub rgyal mtshan ldan sku mchog gis/ /'gro ba'i mig la bde skyid cing / /yid la khyab par sem byed pas/ /rgyal dbang mos pa byang chub tu/ /bsgrub phyir 'chi med ston par byed/ /thub dbang zhi tshul dpal ldan pa'i/ /spyod pa rnam par spyod byed cing / /la lar 'dul dbang ji bzhin du/ /slob ma'i tshul gyis ①'dul bar byed/ /la lar lha dbang brgya byin bzhin/ /lha yi spyi bo zhabs la thugarngu /nor sbyin ji bzhin nor mang gtong / /la lar tshangs ltar gzugs 1mchog 'dzin/ /la lar spyan gsum phye ba ste/ /dri med zla ba'i rgyan ldan ston/ /la lar lha mi'i rgyal po dang /klu yi dpal chen khyer ba ston/ /la lar gnod sbyin rgyal po ltar/ /rdo rje 'bar ba thogs pa ston/ /yon tan 'od ldan thub zla ltar/ /la lar g.yang gzhi mtshan bstan ston/ /la lar brgya byin nor bu yis/ /brang la 'od 'bar mdzes pa ston/ /la lar chu yi lha gzugs dang / /la lar 'dod pa'i lha ltar ston / /la lar bud med gzugs mdzes dang / /la lar pho smos dga' ba ston—/ /la lar brtul zhugs nor ldan te/ /'dod las 'dod chags bral ba ston/ /la lar mi rnams yid 'phrog cing / /slob dpon slob ma rgyal po byed—/ /la lar mthu chen byen rlabs ④kyis/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rnam mang sel—/ /'gro ba'i dad pa tshul bzhin du/ /sna tshogs spyod pa las bstan zhing / /snying rje'i yon tan rgya che bas/ /'jig rten phan pa 3grangs med byed/ /bsam gtan 'di 'dra'i gnas thob cing / /khyad par phun sum tshogs thob pas//gter gyi mtshan ma slu med bzhin/ /khyad par gong nas gong brtson bya/ /de la gnas 'cha' yan bor cing / /brtul zhugs lhod pa'i tshul bor te/ /dge 64—1615

ba spel phyir brtson par bya/ /de las bzlog pa dman par 'gro/ /ting 'dzin rtsom 7pa med pa ste/ /rjes su bsgrub pa dkon pas na/ /rnam par rgyal ba 'dod rnams kyis/ /zhi ba'i gnyen po tshugs med bsten/ /yid tshul spang ba'i mchog gyur kyang / /sa ltar mi g.yo brtan pa yi/ /sa mchog mi g.yo ma thob tu/ /de la yid brtan g.yo mi bya/ /mngon par 'dus byas lam byas pa/ /ting 'dzin bsgrub pa'ang 'jig par 'gyur/ /de bas rnam rtog rnam spangs te/ /lam gyi dam pa bsgom par bya/ /bde gtsang rtag pa'i rnam rtog dag /'dus byas slu ba'i chos can du/ /yang dag rtogs par shes bya ste/ /dngos po'i rnam rtog yongs su spang / /dmigs pa chung yang byung gyur na/ /nyon mongs mdas gtsag thugazhir yang 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i gnod pa kun bcil na/ /bdud kyi spyod yul 'das par 'gyur/ /gnas pa'i skyon dang ldan gyur na/ /bsam gtan rnam dag tshul mi 'gyur/ /gnas pa'i rjes 'brangs 3nyams pa ste/ /dong skam bcas zhes de phyir brjod/ /tha snyad tshul dag 'grub don du/ /de ni 'jig rten lam zhes bya/ /yod dang med byung gtang med pas/ /gang na'ang ci yang skye ba med/ /nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra yid ldan na/ /srid pa gsum gye gnas dang bral/ /tshul 'chos bral ba'i spyod brtan la/ /kha gsag med pa'i tshul ldan na/ /'jig rten spyod pa de byed kyang / /'gro ba gcig tu phan pa spyod/ /sems la dbang gyur thob pas na/ /ting 'dzin stobs las nyams pa med/ /de thob yan chad rmad byung ba'i/ /ting 'dzin 'bras bu mang ldan pas/ /dbyar dus rgya mtsho chu klung dag /chu gsar ④byung bas skye zhing 'phel / /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u'o// //64—1616

sbyin ①la sogs pa'i bsod nams 'di dag ni/ /shes rab mgon bcas lhag par mthu ldan 'gyur/ /gser gyi rgyan bzangs ②rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /rin chen phra ③bkod 'od kyis gsal ba bzhin/ /so so'i don la de dag yon tan mthu/ /shes rab 'di nyid rgya chen sgrub par byed/ /dbang ④po rang rang yul gyi bye brag la/ /mthu zhen yid kyis gsal bar bstan pa bzhin/ /lus 'di srog dang bral na mthu med cing / /rang gi dgos pa bsgrub phyopa mi mdzes pa//de bzhin shes rab med pas blo gyur na/ /don sgrub 'jig rten dag na mdzes pa med—/ /dad la sogs pa'i dbang po'i rnam pa yang / /dbang po gzhan la blo 'dzin shes rab gtso/ /de yi mgon ldan yon tan skyon shes pas/ /nyon mongs zad pa'i tshul la mkhas par 'gyur/ /shes rab med na 'bras bu don gnyer la/ /sbyin pa bdag nyid rnam par dag mi 'gyur/ /gzhan don btang ba sbyin pa'i mchog ces gsungs/ /lhag ma nor spel don gyi spyor ba yin/ /shes rab mi gsal rnam par bying gyur ⑥ na/ /byang chub sems dpas rang gi sha byen na/ /sman gyi shing ltar rnam par mi rtog par/ /mtho 'am dma' bar 'gyur ba de la med/ /de bas 'jig rten 'das pa don gyi gzhi/ /khro med dga' bas phun sum tshogs pa'i sems/ /sbyin pa chen pos 'gro don bsgrub mos pa/ /rgyal sras sa yi dang po 'thob ④par 'gyur/ /de la gnas pa phal cher byang chub tu/ /mi 'phrogs dublo 'chang 'khor los byesgyur bar 'gyur/ /shes rab mthus bstan ⑩lam mchog bde ba des/ /rim gyis dri med rgyal sras sa yang thob/ /de nas rang bzhin rnam dag tshul 'chang zhing / /gling bzhi 64—1617

'khor los kyesgyur bar de 'gyur te/ /rgyal po kun gyi spyi bos bka' blang zhing / /thub dbang rgyal ba bzhin du (yimachod par 'gyur/ /de dag yan chad 'dod pa'i lha ris dang / /'jig rten byur bu stong gnyis stong gsum kyi/ /dbang phyug thob 'gyur de dag yan chad du/ /shes rab 'od kyis rgyu rnams sbyangs pas 'thob—/ /shes rab snang bas mun pa ma bsal na/ /tshul khrims dag dang ldan par de mi 'gyur/ /phal cher shes rab med pas tshul khrims dag /shes pa'i skyon gyis nyon mongs rnyog bcas 'gyur/ /rang gi don du tshul khrims mi bsgrub bye ༄na/ /blo ldan srid pa'i btson ra'i skyon mthong zhing / /de nas 'jig rten ma lus gdon mos pa/ /srid pa'i don du mi sgrub smos ci dgos/ /shes rab log pa'i skyon gyis sems rnyog na/ /bzod pa'i yon tan de la gnas ci smos—/ /legs par rtogs la mi dga'i tshul 'chang zhing / /yon tan med pa'i rgyan la grags pa bzhin/ /shes rab ldan pa rnams la gnod pa dag /bzod pa'i yon tan yod pas gnod mi 'gyur/ /shin tu dul ba'i glang po mchog rnams la/ /las kyi khyad par rnam mang bzod pa bzhin/ /brtson 'grus gcig pu byas pa ngal ba'i mtha'/ /shes rab grogs kyis bstangs ④na don chen 'grub/ /bsgrubs rngubyas rjes la de yi yon tan 'thob/ /de las byung ba'i dub pa yongs su sel/ /mkhas pa rnams la phul du bsngags 'gyur zhing / /de las phra zhing zab pa ⑥gzhan med pas/ /'dod pa'i skyon gyis dze+eyongs su ma bsgribs pa'i/ /yid lam drang por shes rab med mi 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i bsam gtan bde dga' mchog ldan pa/ /skyon bsags nyes pa chen po ④grags gyur pa'i/ /lam gol rigs pa'i tshul las ⑨brten pa ni⑫/ /skye bo ma 64—1618

rabs yid la ji ltar 'grub/ /shes rab tshul la brtson med blo 'chang na/ /de yi lta ba yongs su dag mi 'gyur/ /de med tshul khrims mi 'dag de med pas//nying 'dzin mi 'thob sdug bsngal zad mi 'gyur/ /shes rab ldan pas skyon las bag byed cing / /yon tan tshogs las rgyun du bde thob khyepas/ /nyon mongs 'gro ba'i don la rab brtson zhing / /yon tan tshogs kyi dubade ba'i lam du 'jug /yang dag rtogs pas ting 'dzin 'thob 1par 'gyur/ /ngag yid lus rnams rnam par dag pa 'grub/ /de phyir skyon med mthu dang ldan gyur pa/ /'jig rten phan pa phun sum tshogs la/ 'jug /sbyin pas ci 'dod yid bzhin sgrub ④pa byed/ /tshig snyan bdud rtsi shin tu gsal ba dang / /rgyu med mthu dang ldan pa'i sdom pa yis/ /gzhan gyi don la mnyam par kun du spyod/ /don la thun mong yang dag bstan byas shing / /byams pas de dag yid ni dbang bskur ⑤te/ /shes rab stobs kyis dzo'akhor lo thogs med de/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde la 'god par byed/ /shes rab sngon 'gro mthu chen 'di dag gis/ /byin gyis ④brlabs shing yongs su bsrungs pas na/ /mtsho med ngan 'gro bu'achi dang smad pa dang / /dogs pa'i stobs kyis ⑨'jigs pa nyer mi 'ong /'jigs pa thams cad skyon las byung ba ste/ /shes rab skyon dang lhan cig mi 'grogs pas/ /ston gyi nam mkha'i sprin tshogs med pa la/ /nyi 'od gsal ba mun dang mi 'grogs bzhin/ /nyi ma 'od chen shar bar gyur bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i rgyud rnams mun nag gang 'gebs lngapa/ /shes rab 'od kyi mthu chen 'byung bas na/ /thams cad gsal ⑪'gyur ming tsam 'ba' zhig lus/ /gang la shes rab 'od chen shar gyur pa/ /de la bya ba'i lhag ma las pa med/ /64—1619

bskal pa'i mes bsregs 'jig rten gsal ①ba'i tshe/ /bsreg bya'i lhag ma yod par brjod med bzhin/ /snang ba thams cad gcig tu 'dus gyur kyang / /shes rab 'od la bskrun du ②nyer mi 'gro/ /de bas khe chen de las mchog gzhan med—/ /yongs su mnyam pa med par ④'ang gzhan med do/ /shes rab tshul brtson bslab pa bde tshul du/ /yongs su sdogs 'gyur tshul khrims zhi bar 'gyur//de bas rang gi mthu rnams kun gtugs te/ /de 'dra'i shes rab tshul la brtson par bya/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rgyu dag dang / /bden pa'i gnas la som nyir mi 'gyur zhing / /dus gsum de 'drar bsdus pa'i rigs pa ni/ /shes rab shin tu sbyangs pa'i yul 'jug yin/ /shes rab dag sbyangs spyod pa'i rnam pa dag /yid ches dka' ④zhing yon tan snang la yang / /skyi g.ya' ngo mtshar thob pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /rgyal sras grags pa chen pos khyab par 'gyur//shin tu mthu 'bar shes rab stobs kyi phul/ /bdud dang dpung bcas tshogs kyis bzod mi nus/ /shes rab yod kyis de dag mig rmongs pas/ /de dag mgo 'degs ⑤lta bar mos pa med/ /'dod pa'i ltas 'phangs mda' la mgo thub pa'i/ /shes rab go cha sems kyis brtan bgos na/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i dmag mang tshogs kyi rnams/ /gcig pu 'jigs med zil gyis mnan cing 'gro—/ /mi brtan ngang tshul 'jigs shing rtabs pa 'am/ /glen pa'i ngang tshul mya ngan 'dzin pa 'am/ /mthu zhan dusems la rtsa ba zug gyur pa'i/ /khro dang chags dang dman zil gnod pa 'am/ /phan byed rnams la 'jungs pa'i dri ma dag /'dod chags ldan la rten 'cha' rgod pa 'am/ /gzi brjid mthu chung le lo'i bsam pa dang / /shin tu g.yeng bas ma zhi 'char tshul dag /so so'i 64—1620

rkyen gyi bsam pa thibs po la/ /gnas 'cha' nyes pa'i rnam pa de dang de/ /'gro la phan don dam bcas shes rab can/ /shes rab chen pos ma lus yongs su sel/ /skyon bral brtan zhing ngang des de mkhyen nas/ /dga' bde skyid phyir legs par de gzigs shing / /dbang bskur bdud rtsi shin tu sem byed pas / /thub dbang rnams kyis de ni dbang yang bskur/ /bde gshegs mdzod spu mtshan rab thon khyepa yi/ /'od chen zla ba gsal bzhin sem byed pas//rgyal sras de yi mgo nas dbang bskur na/ /mchod sbyin me la mar khyas blugs ltar mdzes/ /chos rgyal rgyal tshab thabs de thob gyur na/kye/ /phyogs bcu kun du sprul pa'i lus bkye pyazhing / /sprin chen char gye rgyun gyis rdul bsal bzhin/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal lhun gyis grub par sel/ /rgyal sras mthu mchog de 'dra rmad byung dag /thams cad shes rab de yi mthu las byung / /bu la byams pa'i ma 'dra shes rab las/ /de 'dra'i phun sum tshogs 'byung ci mtshar gyi④/ /bde gshegs stobs bcu stobs kyi phul byung ba/ /mtshungs med mchog tu bya ba thams cad dang / /yon tan tshogs gzhan ma lus thams cad kyang / /de 'dra'i shes rab rgyu la brten zhing phya'abyung / /'jig rten dag na sgyu rtsal gter mchog dang / /gtsug lag mig 'dra ci snyed yod pa dang / /yongs su skyob /snebyed blo dang sngags la sogs/ /rnam bkod chos kyi khyad par tha dad dang / /rnam grangs rnam mang rnam thar sgo dag dang / /'jig rten phan pa'i rnam pa de dang des/ /rgyal sras mthu chen rnam par ston byed pa/ /de dag thams cad shes rab mthu las 'byung hūṃ/ /dbang po'i 4yul rnams lha rdzas 'dra bdog kye pa'i—/ /rgyal srid che ldan byang chub sems dpa' dag /rang bzhin tshul min 64—1621

'gyur ba med pa yang / /shes rab yon tan blon po ldan pa'i mthus①/ /gzhan la phan byed ro gcig byams pa la/ /'dod chags 'go ba yongs su spang ba ④dang / /gzhan gyi snyug bsngal mi bzod snying rje la/ /mya ngan khur gye le los mi dma' dang / /dga' mchog dang ldan yang dag g.yeng med dang / /'gro don mi g.yel btang snyoms chen po dang / /yon tan de dang de dag gnyen po'i lam/ /shes rab chen pos bakhre/ga pas rnam par mdzes bsam pa bag la nyal la bka' brtsan kyepa'i/ /shes rab nyi 'od 'bar ltar bude med na/ /su zhig yun ring 'jig rten rkyen 'byung ba'i/ /rang bzhin tshul gyur mun nag sel nus yod/ /brtan 'os bla ma rim gro bsnyen bkur te/ /shes rab bsgrub khyephyir thos pa btsal bar bya/ /rnam pa sum cu gnyis kyis shes bya ste/ /yang dag mnyam gzhag yid kyis rnam par sel/ /thos nyung dmus long bsgom dupa'i tshul mi shes/ /de med des ko ci zhig bsam par bya/ /de bas thos la brtson bya de rgyu las/ / bsams bzhin bsgoms ⑦pas shes rab yangs pa 'byung / /dri ma rtsod 0med sgo dang brtan pa dang / /don tshol rtogs pa'i mthu yod rtogs pa dang / /bsam gtan de yi yon tan skyed pa bas/ /shes rab bsgrub la mngon par brtson par bya/ /shes rab thob pa'i tshul la thabs kyi mdo/ /bsam gtan de don nges pa'i thos mang ba/ /yon tan tshogs rgyu shes rab snang ba ni/ /gnyis bo de las gtsub byeshing me ltar 'byung / /mkhas pa'i skye bos spyod pa'i lam bsten te/ /gti mug rgyur gyur thibs po spang bar bya de bsgribs gyur na zla ba shar gyur kyang / /char sprin cher bsgribs mi snang mtshungs mi snang / /le lo snyom dang rten ngan brten ⑪pa dang / /gnyid kyi dbang gyur 64—1622

mi rtog ngang tshul dang / /thub pa'i ye shes mchog la mos med dang / /log pa'i nga rgyal non pas don 'dri dang / /dma' sems ngag la zhen pas byung ba'i rgyus—/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo bsten par ma dad dang / /log pa'i rnam rtog dus tshe log lta dag /gti yug rgyu yin de bsal gnyen po ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched bden pa dang / /rig pa dag dang rgyu byung tshul brtag dang / /chos la mkhas pa'i rnam pa de dag ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi yul brgyad rnam pa yin—/ /gzugs rnams dbu ba'i tshogs 'dra snying po med/ /tshor ba rnam gsum chu yi chu bur tshul/ /'du shes 'dod pa'i yon tan zhugs pa ni/ /smig rgyus ri dwags slu bzhin byis pa slu/ /'du byed rnam pa chu shing rang bzhin 'dra—/ /sgyu ma'i tshul las rnam shes gtad pa med/ /de la brten zhing ཿro 'dra'i lus 'di nyid/ /rnam mang bskyod cing lam rgyud kun du 'khyam/ /bdag dang bdag gi 'di la gang yang med/ /mi gtsang sna tshogs 'dus pa'i tshogs 'di ste/ /rang dbang yod ltar 'khrul 'khor byas pa bzhin/ /sems can 'du shes byis pa slu ba byed/ /mig 'di skad cig 'jig ste bdag ma yin/ /mig ldan de min mig la bdag kyang med/ /bdag la mig med skye mched lhag ma yang / /de dang tshul 'dra gtad ༄ )med bdag gi med/ /lus la gnas pa'i khams dang phyi rol khams/ /mtshan nyid mi mtshungs 'gal ba gang yang med/ /rnam shes khams kyang mi rtag bdag ma yin/ /de las gzhan yang nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /de ltar 'di ni sred rmongs yid ldan la/ /sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig byung bar gyur pa yin/ /sred dang bral na zhi ba'i mchog thob ste/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin sred sel lam yang thob3/ /de dang de dag rten 'byel byung ④64—1623

ba zhes/ /lta ba rnam dag yod med gnyis mi dmigs/ /'gro ba 'di dag de la sgyu ltar snang / /de phyir bde la sogs pas 'gyur med bstan⑨/ /'das gyur byung gyur rtog pa log lta ste/ /byung gyur gang yin srid las bde 'gyur zhes//de ltar 'das pa'i yul la 'dod bral zhing / /byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba ②smon pa med/ /sdug bsngal tshul gyis mngon par mi bde zhing / /mi bzad mig phye mngon pa'i tshul yod na/ /de dag don bsgrub (kyiphongs dor tshul bsams shing / /shes ldan su zhig dgar gnas sla ④snyam sems/ /de ltar rnam grol blo ldan snying rje can/ /'gro ba mgon med nyon mongs gzir mthong na//thams cad byang chub mchog la ma bkod du/ /dma' las byams btang mya ngan 'dar mi mos/ /'jig rten don sgrub tshul la mthu med pa'i/ /theg pa gnyis po gtan du spang byas shing / /thub rgyal theg pa snying rjes bstan pa'i lam/ /gzhan phan ro gcig rang bzhin de dag 'jug /dma' 'os tshul la legs pa'i blo mi gzhol/ /che la che min nam yang gnas mi 'gyur/ /gtsang ma'i rang bzhin gtsang dang rtag tu 'byel/ /gzhan yang mthun dang mthun gyur chos nyid tshul—/ /bde dang mi bde rmi lam 'drar 'brangs shing / /gti mug skyon gyis dma' ba'i 'gro mthong na/ /las kyi dam pa gzhan don dga' bor zhing / /rang gi don la de ko ci ste brtson/ /gang zhig 'jig rten phan phyir kun spyod cing / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal bdag lta yongs spangs te/ /kun la byams pas mi gnyis lam rgyu ba/ /de ni mya ngan 'das kyang 'jig rten spyod/ /shes rab rnam dag mngon sgrub theg pa'i mchog /thub chen thams cad mkhyen nyid de las 'byung / /de ni 'jig rten rnams kyi mig bzhin te/ /'od ldan nyi ma shar 64—1624

ba'i 'od dang 'dra/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyi rkyakhur gyis ngal chad kyang / /shes rab rnam par dbye la skyon med pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas legs bsgrub tsa/theg pa la/ /bdag nyid yongs su skyo bar 'gyur ba med/ /bde gshegs mthu can rmad byung mthong 'gyur bas/ /yan lag thams cad spu g.yo dga' gyur cing / /de bsgrub ④jeg pa'i dam pa spong ④byed pa/ /g.yo sgyu ༄spyod min rgyu ni gzhan med do//bdud kyi 'khrug ⑥pas ma non su zhig ko/ /dkon mchog gsum gye 3'byung gnas theg pa ste/ /gnod pa'i mda' 'byin bde gshegs theg pa la/ /smod par su byed de ni 'gro ba'i sgra3/ /shes rab mig zums 'gros 'khyar gyur pa la/ /'jig rten don sgrub rgyal ba'i rgyal rigs na/ /snying rje mi skyed skyes bu gang zhig yod—/ /de dag rmongs bsal tūbartson 'grus su mi rtsom/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u'o// //pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa ār+ya shu ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba ā tsār+ya ⑪bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba'o// //64byed1625

༄༅/ /las dang po pa'i sa sngung ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya ti karmi byu mi ka ri pa ri/ bod skad du/las dang po pa'i sa sbyang ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma lta bur gzi ldan sku/ /sangs rgyas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /las ni dang po pa yi sa//sbyang ba 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /lam ma sbyangs pa'i nyes pa dang / /lam gyi sbyang ba gang zhe na/ /lam ma sbyangs pa'i skye bo dag /byes bgrod ngal dub tsha grang dang / /phyi dang rtsub dang skyo ba dang / /bkres skom gdung ④shing brnyas pa dang / /'jig dze+edang yi mug nyams su myong / /mya ngan 'tshor 'grib bcas pa dang / /kha cig spyi'u tshugs dmyal ba dang / /dud 'gro yi dwags rnams su bsten/ /nor dang bza' btung grags pa dang / /'dod pas byes 'grod ④ sdug bsngal can/ /re ba 'bras bu med pa dang / /sdug dang bral dang mi sdug phrad / /mi bzad na rgas 'dzoms bzhin du/ /'chi bdag drung du myur 'gro 64byed1630

ba—/ /ma tshor ga zhar bcas shing brtsesde/ /tshe 'di don med myur du 'da'/ /yang dang yang du skye ba yi②/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa grangs med bsten/ /kyi hud lam las nyams pa yi/ /skye bo dag ni nyam ngar gnas/ /mi bzad mya ngan 'brog dgon du/ /lam gol gyur pa dag dang mtshungs/ /mig ldan lam log 'gro ba ltar/ /lam las nyams pa'i skye bo smad/ /de la lam sbyangs pa dze+egang zhe na/ 'dir las dang po pa'i sa ni lam byi dang po ste/ de sbyang ba ni dbye ba rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i dkon mchog gsum legs par shes nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / rgya cher mchod pa dang / yon tan brjod pas bstod pa dang /snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / rjes su dran pa bsgoms pas babe+eb pa la slob pas skyabs phun sum tshogs pa yin/ mi dge ba bcu'i nyes pa shes pa dang / dge ba bcu'i yon tan shes pa dang / dge ba bcu'i sdom pa len pa dang / blangs pa slar mi gtong ba dang / lan 'ga' nyams na yang chos bzhin du slar 'chos pas sdom pa la gnas pa yin/ byang chub sems kyi phan yon legs par shes pa dang / de skye ba'i rgyu la gnas pa dang / sems de yang dag par bskyed pa dang / bskyed pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs ring du spong ba dang / sems de 'phel zhing mi brjed ④pa'i chos la gnas pas byang chub kyi sems la gnas pa yin pas/ de ltar chos rnam pa gsum la rnam pa bco lngar phye ba 'di ni 'dir sa sbyang ba'i gzhi dang / rten dang / gnas zhes bya'o/ /de gzhi de lta bu la brten nas/ lam gyi dngos gzhi gang / ji ltar sbyang zhe na/gzhi de dag la legs par gnas pas 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems blang ba byas nas—/ ji ltar blangs pa'i sdom pa las mi 'da' bar byams pa tshad med pa 64—1631

bsgom pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi bsgom zhing / yang dag par spong ba bzhi la gnas par bya ste/ 'di ni las dang po pa'i sa'i dngos gzhi yid la bya bas/ rim gyis 'phags pa'i bden pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi grub nas/ ting nge 'dzin kyi ngo bo rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la gnas pa na/ sa de nyid kyi khyad par thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa yin te/ bdag dang gzhan gyi 'byor pa dang / /'dun dang tshul khrims dbang po dang / /de bzhin zas dang mi nyal ① dang / /shes bzhin du ni mi spyod dang / /de bzhin dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / /dam chos nyan dang sems pa dang / /bar chad med dang gtong ba dang / /dge sbyong brgya sneni tha ma yin/ /dad ldan g.yo med nad nyung dang / /brtson 'grus shes rab 'dod chung dang / /chog shes gso sla dgang be+e dang / /sbyangs dang mdzes dang drod rig dang / /skyes bu dam chos mkhas rtags dang / /bzod dang des dang gya nom pa'o/ /zhes bya ba'i yon tan dang ldan la/ de las zhugazhan pa theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam gyi khyad par lus la dbang ba la sogs pa dang / snying rje chen po'i sgo sngon du gyur pas sdug bsngal ba mthong ba na rang dbang med par mchi ④ma'i rgyun 'bab pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang /byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi po snga ma'i rten dang bcas pa 'di ni/tshogs kyi lam dang / las dang po pa'i sa dang / dad pa'i sa zhes bya'o/ /da ni 'dir nyin mtshan gyi cha las yang dag par spong ba bzhi la gnas pas ⑤64—1632

lam sbyang ba brjod pa/ tho rangs mal nas langs nas ni/ /bzhi ①gsum dran pas brtul zhugs mchog /bdag gzhan brje dang 'jig rten gyi/ /chos brgyad mnyam par mos pa bskyed/ /de nas yid ni bsdus pa yisne/ /kye ma sems can bde 'gyur bsam/ /de nas lus dang tshor ba dang / /sems dang chos ni mi gtsang dang / /sdug bsngal mi rtag bdag med ces/ /phyin ci log bzhi'i gnyen po bsgom/ /re re'am yang na rim gyis kyang / /nam langs bar du 'bad pas bsgom/ /gang zhig ①lus can grol 'gyur ba'i/ /lam gyi dang po 'di nyid yin/ /de nas nam ni langs pa dang / /ci rigs gtsang sbra byas nas ni/ /mchod rten phyag 'tshal maṇ+ḍal bya/ /sdig bshags la sogs rgyas byas te/ /lhag par skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /byang chub sems ni brtan po bskyed—/ /ci rigs bskor ④ ba byas nas ni/ /bla ma dang ni rgan po dang / /chos smra ba la'ang phyag byas te/ /'dzum zhing snyan par smra ba dang / /de dag dgos pa 'bad de bsgrub/ /bar der dus ni nyer gnas na/ /chos bshad la sogs sems can don/ /rang bde btang la 'bad pas bsgrub/ /khye'u sus la ⑪ sogs zas la spyod/ /dkon mchog sprin las gsungs pa bzhin/ /cha bzhir bgos te bza' bar bya/ /lhag par phongs la bza' btung bgo/ /snga dro yi ni dus dag tu/ /bri dang klog pa la sogs pa'i/ /chos spyod bcu la 'bad pa 'am/ /tsha tsha bya 'am 'gro phan gdags/ /dus kyi dam pa snga dro ni/ /don med 'da' bar mi bya'o/ /nyi ma'i gung la byams pa dang / /dran pa nyer gzhag cung zad bsgom/ /de nas yang ni phyag 'tshal sogs/ /snga ma bzhin du rgyas par bya/ /phyi dro skye bo dam pa dang / /'grogs shing ngal so du bden don 64—1633

la—/ /'gro zhing srid las yid 'byung ba'i/ /legs bshad ro ni myang bar bya /phyi 'phred sbar yang snga ma bzhin/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong bsgom pa dang / /mchod rten phyag 'tshal la sogs bya/ /dmar thag chad nas mtshan mo ni/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur tshul bzhin bya/ /rang gi rkang pa bkrus nas ni/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong bsgom pa 'am/ /don chen ldan pa'i kha ton bya/ /nam gyi cha stod 'das pa dang / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yis/ /rigs pa bzhin du nyal bar bya/ /nyin par dang ni mtshan mo yang / /lag bzangs kyis ni zhus pa dang / /rin chen phreng ba las bshad ltar/ /sna tshogs dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad / /de nas tshe 'di nyid la yang / /drod la sogs pa thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar thos pa dang bsam pa la gnas pas tshogs kyi lam phal pa dang khyad par can sbyang ngo / /de las gong du bsgom pa la ①byang bas mos pas spyod pa'i sa dag la dbang po dang stobs kyi bden pa dag bsgoms pa'i sa sbyang ba ni dkon mchog sprin la sogs par blta zhing / rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa sbyang ba ni sa bcu'i bye le'u las bstan to1/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi sa yi dang po pa/ /tshogs kyi sa ste de sbyangs ④mdor bsdus pa/ /cung zad bshad las dge ba gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro rnams dag pa'i sa thob shog /las dang po pa'i sa sbyang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rgyal gsang ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po kṛṇ+ḍa phyepa dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa ⑥// //64—1634

bsdur mchan/163༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa las dang po pa'i sa /ming ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉la las dang po pa'i sa sbyang ba dgra las rgyal ba gsang bas mdzad pa bzhugs/ zhes 'khod/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanadungs/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torajigs/④〈〈pe 〉〉byes bgrod/ 〈'dir 〉〉ged bgrod/1631 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtse/ /ge〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta1sa/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyang ba/ ngu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brjod/1632 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉panyal/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyan/ sgru〈〈pe 〉〉des/ ④〈〈snar 〉torachi ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/1632 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagazhi/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stonas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyanas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgor/ rgya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gso/1634 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ (3 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabacu ba'i/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉te/ bya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gsung /⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kriji/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉pa'o// 〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ /shu bha/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (125)64wa 1635

༄ga /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdams ngag tu byas pa/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo bye satwa tsar+ya su tri kṛ ②ta pa bā ra/bod skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdams ngag tu byas pa/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo nges par legs pa'i byang chub dang / /mngon par mtho ba thob 'dod pas/ /dkon mchog gsum la lhar bzung nas/ /dang po snying rje kun la lta/ /de nas byang chub sems bskyed de/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i spyod pa yis/ /rang gi sems nyid dang por gdul/ /dang po rang nyid ma 'dul ①bar/ /gzhan dag gdul bar ji ltar nus/ /ji ltar 'dab gshog ma tshang ba'i/ /bya yis mkha' la 'phur mi nus/ /de bzhin lta spyod med pa yi/ /gang zag dag ni ji ltar grol/ /de phyir de gnyis 'grub pa'i phyir/ /dka' ba'i 'bad pa chen pos bya/ /dka' bas sbyang ba ma byas par/ /be+e bas goms par ji ltar 64byed1636

'gyur—/ /go bgos khur khyer rgyal sras des/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten byas te/ /shes rab gsum la gzhi bcas nas/ /go 'phang mchog tu 'gro ba yi/ /lta ba nyid la gtsor sbyangs te/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i gos gyon nas/ /sgrub la nan tan gces ①su bya/ /chos kyi rjes su bsgrub pa'i phyir//dus dang gnas skabs kun du yang / /sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi/ /las rnams dran pas zin par bya/ /skyon spangs ④legs sgrub don yod bya/ /spyod lam don med du mi bya①/ /rtag tu rang gi yon tan sbyangs④/ /dge ba'i phyogs kyi sbyor ba la/ /spro bya zhum dang sems mi gsad/ /nyes spong yon tan dge 'phel ba'i/ /grogs btsal mthun pas de sems bzung ⑤/ /yon tan can la gus phyag bya/ /nyon mongs skye 'gro buthabs kyis spang / /mtho dman grogs kun dag la yang / /chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /nyes pa dor la legs pa blang / /byas pa ④drin gzo be+er phan gdags/ /gzhan gyi sdig rkyen mi bya zhing / /dge ba'i bar chad mi bya'o/ /mtho la phun tshogs phrag dog med//grogs dang dman la brnyas thabs dang / /khyad du gsad ④pa nyid mi bya/ /rang skyon gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag /gzhan skyon mi gleng rang mi bstod/ /'di bas phyi ma gtsor gzung ste/ /byed dgu chos dang bstun te bya/ /'di yi zang zing rnam spangs te/ /'phags pa'i nor gyis lus brgyan bya/ /sdug bsngal dag la bder mi bzung ⑨/ /gnyid rmugs le lo g.yeng spangs te/ /nges par 'chi ba'i dus ⑪shes bskyed/ /dge ba chung yang 'bad pas bsgrub/ /sdig pa chung yang rnam par spang / /chos kyi ched du ma gtogs par/ /kha zas gos sogs don mi gnyer/ /'dod pa chung dang chog ⑪shes bya/ /'jig rten 64—1637

chos brgyad rnam par spang / /ngo dga' gzhogs ①slong sogs mi bya/ /rang la skyon yod mi tshor bar/ /gzhan gyi skyon la dpyad mi bya/ /smra dga' khas len dpa' ⑤byas nas/ /de bzhin mi sgrub spang bar bya/ /g.yo dang sgyu dag mi bya zhing / /log pa'i 'tsho ba rnam par spang / /chos dang mthun pas bsgrub par bya / /nye du 'byel pa la sogs la/ /zhen par ④chags par mi bya zhing / /phyogs ris zhen phyogs med par bya/ /gzhan la re ba chung bar bya/ /mi dge'i las ④ la mi bstod smad/ /dgos pa med pa'i 'du 'dzi spang / /bre mo'i gtam la dga' mi bya/ /zhes pas 'dod pa'i yid smon dgag /yon tan thob dang tshogs 'phel ba'i/ /las la zhum dang ngo tsha spang / /nga rgyal khengs pa gnyen pos gzhom/ /zhe gdug kheng ⑤grags rnam par spang du/ /dngos dang brgyud pas sems can kun/ /nye du 'byel par gyur pa ⑦na/ /lus ngag yid gsum dri med pas/ /de dag kun la bu bzhin blta/ /snying rjes bzhin 'dzum gsong por smra/ /dga' ba'i mig gis kun la blta/ /'gror grogs mtho dman nye ring snyoms/ /bstod dang bkur stes ④mi dregs shing / /smod dang brnyas la zhe mi sdang / /phongs pa rnams la snying rje yis/ /phan ni gdags pa nyid du bya/ /gang la chags pa spang bya ste/ /dman pa rnams la snying rje dang / /phan pa'i bsam pas gdams ngag bya/ /sems can bsam pa tha dad pas/ /bya ba don chen brtags te bya/ /thams cad mgu bar su yis nus/ /'on kyang 'gyod pa med pa yis/ /sdug bsngal khyad bsad bde ma chags/ /rang gi sems sbyang ⑨gzhan sems gzung ⑩/ /brnyas dang nyes pa byung la sogs/ /gnyen po las dang brdzun pas sbyang / /de ltar blta 64—1638
